## Issuance: Tokens

### Create token
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/issuance/create-token

> Creates a token record that can later be deployed to Solana.

`POST /v1/issuance/tokens`

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `issuance.manage` action.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Selects the active project for this request. Required for Clerk (dashboard) callers. Ignored when authenticating with an API key, whose scope is fixed to the key's project.

## Request body

`application/json` · required

Create token request body.

- **`name`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · max length 100 · example `Example Token`

  Token name.

- **`symbol`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · max length 10 · pattern `^[A-Za-z0-9]+(?:\.[A-Za-z0-9]+)*$` · example `EXM`

  Ticker symbol.

- **`signingCustodyWalletId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `cwlt_example`

  Optional exact SDP Wallet ID for direct deployment. A draft may defer selection until deploy.

- **`decimals`** · `integer` · min 0 · max 18 · example `6`

  Token decimals.

- **`description`** · `string` · max length 500 · example `Example token description.`

  Token description.

- **`uri`** · `string` · format `uri` · max length 512 · example `https://example.com/metadata.json`

  Metadata URI passed to on-chain token metadata (points to off-chain JSON).

- **`imageUrl`** · `string` · format `uri` · max length 512 · example `https://example.com/token.png`

  Token image URL.

- **`maxSupply`** · `string` · example `1000000`

  Maximum supply as a string (UI units).

- **`template`** · `string` · one of `stablecoin`, `arcade`, `tokenized-security`, `custom` · example `stablecoin`

  Token template preset. Defaults to 'custom' if not specified.

- **`overrides`** · `object`

  Template overrides to customize defaults.

  - **`extensions`** · `object`

    Override template extension configuration.

    - **`transferFee`** · `boolean | object`

      Transfer fee configuration or false to disable.

      Any of:

      - **boolean** · always `false`

      - **object**

        - **`basisPoints`** · `integer` · required · min 0 · max 10000 · example `50`

          Transfer fee in basis points.

        - **`maxFee`** · `string` · required · example `0.5`

          Maximum fee in UI units.

        - **`transferFeeConfigAuthority`** · `string` · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

          Authority to configure transfer fees. Defaults to platform authority.

        - **`withdrawWithheldAuthority`** · `string` · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

          Authority to withdraw withheld fees. Defaults to platform authority.

    - **`interestBearing`** · `boolean | object`

      Interest-bearing configuration or false to disable.

      Any of:

      - **boolean** · always `false`

      - **object**

        - **`rate`** · `number` · required · example `2.5`

          Interest rate in percent.

        - **`rateAuthority`** · `string` · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

          Authority that can update the rate. Defaults to platform authority.

    - **`permanentDelegate`** · `boolean | string` · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

      Permanent delegate authority address, or false to disable.

      Any of:

      - **boolean** · always `false`

      - **string**

    - **`pausable`** · `boolean | object`

      Pausable configuration or false to disable.

      Any of:

      - **boolean** · always `false`

      - **object**

        - **`authority`** · `string` · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

          Authority that can pause/resume transfers. Defaults to platform authority.

    - **`nonTransferable`** · `boolean` · example `false`

      Enable/disable non-transferable.

    - **`defaultAccountState`** · `string` · one of `initialized`, `frozen` · example `frozen`

      Override default account state.

    - **`scaledUiAmount`** · `boolean | object`

      Scaled UI amount configuration or false to disable.

      Any of:

      - **boolean** · always `false`

      - **object**

        - **`authority`** · `string` · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

          Authority that can update scaled UI parameters. Defaults to platform authority.

        - **`multiplier`** · `number` · required · example `1`

          Current UI multiplier.

        - **`newMultiplier`** · `number` · example `2`

          Scheduled multiplier.

        - **`newMultiplierEffectiveTimestamp`** · `integer` · example `1735689600`

          Unix timestamp (seconds) when the new multiplier takes effect.

    - **`transferHook`** · `boolean | object`

      Transfer hook configuration or false to disable.

      Any of:

      - **boolean** · always `false`

      - **object**

        - **`programId`** · `string` · required · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

          Transfer hook program id.

        - **`authority`** · `string` · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

          Authority that can update the hook program. Defaults to platform authority.

  - **`requiresAllowlist`** · `boolean` · example `true`

    Override allowlist requirement (if template allows).

- **`requiresAllowlist`** · `boolean` · example `true`

  Require allowlist checks for transfers.

- **`isMintable`** · `boolean` · example `true`

  Allow minting after creation.

- **`isFreezable`** · `boolean` · example `true`

  Allow freezing token accounts.

## Responses

- **`201`** Token created

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    Token response payload.

    - **`token`** · `object` · required

      Token details.

      - **`id`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `tok_example`

        Token identifier.

      - **`projectId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

        Project identifier.

      - **`organizationId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `org_example`

        Organization identifier.

      - **`signingCustodyWalletId`** · `string | null` · required · min length 1 · example `cwlt_example`

        Exact deployment wallet selected for a pending token, or historical deployment attribution after deployment. This is not the current signer for later authority operations.

      - **`mintAddress`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Mint address once deployed.

      - **`mintAuthority`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Mint authority address, if set.

      - **`freezeAuthority`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Freeze authority address, if set.

      - **`ablListAddress`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        On-chain allowlist/blocklist address, if enabled.

      - **`name`** · `string` · required · example `Example Token`

        Token name.

      - **`symbol`** · `string` · required · example `EXM`

        Token symbol.

      - **`decimals`** · `integer` · required · example `9`

        Token decimals.

      - **`description`** · `string | null` · required · example `Example token description.`

        Token description.

      - **`uri`** · `string | null` · required · example `https://example.com/metadata.json`

        Metadata URI passed to on-chain token metadata (points to off-chain JSON).

      - **`imageUrl`** · `string | null` · required · example `https://example.com/token.png`

        Token image URL.

      - **`template`** · `string` · required · one of `stablecoin`, `arcade`, `tokenized-security`, `custom`, `rwa` · example `stablecoin`

        Token template identifier.

      - **`extensions`** · `object | null` · required

        Token-2022 extensions configuration.

        - **`transferFee`** · `object`

          Transfer fee configuration.

          - **`basisPoints`** · `integer` · required · min 0 · max 10000 · example `25`

            Transfer fee in basis points (0-10000).

          - **`maxFee`** · `string` · required · example `0.5`

            Maximum fee in UI units.

          - **`transferFeeConfigAuthority`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

            Authority to configure transfer fees.

          - **`withdrawWithheldAuthority`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

            Authority to withdraw withheld fees.

        - **`interestBearing`** · `object`

          Interest-bearing configuration.

          - **`rate`** · `number` · required · example `2.5`

            Interest rate in percent.

          - **`rateAuthority`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

            Authority that can update the rate.

        - **`permanentDelegate`** · `string` · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

          Permanent delegate address.

        - **`pausable`** · `object`

          Pausable configuration.

          - **`authority`** · `string` · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

            Authority that can pause/resume transfers.

        - **`nonTransferable`** · `boolean` · example `false`

          Mark token as non-transferable.

        - **`defaultAccountState`** · `string` · one of `initialized`, `frozen` · example `initialized`

          Default account state.

        - **`scaledUiAmount`** · `object`

          Scaled UI amount configuration.

          - **`authority`** · `string` · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

            Authority that can update scaled UI parameters.

          - **`multiplier`** · `number` · required · example `1`

            Current UI multiplier.

          - **`newMultiplier`** · `number` · required · example `2`

            Scheduled multiplier.

          - **`newMultiplierEffectiveTimestamp`** · `integer` · required · example `1735689600`

            Unix timestamp (seconds) when the new multiplier takes effect.

        - **`transferHook`** · `object`

          Transfer hook configuration.

          - **`programId`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

            Transfer hook program id.

          - **`authority`** · `string` · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

            Authority that can update the transfer hook program.

      - **`totalSupply`** · `string` · required · example `1000000`

        Cached total supply in UI units (stored to avoid frequent RPC reads). Use POST /v1/issuance/tokens/\{tokenId\}/supply/refresh to force an on-chain refresh.

      - **`totalSupplyUpdatedAt`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `null`

        Timestamp when supply was last refreshed.

      - **`maxSupply`** · `string | null` · required · example `10000000`

        Maximum supply in UI units, if capped.

      - **`isMintable`** · `boolean` · required · example `true`

        Whether additional minting is allowed.

      - **`isFreezable`** · `boolean` · required · example `true`

        Whether freeze authority is enabled.

      - **`requiresAllowlist`** · `boolean` · required · example `false`

        Whether transfers require allowlist approval.

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `pending`, `active`, `paused`, `revoked` · example `active`

        Token lifecycle status.

      - **`deployedAt`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-05T00:00:00.000Z`

        Deployment timestamp, if deployed.

      - **`createdBy`** · `string` · required · example `key_example`

        Actor identifier that created the token.

      - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        Creation timestamp.

      - **`updatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-02T00:00:00.000Z`

        Last update timestamp.

    - **`allowlistAuthority`** · `string | null` · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

      Live on-chain list authority. Returned only by GET token with includeAllowlistAuthority=true; null when no on-chain list is configured. This is not the token freeze authority or a signer authorization.

    - **`freezeAuthority`** · `string | null` · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

      Live freeze-operation authority. Returned only by GET token with includeFreezeAuthority=true. For Token ACL mints this is the mint-config controller rather than the mint's program PDA freeze authority.

    - **`metadataAuthority`** · `string | null` · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

      Metadata authority, returned only by GET token with includeMetadataAuthority=true. Read live on-chain when the token has a mint; otherwise the stored metadata authority or stored mint authority. Null when unavailable. RPC failure returns 502 without falling back to stored authority. This read does not authorize signing or change the token.

    - **`pauseAuthority`** · `string | null` · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

      Live on-chain pausable authority. Returned only by GET token with includePauseAuthority=true; null when the mint has no pausable authority.

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `issuance.manage` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`422`** Unprocessable Entity

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `400`.

### List tokens
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/issuance/list-tokens

> Lists tokens for the current project or organization.

`GET /v1/issuance/tokens`

Supports contains-style search, filtering and sorting; `meta.total` always reflects the active filters. Ordering carries an id tiebreaker, so paging is stable across tokens that share a timestamp or name.

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `issuance.read` action.

## Query parameters

- **`page`** · `integer` · greater than 0 · max 1000000 · default `1` · example `1`

  Page number (1-based).

- **`pageSize`** · `integer` · min 1 · max 100 · default `50` · example `50`

  Items per page (max 100).

- **`search`** · `string` · max length 100 · example `usdc`

  Contains-style, case-insensitive match over name, symbol, mint address and token id. LIKE wildcards are matched literally. A blank value is treated as no search filter.

- **`status`** · `string` · one of `pending`, `active`, `paused`, `revoked` · example `active`

  Filter by the stored lifecycle column.

- **`deploymentStatus`** · `string` · one of `draft`, `active`, `paused` · example `active`

  Filter by derived lifecycle state: draft until the token has a mint, paused when the mint is paused, active otherwise.

- **`template`** · `string` · min length 1 · max length 64 · example `stablecoin`

  Exact-match template id. Use GET /v1/issuance/tokens/facets for the ids present in the project (older tokens may hold legacy ids).

- **`createdAfter`** · `string` · format `date-time` · example `2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

  Inclusive lower bound on creation time (ISO 8601).

- **`createdBefore`** · `string` · format `date-time` · example `2026-06-30T23:59:59.999Z`

  Inclusive upper bound on creation time (ISO 8601).

- **`sortBy`** · `string` · one of `createdAt`, `name` · default `createdAt` · example `createdAt`

  Field used to sort the token list.

- **`sortDirection`** · `string` · one of `asc`, `desc` · default `desc` · example `desc`

  Sort direction.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Selects the active project for this request. Required for Clerk (dashboard) callers. Ignored when authenticating with an API key, whose scope is fixed to the key's project.

## Responses

- **`200`** Token list

  - **`data`** · `object[]` · required

    - **`id`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `tok_example`

      Token identifier.

    - **`projectId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

      Project identifier.

    - **`organizationId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `org_example`

      Organization identifier.

    - **`signingCustodyWalletId`** · `string | null` · required · min length 1 · example `cwlt_example`

      Exact deployment wallet selected for a pending token, or historical deployment attribution after deployment. This is not the current signer for later authority operations.

    - **`mintAddress`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

      Mint address once deployed.

    - **`mintAuthority`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

      Mint authority address, if set.

    - **`freezeAuthority`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

      Freeze authority address, if set.

    - **`ablListAddress`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

      On-chain allowlist/blocklist address, if enabled.

    - **`name`** · `string` · required · example `Example Token`

      Token name.

    - **`symbol`** · `string` · required · example `EXM`

      Token symbol.

    - **`decimals`** · `integer` · required · example `9`

      Token decimals.

    - **`description`** · `string | null` · required · example `Example token description.`

      Token description.

    - **`uri`** · `string | null` · required · example `https://example.com/metadata.json`

      Metadata URI passed to on-chain token metadata (points to off-chain JSON).

    - **`imageUrl`** · `string | null` · required · example `https://example.com/token.png`

      Token image URL.

    - **`template`** · `string` · required · one of `stablecoin`, `arcade`, `tokenized-security`, `custom`, `rwa` · example `stablecoin`

      Token template identifier.

    - **`extensions`** · `object | null` · required

      Token-2022 extensions configuration.

      - **`transferFee`** · `object`

        Transfer fee configuration.

        - **`basisPoints`** · `integer` · required · min 0 · max 10000 · example `25`

          Transfer fee in basis points (0-10000).

        - **`maxFee`** · `string` · required · example `0.5`

          Maximum fee in UI units.

        - **`transferFeeConfigAuthority`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

          Authority to configure transfer fees.

        - **`withdrawWithheldAuthority`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

          Authority to withdraw withheld fees.

      - **`interestBearing`** · `object`

        Interest-bearing configuration.

        - **`rate`** · `number` · required · example `2.5`

          Interest rate in percent.

        - **`rateAuthority`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

          Authority that can update the rate.

      - **`permanentDelegate`** · `string` · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Permanent delegate address.

      - **`pausable`** · `object`

        Pausable configuration.

        - **`authority`** · `string` · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

          Authority that can pause/resume transfers.

      - **`nonTransferable`** · `boolean` · example `false`

        Mark token as non-transferable.

      - **`defaultAccountState`** · `string` · one of `initialized`, `frozen` · example `initialized`

        Default account state.

      - **`scaledUiAmount`** · `object`

        Scaled UI amount configuration.

        - **`authority`** · `string` · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

          Authority that can update scaled UI parameters.

        - **`multiplier`** · `number` · required · example `1`

          Current UI multiplier.

        - **`newMultiplier`** · `number` · required · example `2`

          Scheduled multiplier.

        - **`newMultiplierEffectiveTimestamp`** · `integer` · required · example `1735689600`

          Unix timestamp (seconds) when the new multiplier takes effect.

      - **`transferHook`** · `object`

        Transfer hook configuration.

        - **`programId`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

          Transfer hook program id.

        - **`authority`** · `string` · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

          Authority that can update the transfer hook program.

      Cached total supply in UI units (stored to avoid frequent RPC reads). Use POST /v1/issuance/tokens/\{tokenId\}/supply/refresh to force an on-chain refresh.

    - **`totalSupplyUpdatedAt`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `null`

      Timestamp when supply was last refreshed.

    - **`maxSupply`** · `string | null` · required · example `10000000`

      Maximum supply in UI units, if capped.

    - **`isMintable`** · `boolean` · required · example `true`

      Whether additional minting is allowed.

    - **`isFreezable`** · `boolean` · required · example `true`

      Whether freeze authority is enabled.

    - **`requiresAllowlist`** · `boolean` · required · example `false`

      Whether transfers require allowlist approval.

    - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `pending`, `active`, `paused`, `revoked` · example `active`

      Token lifecycle status.

    - **`deployedAt`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-05T00:00:00.000Z`

      Deployment timestamp, if deployed.

      Actor identifier that created the token.

    - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      Creation timestamp.

    - **`updatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-02T00:00:00.000Z`

      Last update timestamp.

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Pagination metadata.

    - **`total`** · `integer` · required · min 0

      Total items.

    - **`page`** · `integer` · required · greater than 0

      Current page number.

    - **`pageSize`** · `integer` · required · greater than 0

      Items per page.

    - **`hasMore`** · `boolean` · required

      Whether more pages exist.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `issuance.read` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `400`.

```ts tab="TypeScript"
  }
```

### List token filter facets
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/issuance/list-token-facets

> Returns the filter choices available for the project's token list — template ids in use, counts per lifecycle state, and the unfiltered total.

`GET /v1/issuance/tokens/facets`

Deliberately unaffected by list filters, so a client can offer the full set of options while showing a filtered page.

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `issuance.read` action.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Selects the active project for this request. Required for Clerk (dashboard) callers. Ignored when authenticating with an API key, whose scope is fixed to the key's project.

## Responses

- **`200`** Token filter facets

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    - **`templates`** · `object[]` · required

      Template ids present in the project with their token counts. Includes legacy ids still stored on older tokens.

      - **`template`** · `string` · required · example `stablecoin`

      - **`count`** · `integer` · required · example `12`

    - **`deploymentStatuses`** · `object` · required

      Token counts per derived lifecycle state (draft until deployed, paused when the mint is paused, active otherwise).

      - **`draft`** · `integer` · required · example `3`

      - **`active`** · `integer` · required · example `8`

      - **`paused`** · `integer` · required · example `1`

    - **`total`** · `integer` · required · example `12`

      Total tokens in the project, unfiltered — distinguishes an empty project from an over-filtered list.

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `issuance.read` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `401`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `401`.

### Get token
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/issuance/get-token

> Gets token details with optional read-only authority lookups for wallet selection.

`GET /v1/issuance/tokens/{tokenId}`

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `issuance.read` action.

## Path parameters

- **`tokenId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `tok_example`

  Token identifier.

## Query parameters

- **`includeAllowlistAuthority`** · `string` · one of `true`, `false` · example `true`

  Opt in to a read-only RPC lookup of the current on-chain list authority for wallet selection. Ordinary token reads do not perform this lookup.

- **`includeFreezeAuthority`** · `string` · one of `true`, `false` · example `true`

  Opt in to a read-only lookup of the authority that controls freeze operations. Token ACL mints return the live mint-config controller.

- **`includeMetadataAuthority`** · `string` · one of `true`, `false` · example `true`

  Opt in to a read-only lookup of the current metadata authority for wallet selection. Tokens with a mint use live chain state; tokens without a mint use the stored metadata authority, falling back to stored mint authority, without RPC. Ordinary token reads do not perform this lookup.

- **`includePauseAuthority`** · `string` · one of `true`, `false` · example `true`

  Opt in to a read-only lookup of the live Token-2022 pausable authority for wallet selection.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Selects the active project for this request. Required for Clerk (dashboard) callers. Ignored when authenticating with an API key, whose scope is fixed to the key's project.

      - **`updatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-02T00:00:00.000Z`

        Last update timestamp.

    - **`allowlistAuthority`** · `string | null` · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

      Live on-chain list authority. Returned only by GET token with includeAllowlistAuthority=true; null when no on-chain list is configured. This is not the token freeze authority or a signer authorization.

    - **`freezeAuthority`** · `string | null` · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

      Live freeze-operation authority. Returned only by GET token with includeFreezeAuthority=true. For Token ACL mints this is the mint-config controller rather than the mint's program PDA freeze authority.

    - **`metadataAuthority`** · `string | null` · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

      Metadata authority, returned only by GET token with includeMetadataAuthority=true. Read live on-chain when the token has a mint; otherwise the stored metadata authority or stored mint authority. Null when unavailable. RPC failure returns 502 without falling back to stored authority. This read does not authorize signing or change the token.

    - **`pauseAuthority`** · `string | null` · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

      Live on-chain pausable authority. Returned only by GET token with includePauseAuthority=true; null when the mint has no pausable authority.

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `issuance.read` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`404`** Not Found

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`502`** Bad Gateway

  Same fields as `400`.

## Example request

```bash tab="cURL"

```

```ts tab="TypeScript"
  }

```

### Update token
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/issuance/update-token

> Updates stored token fields.

`PATCH /v1/issuance/tokens/{tokenId}`

For deployed tokens, metadata fields are also written on-chain through the current metadata authority.

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `issuance.execute` action.

## Path parameters

- **`tokenId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `tok_example`

  Token identifier.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Selects the active project for this request. Required for Clerk (dashboard) callers. Ignored when authenticating with an API key, whose scope is fixed to the key's project.

## Request body

`application/json` · required

Update token request body.

- **`signingCustodyWalletId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `cwlt_example`

  Optional exact SDP Wallet ID. On an undeployed pending draft, updates the deployment wallet. After deployment, selects the signer only for this on-chain metadata update and does not change deployment attribution. A request containing only this field after deployment returns 400; include the token changes to apply. Database-only edits need no signer. For on-chain metadata updates, the selected wallet must control the current metadata authority; omission requires exactly one matching in-scope custody record, otherwise returns 409.

- **`name`** · `string` · min length 1 · max length 100 · example `Example Token Updated`

  Updated token name. For deployed tokens, this updates on-chain Token-2022 metadata using the current metadata authority.

- **`symbol`** · `string` · min length 1 · max length 10 · pattern `^[A-Za-z0-9]+(?:\.[A-Za-z0-9]+)*$`

- **`decimals`** · `integer` · min 0 · max 18

- **`description`** · `string | null` · max length 500 · example `Updated token description.`

  Updated token description. For deployed tokens, this writes the on-chain `description` metadata field. Use null to clear the displayed value.

- **`uri`** · `string | null` · format `uri` · max length 512 · example `https://example.com/metadata.json`

  Updated metadata URI. For deployed tokens, this updates the on-chain Token-2022 metadata URI using the current metadata authority. Use null to clear.

- **`imageUrl`** · `string | null` · format `uri` · max length 512 · example `https://example.com/token.png`

  Updated image URL. For deployed tokens, this writes the on-chain `image` metadata field. Use null to clear the displayed value.

- **`requiresAllowlist`** · `boolean` · example `true`

  Whether transfers are restricted to allowlisted accounts. Only accepted while the token is undeployed (pending, no mint address); returns 400 after deployment.

- **`maxSupply`** · `string | null` · example `1000000`

  Updated maximum supply as a string (UI units); null removes the cap. Enforced by SDP at mint time while it holds the mint authority, so it is rejected with 400 once the supply is locked on-chain (mint authority revoked), and cannot be set below the already-minted supply.

## Responses

- **`200`** Token updated

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    Token response payload.

    - **`token`** · `object` · required

      Token details.

      - **`id`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `tok_example`

        Token identifier.

      - **`projectId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

        Project identifier.

      - **`organizationId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `org_example`

        Organization identifier.

      - **`signingCustodyWalletId`** · `string | null` · required · min length 1 · example `cwlt_example`

        Exact deployment wallet selected for a pending token, or historical deployment attribution after deployment. This is not the current signer for later authority operations.

      - **`mintAddress`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Mint address once deployed.

      - **`mintAuthority`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Mint authority address, if set.

      - **`freezeAuthority`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Freeze authority address, if set.

      - **`ablListAddress`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        On-chain allowlist/blocklist address, if enabled.

      - **`name`** · `string` · required · example `Example Token`

        Token name.

      - **`symbol`** · `string` · required · example `EXM`

        Token symbol.

      - **`decimals`** · `integer` · required · example `9`

        Token decimals.

      - **`description`** · `string | null` · required · example `Example token description.`

        Token description.

      - **`uri`** · `string | null` · required · example `https://example.com/metadata.json`

        Metadata URI passed to on-chain token metadata (points to off-chain JSON).

      - **`imageUrl`** · `string | null` · required · example `https://example.com/token.png`

        Token image URL.

      - **`template`** · `string` · required · one of `stablecoin`, `arcade`, `tokenized-security`, `custom`, `rwa` · example `stablecoin`

        Token template identifier.

      - **`extensions`** · `object | null` · required

        Token-2022 extensions configuration.

        - **`transferFee`** · `object`

          Transfer fee configuration.

          - **`basisPoints`** · `integer` · required · min 0 · max 10000 · example `25`

            Transfer fee in basis points (0-10000).

          - **`maxFee`** · `string` · required · example `0.5`

            Maximum fee in UI units.

          - **`transferFeeConfigAuthority`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

            Authority to configure transfer fees.

          - **`withdrawWithheldAuthority`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

            Authority to withdraw withheld fees.

        - **`interestBearing`** · `object`

          Interest-bearing configuration.

          - **`rate`** · `number` · required · example `2.5`

            Interest rate in percent.

          - **`rateAuthority`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

            Authority that can update the rate.

        - **`permanentDelegate`** · `string` · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

          Permanent delegate address.

        - **`pausable`** · `object`

          Pausable configuration.

          - **`authority`** · `string` · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

            Authority that can pause/resume transfers.

        - **`nonTransferable`** · `boolean` · example `false`

          Mark token as non-transferable.

        - **`defaultAccountState`** · `string` · one of `initialized`, `frozen` · example `initialized`

          Default account state.

        - **`scaledUiAmount`** · `object`

          Scaled UI amount configuration.

          - **`authority`** · `string` · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

            Authority that can update scaled UI parameters.

          - **`multiplier`** · `number` · required · example `1`

            Current UI multiplier.

          - **`newMultiplier`** · `number` · required · example `2`

            Scheduled multiplier.

          - **`newMultiplierEffectiveTimestamp`** · `integer` · required · example `1735689600`

            Unix timestamp (seconds) when the new multiplier takes effect.

        - **`transferHook`** · `object`

          Transfer hook configuration.

          - **`programId`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

            Transfer hook program id.

          - **`authority`** · `string` · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

            Authority that can update the transfer hook program.

      - **`totalSupply`** · `string` · required · example `1000000`

        Cached total supply in UI units (stored to avoid frequent RPC reads). Use POST /v1/issuance/tokens/\{tokenId\}/supply/refresh to force an on-chain refresh.

      - **`totalSupplyUpdatedAt`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `null`

        Timestamp when supply was last refreshed.

      - **`maxSupply`** · `string | null` · required · example `10000000`

        Maximum supply in UI units, if capped.

      - **`isMintable`** · `boolean` · required · example `true`

        Whether additional minting is allowed.

      - **`isFreezable`** · `boolean` · required · example `true`

        Whether freeze authority is enabled.

      - **`requiresAllowlist`** · `boolean` · required · example `false`

        Whether transfers require allowlist approval.

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `pending`, `active`, `paused`, `revoked` · example `active`

        Token lifecycle status.

      - **`deployedAt`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-05T00:00:00.000Z`

        Deployment timestamp, if deployed.

      - **`createdBy`** · `string` · required · example `key_example`

        Actor identifier that created the token.

      - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        Creation timestamp.

      - **`updatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-02T00:00:00.000Z`

        Last update timestamp.

    - **`allowlistAuthority`** · `string | null` · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

      Live on-chain list authority. Returned only by GET token with includeAllowlistAuthority=true; null when no on-chain list is configured. This is not the token freeze authority or a signer authorization.

    - **`freezeAuthority`** · `string | null` · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

      Live freeze-operation authority. Returned only by GET token with includeFreezeAuthority=true. For Token ACL mints this is the mint-config controller rather than the mint's program PDA freeze authority.

    - **`metadataAuthority`** · `string | null` · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

      Metadata authority, returned only by GET token with includeMetadataAuthority=true. Read live on-chain when the token has a mint; otherwise the stored metadata authority or stored mint authority. Null when unavailable. RPC failure returns 502 without falling back to stored authority. This read does not authorize signing or change the token.

    - **`pauseAuthority`** · `string | null` · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

      Live on-chain pausable authority. Returned only by GET token with includePauseAuthority=true; null when the mint has no pausable authority.

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `issuance.execute` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`404`** Not Found

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`409`** Conflict

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `400`.

### Get public token metadata JSON
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/issuance/get-token-metadata-json

> Public, unauthenticated endpoint serving the SDP-hosted Token-2022 / Metaplex fungible-compatible metadata JSON for a deployed token.

`GET /v1/issuance/tokens/{tokenId}/metadata.json`

This is the URL burned into the on-chain MetadataPointer when the issuer doesn't supply their own URI. Only deployed (on-chain) tokens are served; pending drafts return 404.

Public: this route takes no API key.

## Path parameters

- **`tokenId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `tok_example`

  Token identifier.

## Responses

- **`200`** Token metadata JSON

  - **`name`** · `string` · required

  - **`symbol`** · `string` · required

  - **`description`** · `string`

    - **`details`** · `object`

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

### Refresh cached token supply
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/issuance/refresh-token-supply

> Fetches the current on-chain supply and refreshes the cached totalSupply value.

`POST /v1/issuance/tokens/{tokenId}/supply/refresh`

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `issuance.read` action.

## Path parameters

- **`tokenId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `tok_example`

  Token identifier.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Selects the active project for this request. Required for Clerk (dashboard) callers. Ignored when authenticating with an API key, whose scope is fixed to the key's project.

## Responses

- **`200`** Token supply refreshed

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    Token response payload.

    - **`token`** · `object` · required

      Token details.

      - **`id`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `tok_example`

        Token identifier.

      - **`projectId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

        Project identifier.

      - **`organizationId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `org_example`

        Organization identifier.

      - **`signingCustodyWalletId`** · `string | null` · required · min length 1 · example `cwlt_example`

        Exact deployment wallet selected for a pending token, or historical deployment attribution after deployment. This is not the current signer for later authority operations.

      - **`mintAddress`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Mint address once deployed.

      - **`mintAuthority`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Mint authority address, if set.

      - **`freezeAuthority`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Freeze authority address, if set.

      - **`ablListAddress`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        On-chain allowlist/blocklist address, if enabled.

      - **`name`** · `string` · required · example `Example Token`

        Token name.

      - **`symbol`** · `string` · required · example `EXM`

        Token symbol.

      - **`decimals`** · `integer` · required · example `9`

        Token decimals.

      - **`description`** · `string | null` · required · example `Example token description.`

        Token description.

      - **`uri`** · `string | null` · required · example `https://example.com/metadata.json`

        Metadata URI passed to on-chain token metadata (points to off-chain JSON).

      - **`imageUrl`** · `string | null` · required · example `https://example.com/token.png`

        Token image URL.

      - **`template`** · `string` · required · one of `stablecoin`, `arcade`, `tokenized-security`, `custom`, `rwa` · example `stablecoin`

        Token template identifier.

      - **`extensions`** · `object | null` · required

        Token-2022 extensions configuration.

        - **`transferFee`** · `object`

          Transfer fee configuration.

          - **`basisPoints`** · `integer` · required · min 0 · max 10000 · example `25`

            Transfer fee in basis points (0-10000).

          - **`maxFee`** · `string` · required · example `0.5`

            Maximum fee in UI units.

          - **`transferFeeConfigAuthority`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

            Authority to configure transfer fees.

          - **`withdrawWithheldAuthority`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

            Authority to withdraw withheld fees.

        - **`interestBearing`** · `object`

          Interest-bearing configuration.

          - **`rate`** · `number` · required · example `2.5`

            Interest rate in percent.

          - **`rateAuthority`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

            Authority that can update the rate.

        - **`permanentDelegate`** · `string` · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

          Permanent delegate address.

        - **`pausable`** · `object`

          Pausable configuration.

          - **`authority`** · `string` · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

            Authority that can pause/resume transfers.

        - **`nonTransferable`** · `boolean` · example `false`

          Mark token as non-transferable.

        - **`defaultAccountState`** · `string` · one of `initialized`, `frozen` · example `initialized`

          Default account state.

        - **`scaledUiAmount`** · `object`

          Scaled UI amount configuration.

          - **`authority`** · `string` · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

            Authority that can update scaled UI parameters.

          - **`multiplier`** · `number` · required · example `1`

            Current UI multiplier.

          - **`newMultiplier`** · `number` · required · example `2`

            Scheduled multiplier.

          - **`newMultiplierEffectiveTimestamp`** · `integer` · required · example `1735689600`

            Unix timestamp (seconds) when the new multiplier takes effect.

        - **`transferHook`** · `object`

          Transfer hook configuration.

          - **`programId`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

            Transfer hook program id.

          - **`authority`** · `string` · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

            Authority that can update the transfer hook program.

      - **`totalSupply`** · `string` · required · example `1000000`

        Cached total supply in UI units (stored to avoid frequent RPC reads). Use POST /v1/issuance/tokens/\{tokenId\}/supply/refresh to force an on-chain refresh.

      - **`totalSupplyUpdatedAt`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `null`

        Timestamp when supply was last refreshed.

      - **`maxSupply`** · `string | null` · required · example `10000000`

        Maximum supply in UI units, if capped.

      - **`isMintable`** · `boolean` · required · example `true`

        Whether additional minting is allowed.

      - **`isFreezable`** · `boolean` · required · example `true`

        Whether freeze authority is enabled.

      - **`requiresAllowlist`** · `boolean` · required · example `false`

        Whether transfers require allowlist approval.

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `pending`, `active`, `paused`, `revoked` · example `active`

        Token lifecycle status.

      - **`deployedAt`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-05T00:00:00.000Z`

        Deployment timestamp, if deployed.

      - **`createdBy`** · `string` · required · example `key_example`

        Actor identifier that created the token.

      - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        Creation timestamp.

      - **`updatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-02T00:00:00.000Z`

        Last update timestamp.

    - **`allowlistAuthority`** · `string | null` · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

      Live on-chain list authority. Returned only by GET token with includeAllowlistAuthority=true; null when no on-chain list is configured. This is not the token freeze authority or a signer authorization.

    - **`freezeAuthority`** · `string | null` · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

      Live freeze-operation authority. Returned only by GET token with includeFreezeAuthority=true. For Token ACL mints this is the mint-config controller rather than the mint's program PDA freeze authority.

    - **`metadataAuthority`** · `string | null` · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

      Metadata authority, returned only by GET token with includeMetadataAuthority=true. Read live on-chain when the token has a mint; otherwise the stored metadata authority or stored mint authority. Null when unavailable. RPC failure returns 502 without falling back to stored authority. This read does not authorize signing or change the token.

    - **`pauseAuthority`** · `string | null` · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

      Live on-chain pausable authority. Returned only by GET token with includePauseAuthority=true; null when the mint has no pausable authority.

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `issuance.read` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`404`** Not Found

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`502`** Bad Gateway

  Same fields as `400`.

## Example request

## Issuance: Activity

### List issuance transactions
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/issuance/list-issuance-transactions

> Lists issuance transactions across tokens for the current organization or project.

`GET /v1/issuance/transactions`

Use repeated type query parameters, for example type=burn&type=force_burn, to request multiple transaction types. custodyWalletId and walletId cannot be combined.

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `issuance.read` action.

## Query parameters

- **`custodyWalletId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `cwlt_example`

  Filter to transactions where this exact SDP wallet's address participated. This is participant history, not a signer-only filter.

- **`walletId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `privy_wallet_123`

  Legacy Provider wallet ID filter. Cannot be combined with custodyWalletId.

- **`type`** · `string[]` · each one of `mint`, `burn`, `freeze`, `unfreeze`, `seize`, `force_burn`, `update_authority`, `pause`, `unpause`, `deploy` · each example `burn`

  Filter by transaction type. Repeat this query parameter for multiple values, for example type=burn&type=force_burn.

- **`status`** · `string` · one of `pending`, `processing`, `confirmed`, `finalized`, `failed` · example `confirmed`

  Filter by token transaction status.

- **`page`** · `integer` · greater than 0 · example `1`

  Page number (1-based).

- **`pageSize`** · `integer` · greater than 0 · example `50`

  Number of items per page.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Selects the active project for this request. Required for Clerk (dashboard) callers. Ignored when authenticating with an API key, whose scope is fixed to the key's project.

## Responses

- **`200`** Issuance transaction list

  - **`data`** · `object[]` · required

    - **`token`** · `object` · required

      Token metadata for this transaction.

      - **`id`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `tok_example`

        Token identifier.

      - **`name`** · `string` · required · example `Example Token`

        Token name.

      - **`symbol`** · `string` · required · example `EXM`

        Token symbol.

      - **`mintAddress`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `null`

        Mint address once deployed.

    - **`transaction`** · `object` · required

      Token transaction record.

      - **`id`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `ttx_example`

        Token transaction identifier.

      - **`tokenId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `tok_example`

        Token identifier.

      - **`organizationId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `org_example`

        Organization identifier.

      - **`type`** · `string` · required · one of `mint`, `burn`, `freeze`, `unfreeze`, `seize`, `force_burn`, `update_authority`, `pause`, `unpause`, `deploy` · example `mint`

        Transaction type.

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `pending`, `processing`, `confirmed`, `finalized`, `failed` · example `confirmed`

        Transaction status.

      - **`signature`** · `string | null` · required · example `sig_example`

        Solana transaction signature.

      - **`idempotencyKey`** · `string` · example `idem_example_12345`

        Idempotency key used for this request.

      - **`idempotencyFingerprint`** · `string` · example `4f2d9c7a5e6f1c...`

        Request fingerprint used to validate idempotent retries.

      - **`serializedTx`** · `string | null` · required · min length 1 · example `AQID`

        Base64-encoded transaction payload, if available.

      - **`params`** · `object` · required

        Operation parameters captured for audit.

        - **`*`** · `any`

      - **`slot`** · `integer | null` · required · example `123456`

        Slot number, if confirmed.

      - **`blockTime`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        Block time, if confirmed.

      - **`fee`** · `integer | null` · required · example `5000`

        Transaction fee in lamports.

      - **`error`** · `string | null` · required · example `Signature failed`

        Error message if the transaction failed.

      - **`initiatedByKeyId`** · `string | null` · required · min length 1 · example `key_example`

        API key that initiated the transaction.

      - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        Creation timestamp.

      - **`updatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-02T00:00:00.000Z`

        Last update timestamp.

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Pagination metadata.

    - **`total`** · `integer` · required · min 0

      Total items.

    - **`page`** · `integer` · required · greater than 0

      Current page number.

    - **`pageSize`** · `integer` · required · greater than 0

      Items per page.

    - **`hasMore`** · `boolean` · required

      Whether more pages exist.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `issuance.read` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`404`** Not Found

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `400`.

## Example request

### List token transactions
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/issuance/list-token-transactions

> Lists token transactions for an issued token.

`GET /v1/issuance/tokens/{tokenId}/transactions`

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `issuance.read` action.

## Path parameters

- **`tokenId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `tok_example`

  Token identifier.

## Query parameters

- **`type`** · `string` · one of `mint`, `burn`, `freeze`, `unfreeze`, `seize`, `force_burn`, `update_authority`, `pause`, `unpause`, `deploy` · example `burn`

  Filter by token transaction type.

- **`status`** · `string` · one of `pending`, `processing`, `confirmed`, `finalized`, `failed` · example `confirmed`

  Filter by token transaction status.

- **`page`** · `integer` · greater than 0 · example `1`

  Page number (1-based).

- **`pageSize`** · `integer` · greater than 0 · example `50`

  Number of items per page.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Selects the active project for this request. Required for Clerk (dashboard) callers. Ignored when authenticating with an API key, whose scope is fixed to the key's project.

## Responses

- **`200`** Token transactions

  - **`data`** · `object[]` · required

    - **`id`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `ttx_example`

      Token transaction identifier.

    - **`tokenId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `tok_example`

      Token identifier.

    - **`organizationId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `org_example`

      Organization identifier.

    - **`type`** · `string` · required · one of `mint`, `burn`, `freeze`, `unfreeze`, `seize`, `force_burn`, `update_authority`, `pause`, `unpause`, `deploy` · example `mint`

      Transaction type.

    - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `pending`, `processing`, `confirmed`, `finalized`, `failed` · example `confirmed`

      Transaction status.

    - **`signature`** · `string | null` · required · example `sig_example`

      Solana transaction signature.

    - **`idempotencyKey`** · `string` · example `idem_example_12345`

      Idempotency key used for this request.

    - **`idempotencyFingerprint`** · `string` · example `4f2d9c7a5e6f1c...`

      Request fingerprint used to validate idempotent retries.

    - **`serializedTx`** · `string | null` · required · min length 1 · example `AQID`

      Base64-encoded transaction payload, if available.

    - **`params`** · `object` · required

      Operation parameters captured for audit.

      - **`*`** · `any`

    - **`slot`** · `integer | null` · required · example `123456`

      Slot number, if confirmed.

    - **`blockTime`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      Block time, if confirmed.

    - **`fee`** · `integer | null` · required · example `5000`

      Transaction fee in lamports.

    - **`error`** · `string | null` · required · example `Signature failed`

      Error message if the transaction failed.

    - **`initiatedByKeyId`** · `string | null` · required · min length 1 · example `key_example`

      API key that initiated the transaction.

    - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      Creation timestamp.

    - **`updatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-02T00:00:00.000Z`

      Last update timestamp.

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Pagination metadata.

    - **`total`** · `integer` · required · min 0

      Total items.

    - **`page`** · `integer` · required · greater than 0

      Current page number.

    - **`pageSize`** · `integer` · required · greater than 0

      Items per page.

    - **`hasMore`** · `boolean` · required

      Whether more pages exist.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `issuance.read` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`404`** Not Found

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `400`.

## Example request

```bash tab="cURL"
curl 'https://api.solana.com/v1/issuance/tokens/tok_example/transactions' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SDP_API_KEY"
```

```ts tab="TypeScript"

  method: "GET",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.SDP_API_KEY}`
  }
});
```

```python tab="Python"

  headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['SDP_API_KEY']}"})
```

### Get asset audit history
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/issuance/get-asset-audit-history

> Returns the aggregated audit history for an issued token: events logged against the token and its child resources (transactions, allowlist entries, frozen accounts), newest first.

`GET /v1/issuance/tokens/{tokenId}/audit`

Supports filtering by action type.

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `issuance.read` action.

## Path parameters

- **`tokenId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `tok_example`

  Token identifier.

## Query parameters

- **`action`** · `string`

  Filter by audit action.

- **`page`** · `integer` · greater than 0 · example `1`

  Page number (1-based).

- **`pageSize`** · `integer` · greater than 0 · example `50`

  Number of items per page.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Selects the active project for this request. Required for Clerk (dashboard) callers. Ignored when authenticating with an API key, whose scope is fixed to the key's project.

## Responses

- **`200`** Asset audit history

  - **`data`** · `object[]` · required

    - **`id`** · `string` · required

    - **`action`** · `string` · required · example `freeze`

    - **`resourceType`** · `string` · required · example `frozen_account`

    - **`resourceId`** · `string | null` · required

    - **`actorType`** · `string` · required · one of `user`, `api_key`, `system` · example `user`

    - **`actorLabel`** · `string` · required · example `Jordan Lee`

    - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `success`, `failure` · example `success`

    - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · example `2026-07-19T12:00:00.000Z`

    - **`metadata`** · `object | null` · required

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Pagination metadata.

    - **`total`** · `integer` · required · min 0

      Total items.

    - **`page`** · `integer` · required · greater than 0

      Current page number.

    - **`pageSize`** · `integer` · required · greater than 0

      Items per page.

    - **`hasMore`** · `boolean` · required

      Whether more pages exist.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.
