## Issuance: Deploy

### Deploy token
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/issuance/deploy-token

> Deploys the token to Solana using custody signing.

`POST /v1/issuance/tokens/{tokenId}/deploy`

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `issuance.execute` action.

## Path parameters

- **`tokenId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `tok_example`

  Token identifier.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Selects the active project for this request. Required for Clerk (dashboard) callers. Ignored when authenticating with an API key, whose scope is fixed to the key's project.

- **`Idempotency-Key`** · `string` · pattern `^[\x20-\x7e]{1,255}$` · example `idempotency_example_12345`

  Idempotency key for safely retrying mutating requests. 1-255 printable ASCII characters; echoed back on the response.

## Request body

`application/json`

Direct token deployment request body.

- **`signingCustodyWalletId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `cwlt_example`

  Optional exact SDP Wallet ID. Overrides the wallet selected on the pending draft for this direct deployment.

- **`authorityCustodyWalletIds`** · `object`

  Optional exact SDP Wallet IDs for initial metadata, freeze, and permanent-delegate authorities. Omitted roles retain their template defaults. The deployment wallet holds mint authority. Freeze and permanentDelegate require the corresponding token capability. Each selected wallet must be in scope with tokens:write permission; the metadata wallet signs any metadata URI follow-up.

  - **`metadata`** · `string` · min length 1

  - **`freeze`** · `string` · min length 1

  - **`permanentDelegate`** · `string` · min length 1

- **`feePayment`** · `string` · one of `sponsored`, `wallet` · default `sponsored` · example `sponsored`

  How the deployment transaction fee is paid.

## Responses

- **`200`** Token deployed

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    Token response payload.

    - **`token`** · `object` · required

      Token details.

      - **`id`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `tok_example`

        Token identifier.

      - **`projectId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

        Project identifier.

      - **`organizationId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `org_example`

        Organization identifier.

      - **`signingCustodyWalletId`** · `string | null` · required · min length 1 · example `cwlt_example`

        Exact deployment wallet selected for a pending token, or historical deployment attribution after deployment. This is not the current signer for later authority operations.

      - **`mintAddress`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Mint address once deployed.

      - **`mintAuthority`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Mint authority address, if set.

      - **`freezeAuthority`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Freeze authority address, if set.

      - **`ablListAddress`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        On-chain allowlist/blocklist address, if enabled.

      - **`name`** · `string` · required · example `Example Token`

        Token name.

      - **`symbol`** · `string` · required · example `EXM`

        Token symbol.

      - **`decimals`** · `integer` · required · example `9`

        Token decimals.

      - **`description`** · `string | null` · required · example `Example token description.`

        Token description.

      - **`uri`** · `string | null` · required · example `https://example.com/metadata.json`

        Metadata URI passed to on-chain token metadata (points to off-chain JSON).

      - **`imageUrl`** · `string | null` · required · example `https://example.com/token.png`

        Token image URL.

      - **`template`** · `string` · required · one of `stablecoin`, `arcade`, `tokenized-security`, `custom`, `rwa` · example `stablecoin`

        Token template identifier.

      - **`extensions`** · `object | null` · required

        Token-2022 extensions configuration.

        - **`transferFee`** · `object`

          Transfer fee configuration.

          - **`basisPoints`** · `integer` · required · min 0 · max 10000 · example `25`

            Transfer fee in basis points (0-10000).

          - **`maxFee`** · `string` · required · example `0.5`

            Maximum fee in UI units.

          - **`transferFeeConfigAuthority`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

            Authority to configure transfer fees.

          - **`withdrawWithheldAuthority`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

            Authority to withdraw withheld fees.

        - **`interestBearing`** · `object`

          Interest-bearing configuration.

          - **`rate`** · `number` · required · example `2.5`

            Interest rate in percent.

          - **`rateAuthority`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

            Authority that can update the rate.

        - **`permanentDelegate`** · `string` · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

          Permanent delegate address.

        - **`pausable`** · `object`

          Pausable configuration.

          - **`authority`** · `string` · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

            Authority that can pause/resume transfers.

        - **`nonTransferable`** · `boolean` · example `false`

          Mark token as non-transferable.

        - **`defaultAccountState`** · `string` · one of `initialized`, `frozen` · example `initialized`

          Default account state.

        - **`scaledUiAmount`** · `object`

          Scaled UI amount configuration.

          - **`authority`** · `string` · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

            Authority that can update scaled UI parameters.

          - **`multiplier`** · `number` · required · example `1`

            Current UI multiplier.

          - **`newMultiplier`** · `number` · required · example `2`

            Scheduled multiplier.

          - **`newMultiplierEffectiveTimestamp`** · `integer` · required · example `1735689600`

            Unix timestamp (seconds) when the new multiplier takes effect.

        - **`transferHook`** · `object`

          Transfer hook configuration.

          - **`programId`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

            Transfer hook program id.

          - **`authority`** · `string` · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

            Authority that can update the transfer hook program.

      - **`totalSupply`** · `string` · required · example `1000000`

        Cached total supply in UI units (stored to avoid frequent RPC reads). Use POST /v1/issuance/tokens/\{tokenId\}/supply/refresh to force an on-chain refresh.

      - **`totalSupplyUpdatedAt`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `null`

        Timestamp when supply was last refreshed.

      - **`maxSupply`** · `string | null` · required · example `10000000`

        Maximum supply in UI units, if capped.

      - **`isMintable`** · `boolean` · required · example `true`

        Whether additional minting is allowed.

      - **`isFreezable`** · `boolean` · required · example `true`

        Whether freeze authority is enabled.

      - **`requiresAllowlist`** · `boolean` · required · example `false`

        Whether transfers require allowlist approval.

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `pending`, `active`, `paused`, `revoked` · example `active`

        Token lifecycle status.

      - **`deployedAt`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-05T00:00:00.000Z`

        Deployment timestamp, if deployed.

      - **`createdBy`** · `string` · required · example `key_example`

        Actor identifier that created the token.

      - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        Creation timestamp.

      - **`updatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-02T00:00:00.000Z`

        Last update timestamp.

    - **`allowlistAuthority`** · `string | null` · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

      Live on-chain list authority. Returned only by GET token with includeAllowlistAuthority=true; null when no on-chain list is configured. This is not the token freeze authority or a signer authorization.

    - **`freezeAuthority`** · `string | null` · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

      Live freeze-operation authority. Returned only by GET token with includeFreezeAuthority=true. For Token ACL mints this is the mint-config controller rather than the mint's program PDA freeze authority.

    - **`metadataAuthority`** · `string | null` · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

      Metadata authority, returned only by GET token with includeMetadataAuthority=true. Read live on-chain when the token has a mint; otherwise the stored metadata authority or stored mint authority. Null when unavailable. RPC failure returns 502 without falling back to stored authority. This read does not authorize signing or change the token.

    - **`pauseAuthority`** · `string | null` · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

      Live on-chain pausable authority. Returned only by GET token with includePauseAuthority=true; null when the mint has no pausable authority.

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `issuance.execute` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`404`** Not Found

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`409`** Conflict

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`422`** Unprocessable Entity

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`502`** Bad Gateway

  Same fields as `400`.

## Example request

```bash tab="cURL"
curl -X POST 'https://api.solana.com/v1/issuance/tokens/tok_example/deploy' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SDP_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "signingCustodyWalletId": "cwlt_example",
    "authorityCustodyWalletIds": {
      "metadata": "cwlt_metadata",
      "freeze": "cwlt_freeze",
      "permanentDelegate": "cwlt_recovery"
    },
    "feePayment": "sponsored"
  }'
```

```ts tab="TypeScript"
const res = await fetch("https://api.solana.com/v1/issuance/tokens/tok_example/deploy", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.SDP_API_KEY}`,
    "Idempotency-Key": crypto.randomUUID(),
    "Content-Type": "application/json"
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({
    "signingCustodyWalletId": "cwlt_example",
    "authorityCustodyWalletIds": {
      "metadata": "cwlt_metadata",
      "freeze": "cwlt_freeze",
      "permanentDelegate": "cwlt_recovery"
    },
    "feePayment": "sponsored"
  })
});
```

```python tab="Python"
import os, requests, uuid

r = requests.post("https://api.solana.com/v1/issuance/tokens/tok_example/deploy",
  headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['SDP_API_KEY']}", "Idempotency-Key": str(uuid.uuid4())},
  json={
    "signingCustodyWalletId": "cwlt_example",
    "authorityCustodyWalletIds": {
      "metadata": "cwlt_metadata",
      "freeze": "cwlt_freeze",
      "permanentDelegate": "cwlt_recovery"
    },
    "feePayment": "sponsored"
  })
```

### Prepare token deploy transaction
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/issuance/prepare-deploy-token

> Builds an unsigned deploy transaction for client-side signing.

`POST /v1/issuance/tokens/{tokenId}/deploy/prepare`

A signing wallet is required: the body's `signingWalletId`, else the token's `signingWalletId`. The request is rejected with 400 when neither is set; an API key is never asked for a default wallet. The resolved wallet is pinned on the token for deploy/confirm and prepare-metadata.

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `issuance.execute` action.

## Path parameters

- **`tokenId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `tok_example`

  Token identifier.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Selects the active project for this request. Required for Clerk (dashboard) callers. Ignored when authenticating with an API key, whose scope is fixed to the key's project.

## Responses

- **`200`** Prepared deploy transaction

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    Prepare deploy response payload.

    - **`transaction`** · `object` · required

      Prepared transaction for deploying the token.

      - **`serialized`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `AQID`

        Base64-encoded unsigned transaction.

      - **`blockhash`** · `string` · required · example `blockhash_example`

        Blockhash for the transaction.

      - **`lastValidBlockHeight`** · `string` · required · example `123456`

        Last valid block height.

    - **`mint`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

      Mint address that will be created.

    - **`listAddress`** · `string` · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

      On-chain ABL list-config address, present only for allowlist/blocklist tokens with on-chain access control enabled.

    - **`metadataUriFollowUp`** · `object`

      Present when the inline metadata URI overflowed the create transaction's packet limit. The create tx was prepared with an empty URI; after confirming the deploy, the client must call POST /deploy/prepare-metadata and submit the returned follow-up transaction to set this URI on-chain.

      - **`required`** · `boolean` · required · always `true`

      - **`uri`** · `string` · required · format `uri`

    - **`simulation`** · `object`

      Optional transaction simulation results.

      - **`success`** · `boolean` · required · example `true`

        Simulation success flag.

      - **`logs`** · `string[]` · required

        Simulation logs, if any.

      - **`unitsConsumed`** · `number | string | null` · required · example `20000`

        Compute units consumed.

        Any of:

        - **number**

        - **string**

      - **`error`** · `string | null` · required · example `Insufficient funds`

        Simulation error, if any.

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `issuance.execute` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`404`** Not Found

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`409`** Conflict

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`502`** Bad Gateway

  Same fields as `400`.

## Example request

```bash tab="cURL"
curl -X POST 'https://api.solana.com/v1/issuance/tokens/tok_example/deploy/prepare' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SDP_API_KEY"
```

```ts tab="TypeScript"
const res = await fetch("https://api.solana.com/v1/issuance/tokens/tok_example/deploy/prepare", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.SDP_API_KEY}`
  }
});
```

```python tab="Python"
import os, requests

r = requests.post("https://api.solana.com/v1/issuance/tokens/tok_example/deploy/prepare",
  headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['SDP_API_KEY']}"})
```

### Confirm non-custodial deploy
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/issuance/confirm-deploy

> Records the mint after the client signs and submits a prepared (non-custodial) deploy transaction.

`POST /v1/issuance/tokens/{tokenId}/deploy/confirm`

Verifies the transaction landed on-chain, then marks the token deployed.

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `issuance.execute` action.

## Path parameters

- **`tokenId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `tok_example`

  Token identifier.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Selects the active project for this request. Required for Clerk (dashboard) callers. Ignored when authenticating with an API key, whose scope is fixed to the key's project.

## Request body

`application/json` · required

Confirm non-custodial deploy request body.

- **`signature`** · `string` · required · example `5x...signature`

  Signature of the confirmed create transaction the client submitted.

- **`mint`** · `string` · required · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

  Mint address returned by deploy/prepare and created by the submitted tx.

- **`listAddress`** · `string` · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

  Accepted for backward compatibility but ignored: the server re-derives the ABL list-config PDA deterministically from the mint authority and mint.

- **`signingWalletId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `privy_wallet_123`

  Accepted for backward compatibility but ignored: the server uses the signing wallet pinned during deploy/prepare, so the authority can't be changed at confirm time.

## Responses

- **`200`** Token deployed

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    Token response payload.

    - **`token`** · `object` · required

      Token details.

      - **`id`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `tok_example`

        Token identifier.

      - **`projectId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

        Project identifier.

      - **`organizationId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `org_example`

        Organization identifier.

      - **`signingCustodyWalletId`** · `string | null` · required · min length 1 · example `cwlt_example`

        Exact deployment wallet selected for a pending token, or historical deployment attribution after deployment. This is not the current signer for later authority operations.

      - **`mintAddress`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Mint address once deployed.

      - **`mintAuthority`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Mint authority address, if set.

      - **`freezeAuthority`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Freeze authority address, if set.

      - **`ablListAddress`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        On-chain allowlist/blocklist address, if enabled.

      - **`name`** · `string` · required · example `Example Token`

        Token name.

      - **`symbol`** · `string` · required · example `EXM`

        Token symbol.

      - **`decimals`** · `integer` · required · example `9`

        Token decimals.

      - **`description`** · `string | null` · required · example `Example token description.`

        Token description.

      - **`uri`** · `string | null` · required · example `https://example.com/metadata.json`

        Metadata URI passed to on-chain token metadata (points to off-chain JSON).

      - **`imageUrl`** · `string | null` · required · example `https://example.com/token.png`

        Token image URL.

      - **`template`** · `string` · required · one of `stablecoin`, `arcade`, `tokenized-security`, `custom`, `rwa` · example `stablecoin`

        Token template identifier.

      - **`extensions`** · `object | null` · required

        Token-2022 extensions configuration.

        - **`transferFee`** · `object`

          Transfer fee configuration.

          - **`basisPoints`** · `integer` · required · min 0 · max 10000 · example `25`

            Transfer fee in basis points (0-10000).

          - **`maxFee`** · `string` · required · example `0.5`

            Maximum fee in UI units.

          - **`transferFeeConfigAuthority`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

            Authority to configure transfer fees.

          - **`withdrawWithheldAuthority`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

            Authority to withdraw withheld fees.

        - **`interestBearing`** · `object`

          Interest-bearing configuration.

          - **`rate`** · `number` · required · example `2.5`

            Interest rate in percent.

          - **`rateAuthority`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

            Authority that can update the rate.

        - **`permanentDelegate`** · `string` · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

          Permanent delegate address.

        - **`pausable`** · `object`

          Pausable configuration.

          - **`authority`** · `string` · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

            Authority that can pause/resume transfers.

        - **`nonTransferable`** · `boolean` · example `false`

          Mark token as non-transferable.

        - **`defaultAccountState`** · `string` · one of `initialized`, `frozen` · example `initialized`

          Default account state.

        - **`scaledUiAmount`** · `object`

          Scaled UI amount configuration.

          - **`authority`** · `string` · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

            Authority that can update scaled UI parameters.

          - **`multiplier`** · `number` · required · example `1`

            Current UI multiplier.

          - **`newMultiplier`** · `number` · required · example `2`

            Scheduled multiplier.

          - **`newMultiplierEffectiveTimestamp`** · `integer` · required · example `1735689600`

            Unix timestamp (seconds) when the new multiplier takes effect.

        - **`transferHook`** · `object`

          Transfer hook configuration.

          - **`programId`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

            Transfer hook program id.

          - **`authority`** · `string` · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

            Authority that can update the transfer hook program.

      - **`totalSupply`** · `string` · required · example `1000000`

        Cached total supply in UI units (stored to avoid frequent RPC reads). Use POST /v1/issuance/tokens/\{tokenId\}/supply/refresh to force an on-chain refresh.

      - **`totalSupplyUpdatedAt`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `null`

        Timestamp when supply was last refreshed.

      - **`maxSupply`** · `string | null` · required · example `10000000`

        Maximum supply in UI units, if capped.

      - **`isMintable`** · `boolean` · required · example `true`

        Whether additional minting is allowed.

      - **`isFreezable`** · `boolean` · required · example `true`

        Whether freeze authority is enabled.

      - **`requiresAllowlist`** · `boolean` · required · example `false`

        Whether transfers require allowlist approval.

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `pending`, `active`, `paused`, `revoked` · example `active`

        Token lifecycle status.

      - **`deployedAt`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-05T00:00:00.000Z`

        Deployment timestamp, if deployed.

      - **`createdBy`** · `string` · required · example `key_example`

        Actor identifier that created the token.

      - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        Creation timestamp.

      - **`updatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-02T00:00:00.000Z`

        Last update timestamp.

    - **`allowlistAuthority`** · `string | null` · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

      Live on-chain list authority. Returned only by GET token with includeAllowlistAuthority=true; null when no on-chain list is configured. This is not the token freeze authority or a signer authorization.

    - **`freezeAuthority`** · `string | null` · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

      Live freeze-operation authority. Returned only by GET token with includeFreezeAuthority=true. For Token ACL mints this is the mint-config controller rather than the mint's program PDA freeze authority.

    - **`metadataAuthority`** · `string | null` · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

      Metadata authority, returned only by GET token with includeMetadataAuthority=true. Read live on-chain when the token has a mint; otherwise the stored metadata authority or stored mint authority. Null when unavailable. RPC failure returns 502 without falling back to stored authority. This read does not authorize signing or change the token.

    - **`pauseAuthority`** · `string | null` · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

      Live on-chain pausable authority. Returned only by GET token with includePauseAuthority=true; null when the mint has no pausable authority.

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `issuance.execute` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`404`** Not Found

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`409`** Conflict

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`422`** Unprocessable Entity

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`502`** Bad Gateway

  Same fields as `400`.

### Prepare metadata-URI follow-up transaction
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/issuance/prepare-deploy-metadata

> Follow-up step for the non-custodial deploy flow.

`POST /v1/issuance/tokens/{tokenId}/deploy/prepare-metadata`

When prepareDeploy returns `metadataUriFollowUp.required` (the inline URI overflowed the create transaction), the client calls this after deploy/confirm to fetch an unsigned transaction that sets the metadata URI on-chain. Signs with the wallet pinned on the token at deploy/prepare (a body `signingWalletId` is ignored); the request is rejected with 400 when the token has none. Returns a null transaction when the on-chain URI already matches.

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `issuance.execute` action.

## Path parameters

- **`tokenId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `tok_example`

  Token identifier.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Selects the active project for this request. Required for Clerk (dashboard) callers. Ignored when authenticating with an API key, whose scope is fixed to the key's project.

## Responses

- **`200`** Prepared metadata-URI follow-up transaction (or no-op)

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    Prepare deploy-metadata follow-up response payload.

    - **`transaction`** · `object | null` · required

      Prepared metadata-URI update transaction for client signing, or null when the on-chain URI already matches (nothing to sign).

      - **`serialized`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `AQID`

        Base64-encoded unsigned transaction.

      - **`blockhash`** · `string` · required · example `blockhash_example`

        Blockhash for the transaction.

      - **`lastValidBlockHeight`** · `string` · required · example `123456`

        Last valid block height.

    - **`uri`** · `string` · required · format `uri` · example `https://api.example.com/v1/issuance/tokens/tok_123/metadata.json`

      The metadata URI the follow-up transaction sets on-chain.

    - **`simulation`** · `object`

      Optional transaction simulation results.

      - **`success`** · `boolean` · required · example `true`

        Simulation success flag.

      - **`logs`** · `string[]` · required

        Simulation logs, if any.

      - **`unitsConsumed`** · `number | string | null` · required · example `20000`

        Compute units consumed.

        Any of:

        - **number**

        - **string**

      - **`error`** · `string | null` · required · example `Insufficient funds`

        Simulation error, if any.

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `issuance.execute` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`404`** Not Found

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`409`** Conflict

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`502`** Bad Gateway

  Same fields as `400`.

## Example request

```bash tab="cURL"
curl -X POST 'https://api.solana.com/v1/issuance/tokens/tok_example/deploy/prepare-metadata' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SDP_API_KEY"
```

```ts tab="TypeScript"
const res = await fetch("https://api.solana.com/v1/issuance/tokens/tok_example/deploy/prepare-metadata", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.SDP_API_KEY}`
  }
});
```

```python tab="Python"
import os, requests

r = requests.post("https://api.solana.com/v1/issuance/tokens/tok_example/deploy/prepare-metadata",
  headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['SDP_API_KEY']}"})
```

## Issuance: Mint and burn

### Prepare mint transaction
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/issuance/prepare-mint

> Builds an unsigned mint transaction for client-side signing.

`POST /v1/issuance/tokens/{tokenId}/mint/prepare`

The authority wallet is the fee payer: it signs the transaction and pays the network fee and the rent for a new destination token account; SDP does not sponsor prepared transactions.

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `issuance.execute` action.

## Path parameters

- **`tokenId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `tok_example`

  Token identifier.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Selects the active project for this request. Required for Clerk (dashboard) callers. Ignored when authenticating with an API key, whose scope is fixed to the key's project.

## Request body

`application/json` · required

Mint request body.

- **`signingCustodyWalletId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `cwlt_example`

  Optional exact SDP Wallet ID. When supplied, it must control the current mint authority.

- **`mint`** · `object` · required

  Mint operation details.

  - **`destination`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

    Destination wallet address to receive minted tokens.

  - **`amount`** · `string` · required · example `1000`

    Token amount in UI units (decimal string). Human-readable value such as "1" or "1.5". SDP converts to on-chain base units using the token's decimals field.

  - **`memo`** · `string` · max length 100 · example `Payout`

    Optional on-chain memo.

- **`options`** · `object`

  Mint execution options.

  - **`priorityFee`** · `string | integer`

    Any of:

    - **string** · one of `none`, `low`, `medium`, `high`

    - **integer** · min 0

  - **`simulate`** · `boolean`

## Responses

- **`200`** Prepared mint

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    Prepare mint response payload.

    - **`transaction`** · `object` · required

      Mint transaction record.

      - **`id`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `ttx_example`

        Token transaction identifier.

      - **`tokenId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `tok_example`

        Token identifier.

      - **`organizationId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `org_example`

        Organization identifier.

      - **`type`** · `string` · required · one of `mint`, `burn`, `freeze`, `unfreeze`, `seize`, `force_burn`, `update_authority`, `pause`, `unpause`, `deploy` · example `mint`

        Transaction type.

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `pending`, `processing`, `confirmed`, `finalized`, `failed` · example `confirmed`

        Transaction status.

      - **`signature`** · `string | null` · required · example `sig_example`

        Solana transaction signature.

      - **`idempotencyKey`** · `string` · example `idem_example_12345`

        Idempotency key used for this request.

      - **`idempotencyFingerprint`** · `string` · example `4f2d9c7a5e6f1c...`

        Request fingerprint used to validate idempotent retries.

      - **`serializedTx`** · `string | null` · required · min length 1 · example `AQID`

        Base64-encoded transaction payload, if available.

      - **`params`** · `object` · required

        Operation parameters captured for audit.

        - **`*`** · `any`

      - **`slot`** · `integer | null` · required · example `123456`

        Slot number, if confirmed.

      - **`blockTime`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        Block time, if confirmed.

      - **`fee`** · `integer | null` · required · example `5000`

        Transaction fee in lamports.

      - **`error`** · `string | null` · required · example `Signature failed`

        Error message if the transaction failed.

      - **`initiatedByKeyId`** · `string | null` · required · min length 1 · example `key_example`

        API key that initiated the transaction.

      - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        Creation timestamp.

      - **`updatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-02T00:00:00.000Z`

        Last update timestamp.

    - **`preparedTransaction`** · `object` · required

      Prepared transaction for minting.

      - **`serialized`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `AQID`

        Base64-encoded unsigned transaction.

      - **`blockhash`** · `string` · required · example `blockhash_example`

        Blockhash for the transaction.

      - **`lastValidBlockHeight`** · `string` · required · example `123456`

        Last valid block height.

    - **`tokenAccount`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

      Destination token account address.

    - **`simulation`** · `object`

      Optional transaction simulation results.

      - **`success`** · `boolean` · required · example `true`

        Simulation success flag.

      - **`logs`** · `string[]` · required

        Simulation logs, if any.

      - **`unitsConsumed`** · `number | string | null` · required · example `20000`

        Compute units consumed.

        Any of:

        - **number**

        - **string**

      - **`error`** · `string | null` · required · example `Insufficient funds`

        Simulation error, if any.

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `issuance.execute` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`404`** Not Found

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`409`** Conflict

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `400`.

## Example request

```bash tab="cURL"
curl -X POST 'https://api.solana.com/v1/issuance/tokens/tok_example/mint/prepare' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SDP_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "signingCustodyWalletId": "cwlt_example",
    "mint": {
      "destination": "So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112",
      "amount": "1000",
      "memo": "Payout"
    },
    "options": {
      "priorityFee": "low",
      "simulate": true
    }
  }'
```

```ts tab="TypeScript"
    "Content-Type": "application/json"
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({
    "signingCustodyWalletId": "cwlt_example",
    "mint": {
      "destination": "So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112",
      "amount": "1000",
      "memo": "Payout"
    },
    "options": {
      "priorityFee": "low",
      "simulate": true
    }
  })
});
```

```python tab="Python"

r = requests.post("https://api.solana.com/v1/issuance/tokens/tok_example/mint/prepare",
  headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['SDP_API_KEY']}"},
  json={
    "signingCustodyWalletId": "cwlt_example",
    "mint": {
      "destination": "So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112",
      "amount": "1000",
      "memo": "Payout"
    },
    "options": {
      "priorityFee": "low",
      "simulate": True
    }
  })
```

### Execute mint
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/issuance/execute-mint

> Mints tokens using custody signing and submission.

`POST /v1/issuance/tokens/{tokenId}/mint`

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `issuance.execute` action.

## Path parameters

- **`tokenId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `tok_example`

  Token identifier.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Selects the active project for this request. Required for Clerk (dashboard) callers. Ignored when authenticating with an API key, whose scope is fixed to the key's project.

- **`Idempotency-Key`** · `string` · pattern `^[\x20-\x7e]{1,255}$` · example `idempotency_example_12345`

  Idempotency key for safely retrying mutating requests. 1-255 printable ASCII characters; echoed back on the response.

## Request body

`application/json` · required

Mint request body.

- **`signingCustodyWalletId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `cwlt_example`

  Optional exact SDP Wallet ID. When supplied, it must control the current mint authority.

- **`mint`** · `object` · required

  Mint operation details.

  - **`destination`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

    Destination wallet address to receive minted tokens.

  - **`amount`** · `string` · required · example `1000`

    Token amount in UI units (decimal string). Human-readable value such as "1" or "1.5". SDP converts to on-chain base units using the token's decimals field.

  - **`memo`** · `string` · max length 100 · example `Payout`

    Optional on-chain memo.

- **`options`** · `object`

  Mint execution options.

  - **`priorityFee`** · `string | integer`

    Any of:

    - **string** · one of `none`, `low`, `medium`, `high`

    - **integer** · min 0

  - **`simulate`** · `boolean`

## Responses

- **`200`** Mint executed

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    Execute mint response payload.

    - **`transaction`** · `object` · required

      Mint transaction record.

      - **`id`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `ttx_example`

        Token transaction identifier.

      - **`tokenId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `tok_example`

        Token identifier.

      - **`organizationId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `org_example`

        Organization identifier.

      - **`type`** · `string` · required · one of `mint`, `burn`, `freeze`, `unfreeze`, `seize`, `force_burn`, `update_authority`, `pause`, `unpause`, `deploy` · example `mint`

        Transaction type.

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `pending`, `processing`, `confirmed`, `finalized`, `failed` · example `confirmed`

        Transaction status.

      - **`signature`** · `string | null` · required · example `sig_example`

        Solana transaction signature.

      - **`idempotencyKey`** · `string` · example `idem_example_12345`

        Idempotency key used for this request.

      - **`idempotencyFingerprint`** · `string` · example `4f2d9c7a5e6f1c...`

        Request fingerprint used to validate idempotent retries.

      - **`serializedTx`** · `string | null` · required · min length 1 · example `AQID`

        Base64-encoded transaction payload, if available.

      - **`params`** · `object` · required

        Operation parameters captured for audit.

        - **`*`** · `any`

      - **`slot`** · `integer | null` · required · example `123456`

        Slot number, if confirmed.

      - **`blockTime`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        Block time, if confirmed.

      - **`fee`** · `integer | null` · required · example `5000`

        Transaction fee in lamports.

      - **`error`** · `string | null` · required · example `Signature failed`

        Error message if the transaction failed.

      - **`initiatedByKeyId`** · `string | null` · required · min length 1 · example `key_example`

        API key that initiated the transaction.

      - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        Creation timestamp.

      - **`updatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-02T00:00:00.000Z`

        Last update timestamp.

    - **`tokenAccount`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

      Destination token account address.

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `issuance.execute` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`404`** Not Found

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`409`** Conflict

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`422`** Unprocessable Entity

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `400`.

## Example request


### Prepare burn transaction
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/issuance/prepare-burn

> Builds an unsigned burn transaction for client-side signing.

`POST /v1/issuance/tokens/{tokenId}/burn/prepare`

The authority wallet is the fee payer: it signs the transaction and pays the network fee; SDP does not sponsor prepared transactions.

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `issuance.execute` action.

## Path parameters

- **`tokenId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `tok_example`

  Token identifier.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Selects the active project for this request. Required for Clerk (dashboard) callers. Ignored when authenticating with an API key, whose scope is fixed to the key's project.

## Request body

`application/json` · required

Burn request body.

- **`signingCustodyWalletId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `cwlt_example`

  Exact SDP Wallet ID that owns the source tokens and signs this burn.

- **`burn`** · `object` · required

  Burn operation details.

  - **`source`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

    Source wallet or token account to burn from.

  - **`amount`** · `string` · required · example `1000`

    Token amount in UI units (decimal string). Human-readable value such as "1" or "1.5". SDP converts to on-chain base units using the token's decimals field.

  - **`memo`** · `string` · max length 100 · example `Correction`

    Optional on-chain memo.

- **`options`** · `object`

  Burn execution options.

  - **`priorityFee`** · `string | integer`

    Any of:

    - **string** · one of `none`, `low`, `medium`, `high`

    - **integer** · min 0

  - **`simulate`** · `boolean`

## Responses

- **`200`** Prepared burn

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    Prepare burn response payload.

    - **`transaction`** · `object` · required

      Burn transaction record.

      - **`id`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `ttx_example`

        Token transaction identifier.

      - **`tokenId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `tok_example`

        Token identifier.

      - **`organizationId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `org_example`

        Organization identifier.

      - **`type`** · `string` · required · one of `mint`, `burn`, `freeze`, `unfreeze`, `seize`, `force_burn`, `update_authority`, `pause`, `unpause`, `deploy` · example `mint`

        Transaction type.

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `pending`, `processing`, `confirmed`, `finalized`, `failed` · example `confirmed`

        Transaction status.

      - **`signature`** · `string | null` · required · example `sig_example`

        Solana transaction signature.

      - **`idempotencyKey`** · `string` · example `idem_example_12345`

        Idempotency key used for this request.

      - **`idempotencyFingerprint`** · `string` · example `4f2d9c7a5e6f1c...`

        Request fingerprint used to validate idempotent retries.

      - **`serializedTx`** · `string | null` · required · min length 1 · example `AQID`

        Base64-encoded transaction payload, if available.

      - **`params`** · `object` · required

        Operation parameters captured for audit.

        - **`*`** · `any`

      - **`slot`** · `integer | null` · required · example `123456`

        Slot number, if confirmed.

      - **`blockTime`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        Block time, if confirmed.

      - **`fee`** · `integer | null` · required · example `5000`

        Transaction fee in lamports.

      - **`error`** · `string | null` · required · example `Signature failed`

        Error message if the transaction failed.

      - **`initiatedByKeyId`** · `string | null` · required · min length 1 · example `key_example`

        API key that initiated the transaction.

      - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        Creation timestamp.

      - **`updatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-02T00:00:00.000Z`

        Last update timestamp.

    - **`preparedTransaction`** · `object` · required

      Prepared transaction for burning.

      - **`serialized`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `AQID`

        Base64-encoded unsigned transaction.

      - **`blockhash`** · `string` · required · example `blockhash_example`

        Blockhash for the transaction.

      - **`lastValidBlockHeight`** · `string` · required · example `123456`

        Last valid block height.

    - **`simulation`** · `object`

      Optional transaction simulation results.

      - **`success`** · `boolean` · required · example `true`

        Simulation success flag.

      - **`logs`** · `string[]` · required

        Simulation logs, if any.

      - **`unitsConsumed`** · `number | string | null` · required · example `20000`

        Compute units consumed.

        Any of:

        - **number**

        - **string**

      - **`error`** · `string | null` · required · example `Insufficient funds`

        Simulation error, if any.

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `issuance.execute` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`404`** Not Found

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`409`** Conflict

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `400`.

### Execute burn
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/issuance/execute-burn

> Burns tokens using custody signing and submission.

`POST /v1/issuance/tokens/{tokenId}/burn`

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `issuance.execute` action.

## Path parameters

- **`tokenId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `tok_example`

  Token identifier.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Selects the active project for this request. Required for Clerk (dashboard) callers. Ignored when authenticating with an API key, whose scope is fixed to the key's project.

- **`Idempotency-Key`** · `string` · pattern `^[\x20-\x7e]{1,255}$` · example `idempotency_example_12345`

  Idempotency key for safely retrying mutating requests. 1-255 printable ASCII characters; echoed back on the response.

## Request body

`application/json` · required

Burn request body.

- **`signingCustodyWalletId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `cwlt_example`

  Exact SDP Wallet ID that owns the source tokens and signs this burn.

  Burn operation details.

  - **`source`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

    Source wallet or token account to burn from.

  - **`amount`** · `string` · required · example `1000`

    Token amount in UI units (decimal string). Human-readable value such as "1" or "1.5". SDP converts to on-chain base units using the token's decimals field.

  - **`memo`** · `string` · max length 100 · example `Correction`

    Optional on-chain memo.

- **`options`** · `object`

  Burn execution options.

  - **`priorityFee`** · `string | integer`

    - **string** · one of `none`, `low`, `medium`, `high`

    - **integer** · min 0

  - **`simulate`** · `boolean`

        Transaction type.

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `pending`, `processing`, `confirmed`, `finalized`, `failed` · example `confirmed`

        Transaction status.

        Solana transaction signature.

      - **`idempotencyKey`** · `string` · example `idem_example_12345`

        Idempotency key used for this request.

      - **`updatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-02T00:00:00.000Z`

## Issuance: Enforcement

### Prepare seize transaction
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/issuance/prepare-seize

> Builds an unsigned force transfer transaction for client-side signing.

`POST /v1/issuance/tokens/{tokenId}/seize/prepare`

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `issuance.enforce` action.

## Path parameters

- **`tokenId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `tok_example`

  Token identifier.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Selects the active project for this request. Required for Clerk (dashboard) callers. Ignored when authenticating with an API key, whose scope is fixed to the key's project.

## Request body

`application/json` · required

Seize (force transfer) request body.

- **`signingCustodyWalletId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `cwlt_example`

  Optional exact SDP Wallet ID. When supplied, it must control the current permanent delegate authority.

- **`seize`** · `object` · required

  Forced transfer details.

  - **`source`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

    Source wallet or token account to seize from.

  - **`destination`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

    Destination wallet or token account to receive seized tokens.

  - **`amount`** · `string` · required · example `250`

    Token amount in UI units (decimal string). Human-readable value such as "1" or "1.5". SDP converts to on-chain base units using the token's decimals field.

  - **`delegateAuthority`** · `string` · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

    Optional delegate authority address for the seizure.

  - **`memo`** · `string` · max length 100 · example `Compliance seizure`

    Optional on-chain memo.

- **`options`** · `object`

  Seize execution options.

  - **`priorityFee`** · `string | integer`

    Any of:

    - **string** · one of `none`, `low`, `medium`, `high`

    - **integer** · min 0

  - **`simulate`** · `boolean`

## Responses

- **`200`** Prepared seize

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    Prepare seize response payload.

    - **`transaction`** · `object` · required

      Seize transaction record.

      - **`id`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `ttx_example`

        Token transaction identifier.

      - **`tokenId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `tok_example`

        Token identifier.

      - **`organizationId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `org_example`

        Organization identifier.

      - **`type`** · `string` · required · one of `mint`, `burn`, `freeze`, `unfreeze`, `seize`, `force_burn`, `update_authority`, `pause`, `unpause`, `deploy` · example `mint`

        Transaction type.

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `pending`, `processing`, `confirmed`, `finalized`, `failed` · example `confirmed`

        Transaction status.

      - **`signature`** · `string | null` · required · example `sig_example`

        Solana transaction signature.

      - **`idempotencyKey`** · `string` · example `idem_example_12345`

        Idempotency key used for this request.

      - **`idempotencyFingerprint`** · `string` · example `4f2d9c7a5e6f1c...`

        Request fingerprint used to validate idempotent retries.

      - **`serializedTx`** · `string | null` · required · min length 1 · example `AQID`

        Base64-encoded transaction payload, if available.

      - **`params`** · `object` · required

        Operation parameters captured for audit.

        - **`*`** · `any`

      - **`slot`** · `integer | null` · required · example `123456`

        Slot number, if confirmed.

      - **`blockTime`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        Block time, if confirmed.

      - **`fee`** · `integer | null` · required · example `5000`

        Transaction fee in lamports.

      - **`error`** · `string | null` · required · example `Signature failed`

        Error message if the transaction failed.

      - **`initiatedByKeyId`** · `string | null` · required · min length 1 · example `key_example`

        API key that initiated the transaction.

      - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        Creation timestamp.

      - **`updatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-02T00:00:00.000Z`

        Last update timestamp.

    - **`preparedTransaction`** · `object` · required

      Prepared transaction for seizure.

      - **`serialized`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `AQID`

        Base64-encoded unsigned transaction.

      - **`blockhash`** · `string` · required · example `blockhash_example`

        Blockhash for the transaction.

      - **`lastValidBlockHeight`** · `string` · required · example `123456`

        Last valid block height.

    - **`simulation`** · `object`

      Optional transaction simulation results.

      - **`success`** · `boolean` · required · example `true`

        Simulation success flag.

      - **`logs`** · `string[]` · required

        Simulation logs, if any.

      - **`unitsConsumed`** · `number | string | null` · required · example `20000`

        Compute units consumed.

        Any of:

        - **number**

        - **string**

      - **`error`** · `string | null` · required · example `Insufficient funds`

        Simulation error, if any.

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `issuance.enforce` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`404`** Not Found

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`409`** Conflict

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `400`.

## Example request

```bash tab="cURL"
  -d '{
    "signingCustodyWalletId": "cwlt_example",
    "seize": {
      "source": "So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112",
      "destination": "So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112",
      "amount": "250",

  }'
```

### Execute seize
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/issuance/execute-seize

> Forces a transfer using permanent delegate authority.

`POST /v1/issuance/tokens/{tokenId}/seize`

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `issuance.enforce` action.

## Path parameters

- **`tokenId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `tok_example`

  Token identifier.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Selects the active project for this request. Required for Clerk (dashboard) callers. Ignored when authenticating with an API key, whose scope is fixed to the key's project.

- **`Idempotency-Key`** · `string` · pattern `^[\x20-\x7e]{1,255}$` · example `idempotency_example_12345`

  Idempotency key for safely retrying mutating requests. 1-255 printable ASCII characters; echoed back on the response.

## Request body

`application/json` · required

Seize (force transfer) request body.

- **`signingCustodyWalletId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `cwlt_example`

  Optional exact SDP Wallet ID. When supplied, it must control the current permanent delegate authority.

- **`seize`** · `object` · required

  Forced transfer details.

  - **`source`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

    Source wallet or token account to seize from.

  - **`destination`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

    Destination wallet or token account to receive seized tokens.

  - **`amount`** · `string` · required · example `250`

    Token amount in UI units (decimal string). Human-readable value such as "1" or "1.5". SDP converts to on-chain base units using the token's decimals field.

  - **`delegateAuthority`** · `string` · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

    Optional delegate authority address for the seizure.

  - **`memo`** · `string` · max length 100 · example `Compliance seizure`

    Optional on-chain memo.

- **`options`** · `object`

  Seize execution options.

  - **`priorityFee`** · `string | integer`

    Any of:

    - **string** · one of `none`, `low`, `medium`, `high`

    - **integer** · min 0

  - **`simulate`** · `boolean`

## Responses

- **`200`** Seize executed

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    Execute seize response payload.

    - **`transaction`** · `object` · required

      Seize transaction record.

      - **`id`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `ttx_example`

        Token transaction identifier.

      - **`tokenId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `tok_example`

        Token identifier.

      - **`organizationId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `org_example`

        Organization identifier.

      - **`type`** · `string` · required · one of `mint`, `burn`, `freeze`, `unfreeze`, `seize`, `force_burn`, `update_authority`, `pause`, `unpause`, `deploy` · example `mint`

        Transaction type.

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `pending`, `processing`, `confirmed`, `finalized`, `failed` · example `confirmed`

        Transaction status.

      - **`signature`** · `string | null` · required · example `sig_example`

        Solana transaction signature.

      - **`idempotencyKey`** · `string` · example `idem_example_12345`

        Idempotency key used for this request.

      - **`idempotencyFingerprint`** · `string` · example `4f2d9c7a5e6f1c...`

        Request fingerprint used to validate idempotent retries.

      - **`serializedTx`** · `string | null` · required · min length 1 · example `AQID`

        Base64-encoded transaction payload, if available.

      - **`params`** · `object` · required

        Operation parameters captured for audit.

        - **`*`** · `any`

      - **`slot`** · `integer | null` · required · example `123456`

        Slot number, if confirmed.

      - **`blockTime`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        Block time, if confirmed.

      - **`fee`** · `integer | null` · required · example `5000`

        Transaction fee in lamports.

      - **`error`** · `string | null` · required · example `Signature failed`

        Error message if the transaction failed.

      - **`initiatedByKeyId`** · `string | null` · required · min length 1 · example `key_example`

        API key that initiated the transaction.

      - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        Creation timestamp.

      - **`updatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-02T00:00:00.000Z`

        Last update timestamp.

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

### Prepare force burn transaction
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/issuance/prepare-force-burn

> Builds an unsigned force burn transaction for client-side signing.

`POST /v1/issuance/tokens/{tokenId}/force-burn/prepare`

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `issuance.enforce` action.

## Path parameters

- **`tokenId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `tok_example`

  Token identifier.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Selects the active project for this request. Required for Clerk (dashboard) callers. Ignored when authenticating with an API key, whose scope is fixed to the key's project.

## Request body

`application/json` · required

Force burn request body.

- **`signingCustodyWalletId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `cwlt_example`

  Optional exact SDP Wallet ID. When supplied, it must control the current permanent delegate authority.

- **`forceBurn`** · `object` · required

  Forced burn details.

  - **`source`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

    Source wallet or token account to force-burn from.

  - **`amount`** · `string` · required · example `250`

    Token amount in UI units (decimal string). Human-readable value such as "1" or "1.5". SDP converts to on-chain base units using the token's decimals field.

  - **`delegateAuthority`** · `string` · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

    Optional delegate authority address for the force burn.

  - **`memo`** · `string` · max length 100 · example `Compliance burn`

    Optional on-chain memo.

- **`options`** · `object`

  Force burn execution options.

  - **`priorityFee`** · `string | integer`

    Any of:

    - **string** · one of `none`, `low`, `medium`, `high`

    - **integer** · min 0

  - **`simulate`** · `boolean`

## Responses

- **`200`** Prepared force burn

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    Prepare force burn response payload.

    - **`transaction`** · `object` · required

      Force burn transaction record.

      - **`id`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `ttx_example`

        Token transaction identifier.

      - **`tokenId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `tok_example`

        Token identifier.

      - **`organizationId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `org_example`

        Organization identifier.

      - **`type`** · `string` · required · one of `mint`, `burn`, `freeze`, `unfreeze`, `seize`, `force_burn`, `update_authority`, `pause`, `unpause`, `deploy` · example `mint`

        Transaction type.

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `pending`, `processing`, `confirmed`, `finalized`, `failed` · example `confirmed`

        Transaction status.

      - **`signature`** · `string | null` · required · example `sig_example`

        Solana transaction signature.

      - **`idempotencyKey`** · `string` · example `idem_example_12345`

        Idempotency key used for this request.

      - **`idempotencyFingerprint`** · `string` · example `4f2d9c7a5e6f1c...`

        Request fingerprint used to validate idempotent retries.

      - **`serializedTx`** · `string | null` · required · min length 1 · example `AQID`

        Base64-encoded transaction payload, if available.

      - **`params`** · `object` · required

        Operation parameters captured for audit.

        - **`*`** · `any`

      - **`slot`** · `integer | null` · required · example `123456`

        Slot number, if confirmed.

      - **`blockTime`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        Block time, if confirmed.

      - **`fee`** · `integer | null` · required · example `5000`

        Transaction fee in lamports.

      - **`error`** · `string | null` · required · example `Signature failed`

        Error message if the transaction failed.

      - **`initiatedByKeyId`** · `string | null` · required · min length 1 · example `key_example`

        API key that initiated the transaction.

      - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        Creation timestamp.

      - **`updatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-02T00:00:00.000Z`

        Last update timestamp.

    - **`preparedTransaction`** · `object` · required

      Prepared transaction for force burn.

      - **`serialized`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `AQID`

        Base64-encoded unsigned transaction.

      - **`blockhash`** · `string` · required · example `blockhash_example`

        Blockhash for the transaction.

      - **`lastValidBlockHeight`** · `string` · required · example `123456`

        Last valid block height.

    - **`simulation`** · `object`

      Optional transaction simulation results.

      - **`success`** · `boolean` · required · example `true`

        Simulation success flag.

      - **`logs`** · `string[]` · required

        Simulation logs, if any.

      - **`unitsConsumed`** · `number | string | null` · required · example `20000`

        Compute units consumed.

        Any of:

        - **number**

        - **string**

      - **`error`** · `string | null` · required · example `Insufficient funds`

        Simulation error, if any.

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `issuance.enforce` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`404`** Not Found

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`409`** Conflict

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `400`.

## Example request
