```bash tab="cURL"
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SDP_API_KEY"
```

```ts tab="TypeScript"
  headers: {

  }
});
```


### Get transfer
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/payments/get-payment-transfer

> Retrieves details for a specific transfer.

`GET /v1/payments/transfers/{transferId}`

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `transfers.read` action.

## Path parameters

- **`transferId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `xfr_example`

  Transfer identifier (SDP record ID, not the on-chain signature).

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Selects the active project for this request. Required for Clerk (dashboard) callers. Ignored when authenticating with an API key, whose scope is fixed to the key's project.

## Responses

- **`200`** Transfer details

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    Transfer response payload.

    - **`transfer`** · `object` · required

      Transfer details.

      - **`fireblocks`** · `object`

        Native Fireblocks transfer tracking. A processing payment may await approval in Fireblocks; network fees are paid by its source vault. A missing transaction ID means submission is still being reconciled. Do not create a replacement payment while its outcome is unknown.

        - **`transactionId`** · `string | null` · required

        - **`status`** · `string` · required

        - **`subStatus`** · `string | null` · required

      - **`id`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `xfr_example`

        Transfer identifier (SDP record ID, not the on-chain signature).

      - **`organizationId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `org_example`

        Organization identifier.

      - **`custodyWalletId`** · `string | null` · required · example `cwlt_example`

        Exact SDP Wallet ID associated with the persisted transfer, or null for unresolved legacy and observed rows.

      - **`providerWalletId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `privy_wallet_123`

        Provider wallet ID retained as evidence; not an execution selector.

      - **`projectId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

        Project identifier for the transfer.

      - **`type`** · `string` · required · one of `transfer`, `transfer_batch`, `onramp`, `offramp` · example `transfer`

        Transfer type.

      - **`kind`** · `string` · required · one of `pay`, `confidential_pay`, `batch_pay`, `recurring_pay`, `deposit`, `request_deposit`, `onramp`, `offramp`

        Dashboard transaction kind derived from the transfer type and originating Payments resource.

      - **`direction`** · `string` · required · one of `inbound`, `outbound` · example `outbound`

        Transfer direction.

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `pending`, `processing`, `confirmed`, `finalized`, `failed`, `awaiting_payment`, `settling`, `completed`, `canceled`, `expired` · example `confirmed`

        Transfer status.

      - **`signature`** · `string | null` · required · example `sig_example`

        Solana transaction signature (tx id/hash).

      - **`serializedTx`** · `string | null` · required · min length 1 · example `base64_tx_example`

        Base64-encoded transaction payload, if available. Always null for transfer batch chunks, whose signed bytes stay server-side.

      - **`slot`** · `integer | null` · required · example `123456`

        Slot number, if confirmed.

      - **`blockTime`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        Block time, if confirmed.

      - **`confirmedAt`** · `string` · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        When SDP confirmed the transfer. A ramp is confirmed once its delivery is verified onchain.

      - **`fee`** · `integer | null` · required · example `5000`

        Transaction fee in lamports.

      - **`error`** · `string | null` · required · example `Signature failed`

        Error message if the transaction failed.

      - **`initiatedBy`** · `object`

        Initiator that triggered the transfer.

        - **`type`** · `string` · required · one of `api_key`, `user`, `system` · example `api_key`

          Initiator type.

        - **`id`** · `string`

          Initiator identifier if applicable.

        - **`display`** · `string`

          Human-friendly label for the initiator.

      - **`source`** · `string` · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Source wallet address.

      - **`destination`** · `string` · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Destination wallet address.

      - **`memo`** · `string` · max length 256

        Optional memo for the transfer.

      - **`rampsMemo`** · `object` · required

        Free-form key-value memo for offchain reconciliation of ramp transfers. At most 20 entries.

        - **`*`** · `string` · min length 1 · max length 256

      - **`token`** · `string`

        Token symbol or mint address.

      - **`amount`** · `string` · example `100.00`

        Token amount in UI units (decimal string).

      - **`provider`** · `string` · one of `moonpay`, `stripe`, `hercle`, `mural`, `moneygram`, `lightspark`, `coinbase`, `bvnk` · example `moonpay`

        Ramp provider for on-ramp and off-ramp transfer records. A retired provider's records keep its id.

      - **`counterpartyId`** · `string` · example `cpty_example`

        Counterparty tied to the transfer record, when available.

      - **`counterpartyDisplayName`** · `string` · example `Acme Studio`

        Current display name of the counterparty tied to the transfer.

      - **`providerReference`** · `string` · example `ramp_quote_example`

        Provider quote or transaction reference used for ramp correlation.

      - **`deliveryMode`** · `string` · one of `hosted`, `manual_instructions`, `session_widget` · example `session_widget`

        Ramp delivery mode. Hosted flows require the customer to complete a provider-hosted UI; manual instructions require the customer to fund displayed instructions; session widgets use a provider SDK session.

      - **`fiatCurrency`** · `string` · example `USD`

        Fiat currency for the ramp leg.

      - **`fiatAmount`** · `string` · example `100.00`

        Quoted fiat amount for the ramp leg: what the customer pays on an on-ramp, the payout quoted on an off-ramp. It never changes after the quote; an off-ramp's final payout is `fiatPayout`.

      - **`settlement`** · `object`

        Provider-reported ramp settlement economics for live providers.

        - **`provider`** · `string` · required · always `moonpay`

        - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `completed`, `failed`

        - **`transactionId`** · `string` · required

          MoonPay transaction id.

        - **`baseCurrencyCode`** · `string` · required

          Fiat currency paid.

        - **`baseCurrencyAmount`** · `number` · required

          Fiat amount paid.

        - **`quoteCurrencyCode`** · `string` · required

          Crypto currency purchased.

        - **`quoteCurrencyAmount`** · `number` · required

          Crypto amount purchased.

        - **`feeAmount`** · `number` · required

          Provider fee.

        - **`extraFeeAmount`** · `number` · required

          Extra provider fee.

        - **`networkFeeAmount`** · `number` · required

          Network fee.

        - **`areFeesIncluded`** · `boolean` · required

          Whether the fees are included in the paid amount.

        - **`usdRate`** · `number` · required

          USD exchange rate.

        - **`cryptoTransactionId`** · `string`

          On-chain transaction id.

        - **`failureReason`** · `string`

          Provider failure reason.

      - **`fiatPayout`** · `object`

        What the provider reports paying out once it settles an off-ramp sale. Provider-reported: SDP cannot verify a bank payout.

        - **`amount`** · `string` · required · example `20.82`

          Fiat paid out, in display units. Differs from the quoted `fiatAmount` when the provider re-prices the sale at receipt.

        - **`currency`** · `string` · required · example `USD`

          ISO currency of the payout, as the provider reports it.

        - **`reportedAt`** · `string` · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-02T00:00:00.000Z`

          When the provider reported the payout.

      - **`deliveryMismatch`** · `object`

        Present while SDP holds a provider-settled ramp in `settling` because the chain contradicts the provider's delivery. A new provider report clears it.

        - **`reason`** · `string` · required · one of `provider_report_mismatch`, `transaction_failed`, `predates_transfer`, `not_delivered`, `amount_mismatch`, `transaction_not_found` · example `amount_mismatch`

          Why the chain contradicts the provider: `provider_report_mismatch` (its report contradicts SDP's record), `transaction_failed`, `predates_transfer` (the transaction landed before the transfer), `not_delivered` (nothing of the quoted asset reached the quoted wallet), `amount_mismatch`, or `transaction_not_found` (no finalized transaction an hour after the report; SDP keeps checking, and a later delivery completes the transfer).

        - **`checkedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-02T00:00:00.000Z`

          When SDP's delivery check reached this verdict.

        - **`reportedAmount`** · `string` · example `20`

          What the provider reported delivering, in display units.

        - **`observedAmount`** · `string` · example `0.5`

          What the chain shows the quoted wallet received, in display units.

      - **`risk`** · `object`

        Optional risk evaluation for the transfer.

        - **`provider`** · `string` · required · example `trm`

          Risk scoring provider.

        - **`score`** · `string` · required · example `0.12`

          Provider-specific risk score.

        - **`level`** · `string` · required · one of `low`, `medium`, `high`, `unknown` · example `low`

          Risk level classification.

        - **`evaluatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

          Timestamp when risk was evaluated.

      - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        Creation timestamp.

      - **`updatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-02T00:00:00.000Z`

        Last update timestamp.

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `transfers.read` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `401`.

- **`404`** Not Found

  Same fields as `401`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `401`.

## Payments: Transfer batches

### Estimate transfer batch
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/payments/estimate-payment-transfer-batch

> Validates an exact-wallet transfer batch request and estimates transaction chunking and fees.

`POST /v1/payments/transfer-batches/estimate`

`warnings` lists what would make the batch fail: a native SOL amount below the rent-exempt minimum sent to an address with no account, or a source wallet left below the minimum; create refuses those with 409 `AMOUNT_BELOW_RENT_MINIMUM`.

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `transfer_batches.read` action.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Selects the active project for this request. Required for Clerk (dashboard) callers. Ignored when authenticating with an API key, whose scope is fixed to the key's project.

## Request body

`application/json` · required

Estimate transaction chunking and fees for a transfer batch.

- **`projectId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Project identifier for the transfer batch context.

- **`externalId`** · `string` · min length 1 · max length 256 · example `payroll_2026_06_30`

  Caller-provided batch correlation ID. Not used as an idempotency key.

- **`sourceCustodyWalletId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `cwlt_example`

  Exact SDP Wallet ID (`id` from `GET /v1/wallets`).

- **`token`** · `string` · required · example `SOL`

  Token to transfer. Pass `SOL` for the native token, a well-known token symbol (e.g. `USDC`) resolved to the configured cluster's mint, or a base58 SPL mint address. Custom tokens must be specified by their on-chain mint.

- **`recipients`** · `object[]` · required · min items 1 · max items 500

  Counterparty-account recipients to pay in this batch.

  - **`externalId`** · `string` · min length 1 · max length 256

  - **`counterpartyId`** · `string` · min length 1

  - **`counterpartyAccountId`** · `string` · required · min length 1

  - **`amount`** · `string` · required

- **`options`** · `object`

  Execution options for transaction chunking, priority fees, and preflight validation.

  - **`maxRecipientsPerTransaction`** · `integer` · min 1 · max 64

  - **`priorityFee`** · `string` · one of `none`, `low`, `medium`, `high`, `auto`

  - **`preflight`** · `boolean`

## Responses

- **`200`** Transfer batch estimate

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    Transfer batch estimate response payload.

    - **`estimate`** · `object` · required

      Transfer batch estimate.

      - **`recipientCount`** · `integer` · required

        Requested recipient count.

      - **`transactionCount`** · `integer` · required

        Estimated number of Solana transaction chunks.

      - **`estimatedFees`** · `object` · required

        Estimated fee components.

        - **`networkFeeLamports`** · `string` · required · example `5000`

          Estimated base network fee in lamports.

        - **`priorityFeeLamports`** · `string` · required · example `0`

          Estimated priority fee in lamports.

        - **`tokenAccountRentLamports`** · `string` · required · example `0`

          Estimated rent needed for newly-created recipient token accounts.

        - **`sponsored`** · `boolean` · required · example `true`

          Whether SDP sponsors transaction fees for this batch.

      - **`warnings`** · `object[]` · required

        What would make the batch fail. Empty when the batch can be sent as estimated.

        One of:

        - **code: "AMOUNT_BELOW_RENT_MINIMUM"**

          - **`code`** · `string` · required · always `AMOUNT_BELOW_RENT_MINIMUM`

            A native SOL recipient's address holds no account and its amount is below the rent-exempt minimum.

          - **`recipientIndex`** · `integer` · required

            Zero-based index of the recipient in the request.

          - **`minimumAmount`** · `string` · required

            The smallest SOL amount the address can receive while it has no account.

          - **`message`** · `string` · required

            Human-readable warning.

        - **code: "SOURCE_BELOW_RENT_MINIMUM"**

          - **`code`** · `string` · required · always `SOURCE_BELOW_RENT_MINIMUM`

            The source wallet would be left holding more than nothing but less than the rent-exempt minimum, at the end or after some order of the batch's concurrent transactions.

          - **`sourceRemainder`** · `string` · required

            The SOL the source wallet would be left with.

          - **`minimumAmount`** · `string` · required

            The rent-exempt minimum for a SOL wallet.

          - **`message`** · `string` · required

            Human-readable warning.

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `transfer_batches.read` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`404`** Not Found

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `400`.

---

### Create transfer batch
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/payments/create-payment-transfer-batch

> Executes an outbound transfer batch from one exact SDP Wallet ID, chunks recipients into Solana transactions, and returns the batch, recipient, and transfer records.

`POST /v1/payments/transfer-batches`

Requires an Idempotency-Key: a retry with the same key and request returns the original batch without another on-chain submission. Recipient order does not change the request. A native SOL batch is refused with 409 `AMOUNT_BELOW_RENT_MINIMUM`, before anything is written or sent, when a recipient whose address has no account gets less than the rent-exempt minimum (`details.recipientIndexes`) or the source wallet would be left holding more than nothing but less than the minimum (`details.sourceRemainder`).

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `transfer_batches.execute` action.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Selects the active project for this request. Required for Clerk (dashboard) callers. Ignored when authenticating with an API key, whose scope is fixed to the key's project.

- **`Idempotency-Key`** · `string` · required · pattern `^[\x20-\x7e]{1,255}$` · example `idempotency_example_12345`

  Required: a request without one returns 400 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED`. 1-255 printable ASCII characters; send a UUID per logical operation and reuse it on every retry. Within 24 hours, a retry with the same key and the same request returns the stored status and body with the response header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`. Keys are scoped to the credential: within 24 hours, the same key with a different request, or from a different credential, returns 422 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED`; after that, the same key from a different credential runs as a new request. A rotated API key is a new credential, so after any rotation read the resource with GET to see whether the original request ran, and never resend a money request under the new credential without checking first. A key whose original request is still running returns 409 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_IN_FLIGHT` with `Retry-After`. A 400, 401, 403, 409 or 429 refusal is not stored, so the same key runs again once the cause is fixed. Access is checked before the key on every request, so a refused request never claims the key, and a credential that has since lost access to the named resource gets 403 instead of the stored response. A replay is a snapshot of the original response: read the current state with GET instead of sending the request again. If the original request never recorded its outcome (it crashed), a same-key retry gets 409 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_IN_FLIGHT` until 15 minutes plus the route's lease have passed since the original was sent (about 16 minutes, or about 20 for transfer batches), then takes over and is answered from the record it wrote. Once the request has written its record, any answer below 500 is stored: a transfer that fails after that (such as 400 `TRANSACTION_FAILED` or a 409 signer mismatch) answers a same-key retry with the same error and `Idempotent-Replayed: true`, and after 24 hours the record answers with the same status and code. A 5xx is not stored: a same-key retry runs again and is answered from the record. To try again after a failure, send the request with a new key. After a 5xx, a retry with the same key runs again and answers from the original record instead of acting twice; that answer also carries `Idempotent-Replayed: true`.

## Request body

`application/json` · required

Create a custody-executed outbound transfer batch.

- **`projectId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Project identifier for the transfer batch context.

- **`externalId`** · `string` · min length 1 · max length 256 · example `payroll_2026_06_30`

  Caller-provided batch correlation ID. Not used as an idempotency key.

- **`sourceCustodyWalletId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `cwlt_example`

  Exact SDP Wallet ID (`id` from `GET /v1/wallets`).

- **`token`** · `string` · required · example `SOL`

  Token to transfer. Pass `SOL` for the native token, a well-known token symbol (e.g. `USDC`) resolved to the configured cluster's mint, or a base58 SPL mint address. Custom tokens must be specified by their on-chain mint.

- **`recipients`** · `object[]` · required · min items 1 · max items 500

  Counterparty-account recipients to pay in this batch.

  - **`externalId`** · `string` · min length 1 · max length 256

  - **`counterpartyId`** · `string` · min length 1

  - **`counterpartyAccountId`** · `string` · required · min length 1

  - **`amount`** · `string` · required

- **`options`** · `object`

  Execution options for transaction chunking, priority fees, and preflight validation.

  - **`maxRecipientsPerTransaction`** · `integer` · min 1 · max 64

  - **`priorityFee`** · `string` · one of `none`, `low`, `medium`, `high`, `auto`

  - **`preflight`** · `boolean`

        Caller-provided recipient correlation ID.

      - **`counterpartyId`** · `string` · required · example `cpty_example`

        Counterparty identifier for the recipient.

      - **`counterpartyAccountId`** · `string` · required · example `cpa_example`

        Counterparty account identifier for the recipient.

      - **`destination`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Resolved Solana destination address.

      - **`amount`** · `string` · required · example `100.00`

        Token amount in UI units (decimal string).

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `pending`, `processing`, `confirmed`, `failed`, `archived` · example `pending`

        Transfer batch recipient status.

      - **`error`** · `string | null` · required

        Recipient-level failure reason, when available.

      - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

      - **`updatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

    - **`transfers`** · `object[]`

      Payment transfer chunk records associated with this batch.

      - **`fireblocks`** · `object`

        Native Fireblocks transfer tracking. A processing payment may await approval in Fireblocks; network fees are paid by its source vault. A missing transaction ID means submission is still being reconciled. Do not create a replacement payment while its outcome is unknown.

        - **`transactionId`** · `string | null` · required

        - **`status`** · `string` · required

        - **`subStatus`** · `string | null` · required

      - **`id`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `xfr_example`

        Transfer identifier (SDP record ID, not the on-chain signature).

      - **`organizationId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `org_example`

        Organization identifier.

      - **`custodyWalletId`** · `string | null` · required · example `cwlt_example`

        Exact SDP Wallet ID associated with the persisted transfer, or null for unresolved legacy and observed rows.

      - **`providerWalletId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `privy_wallet_123`

        Provider wallet ID retained as evidence; not an execution selector.

      - **`projectId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

        Project identifier for the transfer.

        Transfer type.

      - **`kind`** · `string` · required · one of `pay`, `confidential_pay`, `batch_pay`, `recurring_pay`, `deposit`, `request_deposit`, `onramp`, `offramp`

        Dashboard transaction kind derived from the transfer type and originating Payments resource.

      - **`direction`** · `string` · required · one of `inbound`, `outbound` · example `outbound`

        Transfer direction.

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `pending`, `processing`, `confirmed`, `finalized`, `failed`, `awaiting_payment`, `settling`, `completed`, `canceled`, `expired` · example `confirmed`

        Transfer status.

        Solana transaction signature (tx id/hash).

      - **`serializedTx`** · `string | null` · required · min length 1 · example `base64_tx_example`

        Base64-encoded transaction payload, if available. Always null for transfer batch chunks, whose signed bytes stay server-side.

      - **`slot`** · `integer | null` · required · example `123456`

        Slot number, if confirmed.

      - **`blockTime`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        Block time, if confirmed.

        When SDP confirmed the transfer. A ramp is confirmed once its delivery is verified onchain.

      - **`fee`** · `integer | null` · required · example `5000`

        Transaction fee in lamports.

      - **`error`** · `string | null` · required · example `Signature failed`

        Error message if the transaction failed.

      - **`initiatedBy`** · `object`

        Initiator that triggered the transfer.

        - **`type`** · `string` · required · one of `api_key`, `user`, `system` · example `api_key`

          Initiator type.

        - **`id`** · `string`

          Initiator identifier if applicable.

        - **`display`** · `string`

          Human-friendly label for the initiator.

      - **`source`** · `string` · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Source wallet address.

      - **`destination`** · `string` · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Destination wallet address.

      - **`memo`** · `string` · max length 256

        Optional memo for the transfer.

      - **`rampsMemo`** · `object` · required

        Free-form key-value memo for offchain reconciliation of ramp transfers. At most 20 entries.

        - **`*`** · `string` · min length 1 · max length 256

      - **`token`** · `string`

        Token symbol or mint address.

      - **`amount`** · `string` · example `100.00`

        Token amount in UI units (decimal string).

      - **`provider`** · `string` · one of `moonpay`, `stripe`, `hercle`, `mural`, `moneygram`, `lightspark`, `coinbase`, `bvnk` · example `moonpay`

        Ramp provider for on-ramp and off-ramp transfer records. A retired provider's records keep its id.

      - **`counterpartyId`** · `string` · example `cpty_example`

        Counterparty tied to the transfer record, when available.

      - **`counterpartyDisplayName`** · `string` · example `Acme Studio`

        Current display name of the counterparty tied to the transfer.

      - **`providerReference`** · `string` · example `ramp_quote_example`

        Provider quote or transaction reference used for ramp correlation.

      - **`deliveryMode`** · `string` · one of `hosted`, `manual_instructions`, `session_widget` · example `session_widget`

        Ramp delivery mode. Hosted flows require the customer to complete a provider-hosted UI; manual instructions require the customer to fund displayed instructions; session widgets use a provider SDK session.

      - **`fiatCurrency`** · `string` · example `USD`

        Fiat currency for the ramp leg.

      - **`fiatAmount`** · `string` · example `100.00`

        Quoted fiat amount for the ramp leg: what the customer pays on an on-ramp, the payout quoted on an off-ramp. It never changes after the quote; an off-ramp's final payout is `fiatPayout`.

      - **`settlement`** · `object`

        Provider-reported ramp settlement economics for live providers.

        - **`provider`** · `string` · required · always `moonpay`

        - **`transactionId`** · `string` · required

          MoonPay transaction id.

        - **`baseCurrencyCode`** · `string` · required

          Fiat currency paid.

        - **`baseCurrencyAmount`** · `number` · required

          Fiat amount paid.

        - **`quoteCurrencyCode`** · `string` · required

          Crypto currency purchased.

        - **`quoteCurrencyAmount`** · `number` · required

          Crypto amount purchased.

        - **`feeAmount`** · `number` · required

          Provider fee.

        - **`extraFeeAmount`** · `number` · required

          Extra provider fee.

        - **`networkFeeAmount`** · `number` · required

          Network fee.

        - **`areFeesIncluded`** · `boolean` · required

          Whether the fees are included in the paid amount.

        - **`usdRate`** · `number` · required

          USD exchange rate.

        - **`cryptoTransactionId`** · `string`

          On-chain transaction id.

        - **`failureReason`** · `string`

          Provider failure reason.

      - **`fiatPayout`** · `object`

        What the provider reports paying out once it settles an off-ramp sale. Provider-reported: SDP cannot verify a bank payout.

        - **`amount`** · `string` · required · example `20.82`

          Fiat paid out, in display units. Differs from the quoted `fiatAmount` when the provider re-prices the sale at receipt.

        - **`currency`** · `string` · required · example `USD`

          ISO currency of the payout, as the provider reports it.

        - **`reportedAt`** · `string` · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-02T00:00:00.000Z`

          When the provider reported the payout.

      - **`deliveryMismatch`** · `object`

        Present while SDP holds a provider-settled ramp in `settling` because the chain contradicts the provider's delivery. A new provider report clears it.

        - **`reason`** · `string` · required · one of `provider_report_mismatch`, `transaction_failed`, `predates_transfer`, `not_delivered`, `amount_mismatch`, `transaction_not_found` · example `amount_mismatch`

          Why the chain contradicts the provider: `provider_report_mismatch` (its report contradicts SDP's record), `transaction_failed`, `predates_transfer` (the transaction landed before the transfer), `not_delivered` (nothing of the quoted asset reached the quoted wallet), `amount_mismatch`, or `transaction_not_found` (no finalized transaction an hour after the report; SDP keeps checking, and a later delivery completes the transfer).

        - **`checkedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-02T00:00:00.000Z`

          When SDP's delivery check reached this verdict.

        - **`reportedAmount`** · `string` · example `20`

          What the provider reported delivering, in display units.

        - **`observedAmount`** · `string` · example `0.5`

          What the chain shows the quoted wallet received, in display units.

      - **`risk`** · `object`

        Optional risk evaluation for the transfer.

        - **`provider`** · `string` · required · example `trm`

          Risk scoring provider.

        - **`score`** · `string` · required · example `0.12`

          Provider-specific risk score.

        - **`level`** · `string` · required · one of `low`, `medium`, `high`, `unknown` · example `low`

          Risk level classification.

        - **`evaluatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

          Timestamp when risk was evaluated.

      - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        Creation timestamp.

      - **`updatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-02T00:00:00.000Z`

        Last update timestamp.

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

```bash tab="cURL"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "projectId": "prj_example",
    "externalId": "payroll_2026_06_30",
    "sourceCustodyWalletId": "cwlt_example",
    "token": "SOL",
    "recipients": [
      {
        "externalId": "payroll_row_001",
        "counterpartyId": "cpty_example",
        "counterpartyAccountId": "cpa_example",
        "amount": "25.00"
      }
    ],
```

### List transfer batches
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/payments/list-payment-transfer-batches

> Lists transfer batches for the authenticated organization or project scope.

`GET /v1/payments/transfer-batches`

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `transfer_batches.read` action.

## Query parameters

- **`sourceCustodyWalletId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `cwlt_example`

  Filter by exact source SDP Wallet ID.

- **`token`** · `string` · example `SOL`

  Filter by token symbol or mint.

- **`status`** · `string` · one of `pending`, `processing`, `confirmed`, `failed`, `partially_failed`, `archived` · example `processing`

  Filter by transfer batch status.

- **`externalId`** · `string` · min length 1 · max length 256 · example `payroll_2026_06_30`

  Filter by caller-provided batch correlation ID.

- **`page`** · `integer` · greater than 0 · default `1` · example `1`

  Page number (1-based).

- **`pageSize`** · `integer` · min 1 · max 100 · default `20` · example `20`

  Number of batches per page.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Selects the active project for this request. Required for Clerk (dashboard) callers. Ignored when authenticating with an API key, whose scope is fixed to the key's project.

## Responses

- **`200`** Transfer batch list

  - **`data`** · `object[]` · required

    - **`id`** · `string` · required · example `xbatch_example`

      Transfer batch identifier.

    - **`organizationId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `org_example`

      Organization identifier.

    - **`projectId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

      Project identifier for the transfer batch.

    - **`externalId`** · `string | null` · required · example `payroll_2026_06_30`

      Caller-provided batch correlation ID.

    - **`sourceCustodyWalletId`** · `string | null` · required · example `cwlt_example`

      Exact source SDP Wallet ID, or null for unresolved legacy batches.

    - **`sourceProviderWalletId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `privy_wallet_123`

      Source Provider wallet ID retained as evidence.

    - **`sourceAddress`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

      Source custody wallet address.

    - **`token`** · `string` · required · example `SOL`

      Token symbol or mint address.

    - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `pending`, `processing`, `confirmed`, `failed`, `partially_failed`, `archived` · example `processing`

      Transfer batch status.

    - **`totalAmount`** · `string | null` · required · example `1000.00`

      Total requested batch amount in UI units, when computed.

    - **`recipientCount`** · `integer` · required · example `20`

      Number of recipient rows in the batch.

    - **`transactionCount`** · `integer` · required · example `1`

      Number of Solana transaction chunks for the batch.

    - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

    - **`updatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Pagination metadata.

    - **`total`** · `integer` · required · min 0

      Total items.

    - **`page`** · `integer` · required · greater than 0

      Current page number.

    - **`pageSize`** · `integer` · required · greater than 0

      Items per page.

    - **`hasMore`** · `boolean` · required

      Whether more pages exist.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `transfer_batches.read` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`404`** Not Found

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`409`** Conflict

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `400`.

## Example request

```bash tab="cURL"
curl 'https://api.solana.com/v1/payments/transfer-batches' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SDP_API_KEY"
```

```ts tab="TypeScript"

  method: "GET",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.SDP_API_KEY}`
  }
});
```

```python tab="Python"

  headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['SDP_API_KEY']}"})
```

### Get transfer batch
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/payments/get-payment-transfer-batch

> Retrieves a transfer batch with recipient rows and chunk transfer summaries.

`GET /v1/payments/transfer-batches/{batchId}`

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `transfer_batches.read` action.

## Path parameters

- **`batchId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `xbatch_example`

  Transfer batch identifier.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Selects the active project for this request. Required for Clerk (dashboard) callers. Ignored when authenticating with an API key, whose scope is fixed to the key's project.

## Responses

- **`200`** Transfer batch details

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    Transfer batch response payload.

    - **`batch`** · `object` · required

      Transfer batch details.

      - **`id`** · `string` · required · example `xbatch_example`

        Transfer batch identifier.

      - **`organizationId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `org_example`

        Organization identifier.

      - **`projectId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

        Project identifier for the transfer batch.

      - **`externalId`** · `string | null` · required · example `payroll_2026_06_30`

        Caller-provided batch correlation ID.

      - **`sourceCustodyWalletId`** · `string | null` · required · example `cwlt_example`

        Exact source SDP Wallet ID, or null for unresolved legacy batches.

      - **`sourceProviderWalletId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `privy_wallet_123`

        Source Provider wallet ID retained as evidence.

      - **`sourceAddress`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Source custody wallet address.

      - **`token`** · `string` · required · example `SOL`

        Token symbol or mint address.

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `pending`, `processing`, `confirmed`, `failed`, `partially_failed`, `archived` · example `processing`

        Transfer batch status.

      - **`totalAmount`** · `string | null` · required · example `1000.00`

        Total requested batch amount in UI units, when computed.

      - **`recipientCount`** · `integer` · required · example `20`

        Number of recipient rows in the batch.

      - **`transactionCount`** · `integer` · required · example `1`

        Number of Solana transaction chunks for the batch.

      - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

      - **`updatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

    - **`recipients`** · `object[]`

      Recipient rows for the batch, included on detail responses.

      - **`id`** · `string` · required

        Transfer batch recipient identifier.

      - **`batchId`** · `string` · required

        Parent transfer batch identifier.

      - **`transferId`** · `string | null` · required · min length 1 · example `xfr_example`

        Payment transfer chunk that settled this recipient, once assigned.

      - **`externalId`** · `string | null` · required · example `payroll_row_001`

        Caller-provided recipient correlation ID.

      - **`counterpartyId`** · `string` · required · example `cpty_example`

        Counterparty identifier for the recipient.

      - **`counterpartyAccountId`** · `string` · required · example `cpa_example`

        Counterparty account identifier for the recipient.

      - **`destination`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Resolved Solana destination address.

      - **`amount`** · `string` · required · example `100.00`

        Token amount in UI units (decimal string).

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `pending`, `processing`, `confirmed`, `failed`, `archived` · example `pending`

        Transfer batch recipient status.

      - **`error`** · `string | null` · required

        Recipient-level failure reason, when available.

      - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

      - **`updatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

    - **`transfers`** · `object[]`

      Payment transfer chunk records associated with this batch.

      - **`fireblocks`** · `object`

        Native Fireblocks transfer tracking. A processing payment may await approval in Fireblocks; network fees are paid by its source vault. A missing transaction ID means submission is still being reconciled. Do not create a replacement payment while its outcome is unknown.

        - **`transactionId`** · `string | null` · required

        - **`status`** · `string` · required

        - **`subStatus`** · `string | null` · required

      - **`id`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `xfr_example`

        Transfer identifier (SDP record ID, not the on-chain signature).

      - **`organizationId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `org_example`

        Organization identifier.

      - **`custodyWalletId`** · `string | null` · required · example `cwlt_example`

        Exact SDP Wallet ID associated with the persisted transfer, or null for unresolved legacy and observed rows.

      - **`providerWalletId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `privy_wallet_123`

        Provider wallet ID retained as evidence; not an execution selector.

      - **`projectId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

        Project identifier for the transfer.

      - **`type`** · `string` · required · one of `transfer`, `transfer_batch`, `onramp`, `offramp` · example `transfer`

        Transfer type.

      - **`kind`** · `string` · required · one of `pay`, `confidential_pay`, `batch_pay`, `recurring_pay`, `deposit`, `request_deposit`, `onramp`, `offramp`

        Dashboard transaction kind derived from the transfer type and originating Payments resource.

      - **`direction`** · `string` · required · one of `inbound`, `outbound` · example `outbound`

        Transfer direction.

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `pending`, `processing`, `confirmed`, `finalized`, `failed`, `awaiting_payment`, `settling`, `completed`, `canceled`, `expired` · example `confirmed`

        Transfer status.

      - **`signature`** · `string | null` · required · example `sig_example`

        Solana transaction signature (tx id/hash).

      - **`serializedTx`** · `string | null` · required · min length 1 · example `base64_tx_example`

        Base64-encoded transaction payload, if available. Always null for transfer batch chunks, whose signed bytes stay server-side.

      - **`slot`** · `integer | null` · required · example `123456`

        Slot number, if confirmed.

      - **`blockTime`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        Block time, if confirmed.

      - **`confirmedAt`** · `string` · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        When SDP confirmed the transfer. A ramp is confirmed once its delivery is verified onchain.

      - **`fee`** · `integer | null` · required · example `5000`

        Transaction fee in lamports.

      - **`error`** · `string | null` · required · example `Signature failed`

        Error message if the transaction failed.

      - **`initiatedBy`** · `object`

        Initiator that triggered the transfer.

        - **`type`** · `string` · required · one of `api_key`, `user`, `system` · example `api_key`

          Initiator type.

        - **`id`** · `string`

          Initiator identifier if applicable.

        - **`display`** · `string`

          Human-friendly label for the initiator.

      - **`source`** · `string` · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Source wallet address.

      - **`destination`** · `string` · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Destination wallet address.

      - **`memo`** · `string` · max length 256

        Optional memo for the transfer.

      - **`rampsMemo`** · `object` · required

        Free-form key-value memo for offchain reconciliation of ramp transfers. At most 20 entries.

        - **`*`** · `string` · min length 1 · max length 256

      - **`token`** · `string`

        Token symbol or mint address.

      - **`amount`** · `string` · example `100.00`

        Token amount in UI units (decimal string).

      - **`provider`** · `string` · one of `moonpay`, `stripe`, `hercle`, `mural`, `moneygram`, `lightspark`, `coinbase`, `bvnk` · example `moonpay`

        Ramp provider for on-ramp and off-ramp transfer records. A retired provider's records keep its id.

      - **`counterpartyId`** · `string` · example `cpty_example`

        Counterparty tied to the transfer record, when available.

      - **`counterpartyDisplayName`** · `string` · example `Acme Studio`

        Current display name of the counterparty tied to the transfer.

      - **`providerReference`** · `string` · example `ramp_quote_example`

        Provider quote or transaction reference used for ramp correlation.

      - **`deliveryMode`** · `string` · one of `hosted`, `manual_instructions`, `session_widget` · example `session_widget`

        Ramp delivery mode. Hosted flows require the customer to complete a provider-hosted UI; manual instructions require the customer to fund displayed instructions; session widgets use a provider SDK session.

      - **`fiatCurrency`** · `string` · example `USD`

        Fiat currency for the ramp leg.

      - **`fiatAmount`** · `string` · example `100.00`

        Quoted fiat amount for the ramp leg: what the customer pays on an on-ramp, the payout quoted on an off-ramp. It never changes after the quote; an off-ramp's final payout is `fiatPayout`.

      - **`settlement`** · `object`

        Provider-reported ramp settlement economics for live providers.

        - **`provider`** · `string` · required · always `moonpay`

        - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `completed`, `failed`

        - **`transactionId`** · `string` · required

          MoonPay transaction id.

        - **`baseCurrencyCode`** · `string` · required

          Fiat currency paid.

        - **`baseCurrencyAmount`** · `number` · required

          Fiat amount paid.

        - **`quoteCurrencyCode`** · `string` · required

          Crypto currency purchased.

        - **`quoteCurrencyAmount`** · `number` · required

          Crypto amount purchased.

        - **`feeAmount`** · `number` · required

          Provider fee.

        - **`extraFeeAmount`** · `number` · required

          Extra provider fee.

        - **`networkFeeAmount`** · `number` · required

          Network fee.

        - **`areFeesIncluded`** · `boolean` · required

          Whether the fees are included in the paid amount.

        - **`usdRate`** · `number` · required

          USD exchange rate.

        - **`cryptoTransactionId`** · `string`

          On-chain transaction id.

        - **`failureReason`** · `string`

          Provider failure reason.

      - **`fiatPayout`** · `object`

        What the provider reports paying out once it settles an off-ramp sale. Provider-reported: SDP cannot verify a bank payout.

        - **`amount`** · `string` · required · example `20.82`

          Fiat paid out, in display units. Differs from the quoted `fiatAmount` when the provider re-prices the sale at receipt.

        - **`currency`** · `string` · required · example `USD`

          ISO currency of the payout, as the provider reports it.

        - **`reportedAt`** · `string` · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-02T00:00:00.000Z`

          When the provider reported the payout.

      - **`deliveryMismatch`** · `object`

        Present while SDP holds a provider-settled ramp in `settling` because the chain contradicts the provider's delivery. A new provider report clears it.

        - **`reason`** · `string` · required · one of `provider_report_mismatch`, `transaction_failed`, `predates_transfer`, `not_delivered`, `amount_mismatch`, `transaction_not_found` · example `amount_mismatch`

          Why the chain contradicts the provider: `provider_report_mismatch` (its report contradicts SDP's record), `transaction_failed`, `predates_transfer` (the transaction landed before the transfer), `not_delivered` (nothing of the quoted asset reached the quoted wallet), `amount_mismatch`, or `transaction_not_found` (no finalized transaction an hour after the report; SDP keeps checking, and a later delivery completes the transfer).

        - **`checkedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-02T00:00:00.000Z`

          When SDP's delivery check reached this verdict.

        - **`reportedAmount`** · `string` · example `20`

          What the provider reported delivering, in display units.

        - **`observedAmount`** · `string` · example `0.5`

          What the chain shows the quoted wallet received, in display units.

      - **`risk`** · `object`

        Optional risk evaluation for the transfer.

        - **`provider`** · `string` · required · example `trm`

          Risk scoring provider.

        - **`score`** · `string` · required · example `0.12`

          Provider-specific risk score.

        - **`level`** · `string` · required · one of `low`, `medium`, `high`, `unknown` · example `low`

          Risk level classification.

        - **`evaluatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

          Timestamp when risk was evaluated.

      - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        Creation timestamp.

      - **`updatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-02T00:00:00.000Z`

        Last update timestamp.

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `transfer_batches.read` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `401`.

- **`404`** Not Found

  Same fields as `401`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `401`.

## Payments: Recurring payments

### Create recurring payment
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/payments/create-payment-recurring-payment

> Creates an SDP-custody outbound recurring payment intent from a custody wallet to a counterparty crypto-wallet account.

`POST /v1/payments/recurring-payments`

This stores backend state only; activation and collection are added by follow-up endpoints.

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `recurring.manage` action.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Selects the active project for this request. Required for Clerk (dashboard) callers. Ignored when authenticating with an API key, whose scope is fixed to the key's project.

- **`Idempotency-Key`** · `string` · required · pattern `^[\x20-\x7e]{1,255}$` · example `idempotency_example_12345`

  Required: a request without one returns 400 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED`. 1-255 printable ASCII characters; send a UUID per logical operation and reuse it on every retry. Within 24 hours, a retry with the same key and the same request returns the stored status and body with the response header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`. Keys are scoped to the credential: within 24 hours, the same key with a different request, or from a different credential, returns 422 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED`; after that, the same key from a different credential runs as a new request. A rotated API key is a new credential, so after any rotation read the resource with GET to see whether the original request ran, and never resend a money request under the new credential without checking first. A key whose original request is still running returns 409 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_IN_FLIGHT` with `Retry-After`. A 400, 401, 403, 409 or 429 refusal is not stored, so the same key runs again once the cause is fixed. Access is checked before the key on every request, so a refused request never claims the key, and a credential that has since lost access to the named resource gets 403 instead of the stored response. A replay is a snapshot of the original response: read the current state with GET instead of sending the request again. If the original request never recorded its outcome (it crashed), a same-key retry gets 409 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_IN_FLIGHT` until 15 minutes plus the route's lease have passed since the original was sent (about 16 minutes, or about 20 for transfer batches), then takes over and is answered from the record it wrote. After a 5xx, a retry with the same key runs again and answers from the original record instead of acting twice; that answer also carries `Idempotent-Replayed: true`.

## Request body

`application/json` · required

Creates an SDP-custody outbound recurring payment intent. Activation and collection are added by follow-up endpoints.

- **`sourceCustodyWalletId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `cwlt_example`

  Exact SDP Wallet ID (`id` from `GET /v1/wallets`) that will fund the recurring payment. Provider `walletId`, wallet addresses, and the legacy `sourceWalletId` selector are not accepted.

- **`counterpartyId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `cpty_example`

  Counterparty receiving the recurring payment.

- **`counterpartyAccountId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `cpa_example`

  Counterparty crypto_wallet account. It must contain Solana wallet details.

- **`token`** · `string` · required · example `EPjFWdd5AufqSSqeM2qN1xzybapC8G4wEGGkZwyTDt1v`

  Token mint address or well-known symbol. Must be a USD stablecoin (e.g. USDC) or a token issued in this project; native SOL is not supported.

- **`amount`** · `string` · required · example `25.00`

  Recurring payment amount in UI units.

- **`periodHours`** · `integer` · required · greater than 0 · max 8760 · example `720`

  Billing period length in hours.

- **`firstCollectionAt`** · `string` · format `date-time` · example `2099-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

  Optional first collection timestamp. Defaults to activation time when omitted.

- **`metadataUri`** · `string` · format `uri` · max length 128 · example `https://example.com/subscriptions/monthly-usdc.json`

  Optional plan metadata URI.

## Responses

- **`201`** Recurring payment created

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    Recurring payment response payload.

    - **`recurringPayment`** · `object` · required

      SDP-custody outbound recurring payment record.

      - **`id`** · `string` · required · example `prp_example`

        SDP recurring payment ID.

      - **`organizationId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `org_example`

        Organization identifier.

      - **`projectId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

        Project identifier.

      - **`sourceCustodyWalletId`** · `string | null` · required · example `cwlt_example`

        Exact source SDP Wallet ID, or null for unresolved legacy records.

      - **`sourceProviderWalletId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `privy_wallet_123`

        Source Provider wallet ID retained as evidence.

      - **`sourceAddress`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Source wallet address.

      - **`counterpartyId`** · `string` · required · example `cpty_example`

        Counterparty ID.

      - **`counterpartyAccountId`** · `string` · required · example `cpa_example`

        Counterparty account ID.

      - **`destinationAddress`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Counterparty wallet owner address.

      - **`destinationTokenAccount`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Derived counterparty token account used for collection.

      - **`token`** · `string` · required

        SPL token mint address.

      - **`amount`** · `string` · required · example `100.00`

        Token amount in UI units (decimal string).

      - **`periodHours`** · `integer` · required · greater than 0 · example `720`

      - **`firstCollectionAt`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        Requested first collection timestamp.

      - **`nextCollectionDueAt`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        Next due collection timestamp.

      - **`planId`** · `string | null` · required

        Linked SDP subscription plan ID.

      - **`subscriptionId`** · `string | null` · required

        Linked SDP subscription ID.

      - **`planPda`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        On-chain plan PDA.

      - **`planCreatedAt`** · `string | null` · required

        On-chain plan createdAt value as an unsigned integer string.

      - **`planCreationSignature`** · `string | null` · required

        Solana signature for plan creation.

      - **`subscriptionPda`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        On-chain subscription PDA.

      - **`subscriptionAuthorityAddress`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        On-chain subscription authority address.

      - **`authorizationSignature`** · `string | null` · required

        Solana signature for subscription authorization.

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `pending_activation`, `activating`, `active`, `updating`, `canceling`, `resuming`, `paused`, `canceled`, `expired` · example `active`

        Recurring payment status.

      - **`metadataUri`** · `string | null` · required

        Optional plan metadata URI.

      - **`createdBy`** · `string | null` · required

        Creator user ID or API key ID.

      - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

      - **`updatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `recurring.manage` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`404`** Not Found

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`409`** Conflict

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`422`** Unprocessable Entity

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `400`.

## Example request

```bash tab="cURL"
curl -X POST 'https://api.solana.com/v1/payments/recurring-payments' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SDP_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "sourceCustodyWalletId": "cwlt_example",
    "counterpartyId": "cpty_example",
    "counterpartyAccountId": "cpa_example",
    "token": "EPjFWdd5AufqSSqeM2qN1xzybapC8G4wEGGkZwyTDt1v",
    "amount": "25.00",
    "periodHours": 720,
    "firstCollectionAt": "2099-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
    "metadataUri": "https://example.com/subscriptions/monthly-usdc.json"
  }'
```

```ts tab="TypeScript"
const res = await fetch("https://api.solana.com/v1/payments/recurring-payments", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.SDP_API_KEY}`,
    "Idempotency-Key": crypto.randomUUID(),
    "Content-Type": "application/json"
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({
    "sourceCustodyWalletId": "cwlt_example",
    "counterpartyId": "cpty_example",
    "counterpartyAccountId": "cpa_example",
    "token": "EPjFWdd5AufqSSqeM2qN1xzybapC8G4wEGGkZwyTDt1v",
    "amount": "25.00",
    "periodHours": 720,
    "firstCollectionAt": "2099-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
    "metadataUri": "https://example.com/subscriptions/monthly-usdc.json"
  })
});
```

```python tab="Python"

    "periodHours": 720,

  })
```

### Update recurring payment
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/payments/update-payment-recurring-payment

> Updates an SDP-custody recurring payment.

`PATCH /v1/payments/recurring-payments/{id}`

Pending records are updated directly. Active metadata and due-date edits are applied in place, while active term, source, destination, or token edits create a replacement Solana subscription, authorize it, cancel the old subscription, and then swap the recurring payment to the replacement records. Requires an Idempotency-Key, because an edit can sign and broadcast a replacement subscription. A same-key retry of a completed edit replays its answer. A retry of an interrupted edit gets 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_IN_FLIGHT with Retry-After until the attempt is stale, then resumes from the last step SDP recorded. If a step was sent but not yet recorded when the edit was interrupted, which is rare, the retry can fail or send that step again, so read the recurring payment with GET before editing it again.

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `recurring.execute` action.

## Path parameters

- **`id`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `prp_example`

  SDP recurring payment record ID.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Selects the active project for this request. Required for Clerk (dashboard) callers. Ignored when authenticating with an API key, whose scope is fixed to the key's project.

- **`Idempotency-Key`** · `string` · required · pattern `^[\x20-\x7e]{1,255}$` · example `idempotency_example_12345`

  Required: a request without one returns 400 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED`. 1-255 printable ASCII characters; send a UUID per logical operation and reuse it on every retry. Within 24 hours, a retry with the same key and the same request returns the stored status and body with the response header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`. Keys are scoped to the credential: within 24 hours, the same key with a different request, or from a different credential, returns 422 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED`; after that, the same key from a different credential runs as a new request. A rotated API key is a new credential, so after any rotation read the resource with GET to see whether the original request ran, and never resend a money request under the new credential without checking first. A key whose original request is still running returns 409 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_IN_FLIGHT` with `Retry-After`. A 400, 401, 403, 409 or 429 refusal is not stored, so the same key runs again once the cause is fixed. Access is checked before the key on every request, so a refused request never claims the key, and a credential that has since lost access to the named resource gets 403 instead of the stored response. A replay is a snapshot of the original response: read the current state with GET instead of sending the request again. If the original request never recorded its outcome (it crashed), a same-key retry gets 409 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_IN_FLIGHT` until 15 minutes plus the route's lease have passed since the original was sent (about 16 minutes, or about 20 for transfer batches), then takes over and is answered from the record it wrote. After a 5xx, a retry with the same key runs again and answers from the original record instead of acting twice; that answer also carries `Idempotent-Replayed: true`.

## Request body

`application/json` · required

Updates a recurring payment. Pending payments are edited directly. Active metadata or due-date updates are applied in place, while active term/source/destination/token updates create and authorize a replacement subscription before canceling the old one.

- **`sourceCustodyWalletId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `cwlt_example`

  Optional exact replacement SDP Wallet ID (`id` from `GET /v1/wallets`). Provider `walletId`, wallet addresses, and the legacy `sourceWalletId` selector are not accepted. Active replacements require write access to both the old and new source wallets.

- **`counterpartyId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `cpty_example`

  Optional replacement counterparty. When provided, counterpartyAccountId is also required.

- **`counterpartyAccountId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `cpa_example`

  Optional replacement counterparty account. Without counterpartyId, this changes the account for the current counterparty.

- **`token`** · `string` · example `EPjFWdd5AufqSSqeM2qN1xzybapC8G4wEGGkZwyTDt1v`

  Optional replacement token. Must be a USD stablecoin (e.g. USDC) or a token issued in this project; native SOL is not supported.

- **`amount`** · `string` · example `25.00`

  Optional replacement amount in UI units.

- **`periodHours`** · `integer` · greater than 0 · max 8760 · example `720`

  Optional replacement billing period length in hours. Active term changes create a replacement on-chain subscription.

- **`firstCollectionAt`** · `string | null` · format `date-time` · example `2099-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

  Pending-only first collection timestamp. Use null to clear the pending first collection override.

- **`nextCollectionDueAt`** · `string | null` · format `date-time` · example `2099-02-01T00:00:00.000Z`

  Active-only next due timestamp. Use null to reset to the earliest eligible collection time.

- **`metadataUri`** · `string | null` · format `uri` · max length 128 · example `https://example.com/subscriptions/monthly-usdc.json`

  Optional plan metadata URI. Use null to clear it. Active metadata-only edits update the existing on-chain plan in place.

## Responses

- **`200`** Recurring payment updated

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    Recurring payment response payload.

    - **`recurringPayment`** · `object` · required

      SDP-custody outbound recurring payment record.

      - **`id`** · `string` · required · example `prp_example`

        SDP recurring payment ID.

      - **`organizationId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `org_example`

        Source wallet address.

      - **`counterpartyId`** · `string` · required · example `cpty_example`

        Counterparty ID.

### Activate recurring payment
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/payments/activate-payment-recurring-payment

> Activates a pending SDP-custody recurring payment by creating the Solana subscriptions plan, authorizing the subscription, and storing the resulting on-chain identifiers and signatures.

`POST /v1/payments/recurring-payments/{id}/activate`

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `recurring.execute` action.

## Path parameters

- **`id`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `prp_example`

  SDP recurring payment record ID.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Selects the active project for this request. Required for Clerk (dashboard) callers. Ignored when authenticating with an API key, whose scope is fixed to the key's project.

- **`Idempotency-Key`** · `string` · required · pattern `^[\x20-\x7e]{1,255}$` · example `idempotency_example_12345`

  Required: a request without one returns 400 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED`. 1-255 printable ASCII characters; send a UUID per logical operation and reuse it on every retry. Within 24 hours, a retry with the same key and the same request returns the stored status and body with the response header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`. Keys are scoped to the credential: within 24 hours, the same key with a different request, or from a different credential, returns 422 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED`; after that, the same key from a different credential runs as a new request. A rotated API key is a new credential, so after any rotation read the resource with GET to see whether the original request ran, and never resend a money request under the new credential without checking first. A key whose original request is still running returns 409 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_IN_FLIGHT` with `Retry-After`. A 400, 401, 403, 409 or 429 refusal is not stored, so the same key runs again once the cause is fixed. Access is checked before the key on every request, so a refused request never claims the key, and a credential that has since lost access to the named resource gets 403 instead of the stored response. A replay is a snapshot of the original response: read the current state with GET instead of sending the request again. If the original request never recorded its outcome (it crashed), a same-key retry gets 409 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_IN_FLIGHT` until 15 minutes plus the route's lease have passed since the original was sent (about 16 minutes, or about 20 for transfer batches), then takes over and is answered from the record it wrote. After a 5xx, a retry with the same key runs again and answers from the original record instead of acting twice; that answer also carries `Idempotent-Replayed: true`.

## Responses

- **`200`** Recurring payment activated

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    Recurring payment response payload.

    - **`recurringPayment`** · `object` · required

      SDP-custody outbound recurring payment record.

      - **`id`** · `string` · required · example `prp_example`

        SDP recurring payment ID.

      - **`organizationId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `org_example`

        Organization identifier.

      - **`projectId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

        Project identifier.

      - **`sourceCustodyWalletId`** · `string | null` · required · example `cwlt_example`

        Exact source SDP Wallet ID, or null for unresolved legacy records.

      - **`sourceProviderWalletId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `privy_wallet_123`

        Source Provider wallet ID retained as evidence.

      - **`sourceAddress`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Source wallet address.

      - **`counterpartyId`** · `string` · required · example `cpty_example`

        Counterparty ID.

      - **`counterpartyAccountId`** · `string` · required · example `cpa_example`

        Counterparty account ID.

      - **`destinationAddress`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Counterparty wallet owner address.

      - **`destinationTokenAccount`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Derived counterparty token account used for collection.

      - **`token`** · `string` · required

        SPL token mint address.

      - **`amount`** · `string` · required · example `100.00`

        Token amount in UI units (decimal string).

      - **`periodHours`** · `integer` · required · greater than 0 · example `720`

      - **`firstCollectionAt`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        Requested first collection timestamp.

      - **`nextCollectionDueAt`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        Next due collection timestamp.

      - **`planId`** · `string | null` · required

        Linked SDP subscription plan ID.

      - **`subscriptionId`** · `string | null` · required

        Linked SDP subscription ID.

      - **`planPda`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        On-chain plan PDA.

      - **`planCreatedAt`** · `string | null` · required

        On-chain plan createdAt value as an unsigned integer string.

      - **`planCreationSignature`** · `string | null` · required

      - **`subscriptionPda`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`
