### Collect recurring payment
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/payments/collect-payment-recurring-payment

> Manually starts a due active SDP-custody recurring payment collection, creating a linked payment transfer and collection attempt.

`POST /v1/payments/recurring-payments/{id}/collect`

If submission cannot be confirmed immediately, a 200 response returns the same transfer as `processing` with its known signature; reconciliation settles it, and the next due time advances only after exact on-chain confirmation.

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `recurring.execute` action.

## Path parameters

- **`id`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `prp_example`

  SDP recurring payment record ID.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Selects the active project for this request. Required for Clerk (dashboard) callers. Ignored when authenticating with an API key, whose scope is fixed to the key's project.

- **`Idempotency-Key`** · `string` · required · pattern `^[\x20-\x7e]{1,255}$` · example `idempotency_example_12345`

  Required: a request without one returns 400 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED`. 1-255 printable ASCII characters; send a UUID per logical operation and reuse it on every retry. Within 24 hours, a retry with the same key and the same request returns the stored status and body with the response header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`. Keys are scoped to the credential: within 24 hours, the same key with a different request, or from a different credential, returns 422 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED`; after that, the same key from a different credential runs as a new request. A rotated API key is a new credential, so after any rotation read the resource with GET to see whether the original request ran, and never resend a money request under the new credential without checking first. A key whose original request is still running returns 409 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_IN_FLIGHT` with `Retry-After`. A 400, 401, 403, 409 or 429 refusal is not stored, so the same key runs again once the cause is fixed. Access is checked before the key on every request, so a refused request never claims the key, and a credential that has since lost access to the named resource gets 403 instead of the stored response. A replay is a snapshot of the original response: read the current state with GET instead of sending the request again. If the original request never recorded its outcome (it crashed), a same-key retry gets 409 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_IN_FLIGHT` until 15 minutes plus the route's lease have passed since the original was sent (about 16 minutes, or about 20 for transfer batches), then takes over and is answered from the record it wrote. After a 5xx, a retry with the same key runs again and answers from the original record instead of acting twice; that answer also carries `Idempotent-Replayed: true`.

      - **`sourceAddress`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Source wallet address.

        Requested first collection timestamp.

      - **`nextCollectionDueAt`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        Next due collection timestamp.

      - **`planId`** · `string | null` · required

        Linked SDP subscription plan ID.

      - **`subscriptionId`** · `string | null` · required

        Linked SDP subscription ID.

      - **`planPda`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        On-chain plan PDA.

      - **`planCreatedAt`** · `string | null` · required

        On-chain plan createdAt value as an unsigned integer string.

      - **`planCreationSignature`** · `string | null` · required

      - **`amount`** · `string` · required · example `100.00`

          - **`transferId`** · `string` · required

      - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

      - **`updatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

    - **`transfer`** · `object` · required

      Transfer transaction record.

      - **`fireblocks`** · `object`

        Native Fireblocks transfer tracking. A processing payment may await approval in Fireblocks; network fees are paid by its source vault. A missing transaction ID means submission is still being reconciled. Do not create a replacement payment while its outcome is unknown.

        - **`transactionId`** · `string | null` · required

        - **`status`** · `string` · required

        - **`subStatus`** · `string | null` · required

      - **`id`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `xfr_example`

        Transfer identifier (SDP record ID, not the on-chain signature).

      - **`organizationId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `org_example`

        Organization identifier.

      - **`custodyWalletId`** · `string | null` · required · example `cwlt_example`

      - **`providerWalletId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `privy_wallet_123`

        Provider wallet ID retained as evidence; not an execution selector.

      - **`projectId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

        Project identifier for the transfer.

      - **`type`** · `string` · required · one of `transfer`, `transfer_batch`, `onramp`, `offramp` · example `transfer`

        Transfer type.

      - **`kind`** · `string` · required · one of `pay`, `confidential_pay`, `batch_pay`, `recurring_pay`, `deposit`, `request_deposit`, `onramp`, `offramp`

      - **`direction`** · `string` · required · one of `inbound`, `outbound` · example `outbound`

        Transfer direction.

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `pending`, `processing`, `confirmed`, `finalized`, `failed`, `awaiting_payment`, `settling`, `completed`, `canceled`, `expired` · example `confirmed`

        Transfer status.

      - **`signature`** · `string | null` · required · example `sig_example`

        Solana transaction signature (tx id/hash).

      - **`serializedTx`** · `string | null` · required · min length 1 · example `base64_tx_example`

        Base64-encoded transaction payload, if available. Always null for transfer batch chunks, whose signed bytes stay server-side.

      - **`slot`** · `integer | null` · required · example `123456`

        Slot number, if confirmed.

        Block time, if confirmed.

        When SDP confirmed the transfer. A ramp is confirmed once its delivery is verified onchain.

      - **`fee`** · `integer | null` · required · example `5000`

        Transaction fee in lamports.

      - **`error`** · `string | null` · required · example `Signature failed`

        Error message if the transaction failed.

      - **`initiatedBy`** · `object`

        Initiator that triggered the transfer.

        - **`type`** · `string` · required · one of `api_key`, `user`, `system` · example `api_key`

          Initiator type.

        - **`id`** · `string`

          Initiator identifier if applicable.

        - **`display`** · `string`

          Human-friendly label for the initiator.

      - **`source`** · `string` · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Source wallet address.

      - **`destination`** · `string` · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Destination wallet address.

      - **`memo`** · `string` · max length 256

        Optional memo for the transfer.

      - **`rampsMemo`** · `object` · required

        Free-form key-value memo for offchain reconciliation of ramp transfers. At most 20 entries.

        - **`*`** · `string` · min length 1 · max length 256

      - **`token`** · `string`

        Token symbol or mint address.

      - **`amount`** · `string` · example `100.00`

        Token amount in UI units (decimal string).

      - **`provider`** · `string` · one of `moonpay`, `stripe`, `hercle`, `mural`, `moneygram`, `lightspark`, `coinbase`, `bvnk` · example `moonpay`

        Ramp provider for on-ramp and off-ramp transfer records. A retired provider's records keep its id.

      - **`counterpartyId`** · `string` · example `cpty_example`

        Counterparty tied to the transfer record, when available.

      - **`counterpartyDisplayName`** · `string` · example `Acme Studio`

        Current display name of the counterparty tied to the transfer.

      - **`providerReference`** · `string` · example `ramp_quote_example`

        Provider quote or transaction reference used for ramp correlation.

      - **`deliveryMode`** · `string` · one of `hosted`, `manual_instructions`, `session_widget` · example `session_widget`

        Ramp delivery mode. Hosted flows require the customer to complete a provider-hosted UI; manual instructions require the customer to fund displayed instructions; session widgets use a provider SDK session.

      - **`fiatCurrency`** · `string` · example `USD`

        Fiat currency for the ramp leg.

      - **`fiatAmount`** · `string` · example `100.00`

        Quoted fiat amount for the ramp leg: what the customer pays on an on-ramp, the payout quoted on an off-ramp. It never changes after the quote; an off-ramp's final payout is `fiatPayout`.

      - **`settlement`** · `object`

        Provider-reported ramp settlement economics for live providers.

        - **`provider`** · `string` · required · always `moonpay`

        - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `completed`, `failed`

        - **`transactionId`** · `string` · required

          MoonPay transaction id.

        - **`baseCurrencyCode`** · `string` · required

          Fiat currency paid.

        - **`baseCurrencyAmount`** · `number` · required

          Fiat amount paid.

        - **`quoteCurrencyCode`** · `string` · required

          Crypto currency purchased.

        - **`quoteCurrencyAmount`** · `number` · required

          Crypto amount purchased.

        - **`feeAmount`** · `number` · required

          Provider fee.

        - **`extraFeeAmount`** · `number` · required

          Extra provider fee.

        - **`networkFeeAmount`** · `number` · required

          Network fee.

        - **`areFeesIncluded`** · `boolean` · required

          Whether the fees are included in the paid amount.

        - **`usdRate`** · `number` · required

          USD exchange rate.

        - **`cryptoTransactionId`** · `string`

          On-chain transaction id.

        - **`failureReason`** · `string`

          Provider failure reason.

      - **`fiatPayout`** · `object`

        What the provider reports paying out once it settles an off-ramp sale. Provider-reported: SDP cannot verify a bank payout.

        - **`amount`** · `string` · required · example `20.82`

          Fiat paid out, in display units. Differs from the quoted `fiatAmount` when the provider re-prices the sale at receipt.

        - **`currency`** · `string` · required · example `USD`

          ISO currency of the payout, as the provider reports it.

        - **`reportedAt`** · `string` · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-02T00:00:00.000Z`

          When the provider reported the payout.

      - **`deliveryMismatch`** · `object`

        Present while SDP holds a provider-settled ramp in `settling` because the chain contradicts the provider's delivery. A new provider report clears it.

        - **`reason`** · `string` · required · one of `provider_report_mismatch`, `transaction_failed`, `predates_transfer`, `not_delivered`, `amount_mismatch`, `transaction_not_found` · example `amount_mismatch`

          Why the chain contradicts the provider: `provider_report_mismatch` (its report contradicts SDP's record), `transaction_failed`, `predates_transfer` (the transaction landed before the transfer), `not_delivered` (nothing of the quoted asset reached the quoted wallet), `amount_mismatch`, or `transaction_not_found` (no finalized transaction an hour after the report; SDP keeps checking, and a later delivery completes the transfer).

        - **`checkedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-02T00:00:00.000Z`

          When SDP's delivery check reached this verdict.

        - **`reportedAmount`** · `string` · example `20`

          What the provider reported delivering, in display units.

        - **`observedAmount`** · `string` · example `0.5`

          What the chain shows the quoted wallet received, in display units.

      - **`risk`** · `object`

        Optional risk evaluation for the transfer.

        - **`provider`** · `string` · required · example `trm`

          Risk scoring provider.

        - **`score`** · `string` · required · example `0.12`

          Provider-specific risk score.

        - **`level`** · `string` · required · one of `low`, `medium`, `high`, `unknown` · example `low`

          Risk level classification.

        - **`evaluatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

          Timestamp when risk was evaluated.

      - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        Creation timestamp.

      - **`updatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-02T00:00:00.000Z`

        Last update timestamp.

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `recurring.execute` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`404`** Not Found

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`409`** Conflict

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`422`** Unprocessable Entity

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `400`.

### Resume recurring payment
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/payments/resume-payment-recurring-payment

> Resumes a canceled SDP-custody recurring payment by submitting the Solana subscriptions resume transaction and restoring the recurring payment to active status.

`POST /v1/payments/recurring-payments/{id}/resume`

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `recurring.execute` action.

## Path parameters

- **`id`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `prp_example`

  SDP recurring payment record ID.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Selects the active project for this request. Required for Clerk (dashboard) callers. Ignored when authenticating with an API key, whose scope is fixed to the key's project.

- **`Idempotency-Key`** · `string` · required · pattern `^[\x20-\x7e]{1,255}$` · example `idempotency_example_12345`

  Required: a request without one returns 400 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED`. 1-255 printable ASCII characters; send a UUID per logical operation and reuse it on every retry. Within 24 hours, a retry with the same key and the same request returns the stored status and body with the response header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`. Keys are scoped to the credential: within 24 hours, the same key with a different request, or from a different credential, returns 422 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED`; after that, the same key from a different credential runs as a new request. A rotated API key is a new credential, so after any rotation read the resource with GET to see whether the original request ran, and never resend a money request under the new credential without checking first. A key whose original request is still running returns 409 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_IN_FLIGHT` with `Retry-After`. A 400, 401, 403, 409 or 429 refusal is not stored, so the same key runs again once the cause is fixed. Access is checked before the key on every request, so a refused request never claims the key, and a credential that has since lost access to the named resource gets 403 instead of the stored response. A replay is a snapshot of the original response: read the current state with GET instead of sending the request again. If the original request never recorded its outcome (it crashed), a same-key retry gets 409 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_IN_FLIGHT` until 15 minutes plus the route's lease have passed since the original was sent (about 16 minutes, or about 20 for transfer batches), then takes over and is answered from the record it wrote. After a 5xx, a retry with the same key runs again and answers from the original record instead of acting twice; that answer also carries `Idempotent-Replayed: true`.

## Responses

- **`200`** Recurring payment resumed

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

      - **`sourceAddress`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Source wallet address.

## Payments: Payment requests

### Cancel payment request
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/payments/cancel-payment-request

> Cancels an open payment request, so its payment link stops building and sponsoring transactions.

`POST /v1/payments/requests/{paymentRequestId}/cancel`

Requires `payment_requests.manage`. Canceling a request that is already canceled returns it unchanged. A paid or expired request returns 409, and so does one whose fee-sponsored transaction can still land: retry once that transaction's blockhash expires. A payer who signed before the cancel can still land the payment; SDP records it as paid, with `paidLate` set when it landed after the cancel.

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `payment_requests.manage` action.

## Path parameters

- **`paymentRequestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `preq_example`

  SDP payment request ID.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Selects the active project for this request. Required for Clerk (dashboard) callers. Ignored when authenticating with an API key, whose scope is fixed to the key's project.

- **`Idempotency-Key`** · `string` · pattern `^[\x20-\x7e]{1,255}$` · example `idempotency_example_12345`

  Optional, and honored when sent. 1-255 printable ASCII characters; send a UUID per logical operation and reuse it on every retry. Within 24 hours, a retry with the same key and the same request returns the stored status and body with the response header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`. Keys are scoped to the credential: within 24 hours, the same key with a different request, or from a different credential, returns 422 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED`; after that, the same key from a different credential runs as a new request. A rotated API key is a new credential, so after any rotation read the resource with GET to see whether the original request ran, and never resend a money request under the new credential without checking first. A key whose original request is still running returns 409 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_IN_FLIGHT` with `Retry-After`. A 400, 401, 403, 409 or 429 refusal is not stored, so the same key runs again once the cause is fixed. Access is checked before the key on every request, so a refused request never claims the key, and a credential that has since lost access to the named resource gets 403 instead of the stored response. A replay is a snapshot of the original response: read the current state with GET instead of sending the request again. If the original request never recorded its outcome (it crashed), a same-key retry gets 409 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_IN_FLIGHT` until 15 minutes plus the route's lease have passed since the original was sent (about 16 minutes, or about 20 for transfer batches), then 409 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN` with no `Retry-After`, as does every later retry with that key: read the resource with GET to see whether it ran, then send again with a new key. After a 5xx, a retry with the same key runs again and answers from the original record instead of acting twice; that answer also carries `Idempotent-Replayed: true`.

## Responses

- **`200`** Payment request canceled

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    A payment request. Reads never carry its link token.

    - **`id`** · `string` · required · example `preq_example`

      SDP payment request ID.

    - **`organizationId`** · `string` · required

      Organization ID.

    - **`projectId`** · `string | null` · required

      Project ID.

    - **`walletId`** · `string` · required

      Receiving custody wallet's provider ID.

    - **`destinationAddress`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

      Address the payment is sent to.

    - **`token`** · `string` · required

      Token mint address.

    - **`amount`** · `string` · required · example `100.00`

      Token amount in UI units (decimal string).

    - **`reference`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

      Solana Pay reference account that identifies the payment on chain.

    - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `awaiting_payment`, `paid`, `canceled`, `expired` · example `canceled`

      Payment request status. `awaiting_payment` is open; `paid` was settled by an on-chain payment; `canceled` and `expired` closed without one.

    - **`expiresAt`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      Expiry, if any.

    - **`fulfilledByTransferId`** · `string | null` · required

      The inbound transfer that paid the request.

    - **`paidLate`** · `boolean` · required

      Whether the payment landed after the request expired or was canceled. A payer who signed before then can still pay.

    - **`lastCheckedAt`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      When SDP last read the chain for the payment.

    - **`canceledByApiKeyId`** · `string | null` · required

      The API key that canceled the request; null when a member did, or it is not canceled.

    - **`canceledByUserId`** · `string | null` · required

      User ID of the member who canceled the request; null when an API key did, or it is not canceled.

    - **`canceledAt`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      When it was canceled.

    - **`lifecycle`** · `object[]` · required

      Every status the request entered, oldest first.

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `awaiting_payment`, `paid`, `canceled`, `expired` · example `canceled`

        Payment request status. `awaiting_payment` is open; `paid` was settled by an on-chain payment; `canceled` and `expired` closed without one.

      - **`at`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

    - **`createdBy`** · `string | null` · required

      User ID of the member, or of the API key's creator, who created it.

    - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

    - **`updatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `payment_requests.manage` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`404`** Not Found

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`409`** Conflict

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`422`** Unprocessable Entity

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

- **`502`** Bad Gateway

## Payments: Subscription plans

### Create subscription plan
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/payments/create-payment-subscription-plan

> Creates a recurring-payment subscription plan record.

`POST /v1/payments/subscription-plans`

This stores SDP backend state and Solana subscriptions program identifiers; it does not by itself create the on-chain plan.

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `recurring.manage` action.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Selects the active project for this request. Required for Clerk (dashboard) callers. Ignored when authenticating with an API key, whose scope is fixed to the key's project.

- **`Idempotency-Key`** · `string` · pattern `^[\x20-\x7e]{1,255}$` · example `idempotency_example_12345`

  Optional, and honored when sent. 1-255 printable ASCII characters; send a UUID per logical operation and reuse it on every retry. Within 24 hours, a retry with the same key and the same request returns the stored status and body with the response header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`. Keys are scoped to the credential: within 24 hours, the same key with a different request, or from a different credential, returns 422 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED`; after that, the same key from a different credential runs as a new request. A rotated API key is a new credential, so after any rotation read the resource with GET to see whether the original request ran, and never resend a money request under the new credential without checking first. A key whose original request is still running returns 409 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_IN_FLIGHT` with `Retry-After`. A 400, 401, 403, 409 or 429 refusal is not stored, so the same key runs again once the cause is fixed. Access is checked before the key on every request, so a refused request never claims the key, and a credential that has since lost access to the named resource gets 403 instead of the stored response. A replay is a snapshot of the original response: read the current state with GET instead of sending the request again. If the original request never recorded its outcome (it crashed), a same-key retry gets 409 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_IN_FLIGHT` until 15 minutes plus the route's lease have passed since the original was sent (about 16 minutes, or about 20 for transfer batches), then 409 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN` with no `Retry-After`, as does every later retry with that key: read the resource with GET to see whether it ran, then send again with a new key. A 5xx is stored and replayed like any other answer; retry it with a new key.

## Request body

`application/json` · required

Creates an SDP subscription plan record. Prepare the on-chain Solana subscriptions program transaction separately with the plan prepare endpoint.

- **`ownerWalletId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `wal_merchant`

  Custody wallet that owns the Solana subscription plan.

- **`token`** · `string` · required · example `EPjFWdd5AufqSSqeM2qN1xzybapC8G4wEGGkZwyTDt1v`

  Token mint address. Native SOL is not expected for program-backed subscriptions.

- **`amount`** · `string` · required · example `25.00`

  Recurring charge amount in UI units.

- **`periodHours`** · `integer` · required · greater than 0 · max 8760 · example `720`

  Billing period length in hours.

- **`programPlanId`** · `string` · pattern `^\d+$` · example `17014118346046923173`

  Unsigned 64-bit decimal program plan identifier used in the Solana subscriptions PDA seed. Defaults to a generated nonzero value.

- **`planPda`** · `string` · example `7xKXtg2CW87d97TXJSDpbD5jBkheTqA83TZRuJosgAsU`

  On-chain plan PDA once created.

- **`destinationAddress`** · `string` · example `7xKXtg2CW87d97TXJSDpbD5jBkheTqA83TZRuJosgAsU`

  Optional destination owner address allowed by the on-chain plan.

- **`pullerWalletId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `wal_collector`

  Optional SDP custody wallet allowed to pull subscription payments.

- **`metadataUri`** · `string` · format `uri` · max length 128 · example `https://example.com/subscriptions/monthly-usdc.json`

  Optional plan metadata URI.

- **`status`** · `string` · one of `draft`, `active`, `archived` · example `active`

  Subscription plan status.

## Responses

- **`201`** Subscription plan created

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    Subscription plan response payload.

    - **`subscriptionPlan`** · `object` · required

      Recurring payment subscription plan record.

      - **`id`** · `string` · required · example `psp_example`

        SDP subscription plan ID.

      - **`organizationId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `org_example`

        Organization identifier.

      - **`projectId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

        Project identifier.

      - **`ownerWalletId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `privy_wallet_123`

        Provider wallet ID — the `walletId` field returned by GET /v1/wallets.

      - **`ownerAddress`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Base58-encoded Solana address.

      - **`token`** · `string` · required

        Token mint or normalized token identifier.

      - **`amount`** · `string` · required · example `100.00`

        Token amount in UI units (decimal string).

      - **`periodHours`** · `integer` · required · greater than 0 · example `720`

      - **`programPlanId`** · `string` · required · example `17014118346046923173`

        Unsigned 64-bit decimal program plan identifier used in PDA derivation.

      - **`planPda`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        On-chain plan PDA.

      - **`destinationAddress`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Allowed destination owner address.

      - **`pullerWalletId`** · `string | null` · required · min length 1 · example `privy_wallet_123`

        Collector wallet ID.

      - **`pullerAddress`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Collector wallet address.

      - **`metadataUri`** · `string | null` · required

        Optional plan metadata URI.

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `draft`, `active`, `archived` · example `active`

        Subscription plan status.

      - **`createdBy`** · `string | null` · required

        Creator user ID or API key ID.

      - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

      - **`updatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `recurring.manage` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

### List subscription plans
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/payments/list-payment-subscription-plans

> Lists recurring-payment subscription plans.

`GET /v1/payments/subscription-plans`

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `recurring.read` action.

## Query parameters

- **`status`** · `string` · one of `draft`, `active`, `archived` · example `active`

  Subscription plan status.

- **`page`** · `integer` · greater than 0 · default `1`

- **`pageSize`** · `integer` · min 1 · max 100 · default `20`

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Selects the active project for this request. Required for Clerk (dashboard) callers. Ignored when authenticating with an API key, whose scope is fixed to the key's project.

## Responses

- **`200`** Subscription plan list

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    Subscription plan list response payload.

    - **`subscriptionPlans`** · `object[]` · required

      - **`id`** · `string` · required · example `psp_example`

        SDP subscription plan ID.

      - **`organizationId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `org_example`

        Organization identifier.

      - **`projectId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

        Project identifier.

      - **`ownerWalletId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `privy_wallet_123`

        Provider wallet ID — the `walletId` field returned by GET /v1/wallets.

      - **`ownerAddress`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Base58-encoded Solana address.

      - **`token`** · `string` · required

        Token mint or normalized token identifier.

      - **`amount`** · `string` · required · example `100.00`

        Token amount in UI units (decimal string).

      - **`periodHours`** · `integer` · required · greater than 0 · example `720`

      - **`programPlanId`** · `string` · required · example `17014118346046923173`

        Unsigned 64-bit decimal program plan identifier used in PDA derivation.

      - **`planPda`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        On-chain plan PDA.

      - **`destinationAddress`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Allowed destination owner address.

      - **`pullerWalletId`** · `string | null` · required · min length 1 · example `privy_wallet_123`

        Collector wallet ID.

      - **`pullerAddress`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Collector wallet address.

      - **`metadataUri`** · `string | null` · required

        Optional plan metadata URI.

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `draft`, `active`, `archived` · example `active`

        Subscription plan status.

      - **`createdBy`** · `string | null` · required

        Creator user ID or API key ID.

      - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

      - **`updatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

    - **`total`** · `integer` · required

    - **`page`** · `integer` · required

    - **`pageSize`** · `integer` · required

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

      Human-readable error message.

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `recurring.read` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. ### Prepare subscription plan creation
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/payments/prepare-payment-subscription-plan-create

> Prepares an unsigned Solana subscriptions program create-plan transaction from an SDP subscription plan.

`POST /v1/payments/subscription-plans/{planId}/prepare-create`

This derives and stores the plan PDA but does not submit the transaction.

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `recurring.manage` action.

## Path parameters

- **`planId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `psp_example`

  SDP subscription plan record ID.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Selects the active project for this request. Required for Clerk (dashboard) callers. Ignored when authenticating with an API key, whose scope is fixed to the key's project.

## Request body

`application/json`

Optional overrides used when preparing the Solana subscriptions create-plan transaction.

- **`destinations`** · `string[]` · max items 4

  Allowed destination addresses for the on-chain plan. Defaults to the stored plan destination.

- **`pullers`** · `string[]` · max items 4

  Allowed puller addresses for the on-chain plan. Defaults to the stored puller or owner address.

- **`endTs`** · `string` · pattern `^\d+$` · example `1770000000`

  Optional unsigned 64-bit Unix timestamp when the on-chain plan ends.

- **`metadataUri`** · `string` · format `uri` · max length 128 · example `https://example.com/subscriptions/monthly-usdc.json`

  Optional metadata URI to embed in the on-chain plan.

## Responses

- **`200`** Subscription plan creation prepared

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    Prepared Solana subscriptions create-plan response payload.

    - **`subscriptionPlan`** · `object` · required

      Recurring payment subscription plan record.

      - **`id`** · `string` · required · example `psp_example`

        SDP subscription plan ID.

      - **`organizationId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `org_example`

        Organization identifier.

      - **`projectId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

        Project identifier.

      - **`ownerWalletId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `privy_wallet_123`

        Provider wallet ID — the `walletId` field returned by GET /v1/wallets.

      - **`ownerAddress`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Base58-encoded Solana address.

      - **`token`** · `string` · required

        Token mint or normalized token identifier.

      - **`amount`** · `string` · required · example `100.00`

        Token amount in UI units (decimal string).

      - **`periodHours`** · `integer` · required · greater than 0 · example `720`

      - **`programPlanId`** · `string` · required · example `17014118346046923173`

        Unsigned 64-bit decimal program plan identifier used in PDA derivation.

      - **`planPda`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        On-chain plan PDA.

      - **`destinationAddress`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Allowed destination owner address.

      - **`pullerWalletId`** · `string | null` · required · min length 1 · example `privy_wallet_123`

        Collector wallet ID.

      - **`pullerAddress`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Collector wallet address.

      - **`metadataUri`** · `string | null` · required

        Optional plan metadata URI.

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `draft`, `active`, `archived` · example `active`

        Subscription plan status.

      - **`createdBy`** · `string | null` · required

        Creator user ID or API key ID.

      - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

      - **`updatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

    - **`planPda`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

      Derived Solana subscriptions plan PDA.

    - **`preparedTransaction`** · `object` · required

      Unsigned Solana subscriptions transaction payload for client-side signing.

      - **`serialized`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `AQID`

        Base64-encoded unsigned transaction.

      - **`blockhash`** · `string` · required · example `blockhash_example`

        Blockhash for the transaction.

      - **`lastValidBlockHeight`** · `string` · required · example `123456`

        Last valid block height.

      - **`requiredSigners`** · `string[]` · required · each min length 32 · each max length 44 · each example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Addresses that must sign the prepared transaction. This includes the sponsored fee payer when the transaction uses one.

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `recurring.manage` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

### Update subscription plan
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/payments/update-payment-subscription-plan

> Updates mutable subscription plan fields and on-chain identifiers.

`PATCH /v1/payments/subscription-plans/{planId}`

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `recurring.execute` action.

## Path parameters

- **`planId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `psp_example`

  SDP subscription plan record ID.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Selects the active project for this request. Required for Clerk (dashboard) callers. Ignored when authenticating with an API key, whose scope is fixed to the key's project.

- **`Idempotency-Key`** · `string` · pattern `^[\x20-\x7e]{1,255}$` · example `idempotency_example_12345`

  Optional, and honored when sent. 1-255 printable ASCII characters; send a UUID per logical operation and reuse it on every retry. Within 24 hours, a retry with the same key and the same request returns the stored status and body with the response header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`. Keys are scoped to the credential: within 24 hours, the same key with a different request, or from a different credential, returns 422 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED`; after that, the same key from a different credential runs as a new request. A rotated API key is a new credential, so after any rotation read the resource with GET to see whether the original request ran, and never resend a money request under the new credential without checking first. A key whose original request is still running returns 409 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_IN_FLIGHT` with `Retry-After`. A 400, 401, 403, 409 or 429 refusal is not stored, so the same key runs again once the cause is fixed. Access is checked before the key on every request, so a refused request never claims the key, and a credential that has since lost access to the named resource gets 403 instead of the stored response. A replay is a snapshot of the original response: read the current state with GET instead of sending the request again. If the original request never recorded its outcome (it crashed), a same-key retry gets 409 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_IN_FLIGHT` until 15 minutes plus the route's lease have passed since the original was sent (about 16 minutes, or about 20 for transfer batches), then 409 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN` with no `Retry-After`, as does every later retry with that key: read the resource with GET to see whether it ran, then send again with a new key. A 5xx is stored and replayed like any other answer; retry it with a new key.

## Request body

`application/json` · required

Updates mutable SDP subscription plan fields.

- **`planPda`** · `string | null` · example `7xKXtg2CW87d97TXJSDpbD5jBkheTqA83TZRuJosgAsU`

  On-chain plan PDA, or null to clear it.

- **`destinationAddress`** · `string | null`

  Destination owner address, or null to clear it.

- **`pullerWalletId`** · `string | null` · min length 1 · example `wal_collector`

  Collection wallet ID, or null to clear it.

- **`metadataUri`** · `string | null` · format `uri` · max length 128

  Plan metadata URI, or null to clear it.

- **`status`** · `string` · one of `draft`, `active`, `archived` · example `active`

  Subscription plan status.

## Responses

- **`200`** Subscription plan updated

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    Subscription plan response payload.

    - **`subscriptionPlan`** · `object` · required

      Recurring payment subscription plan record.

      - **`id`** · `string` · required · example `psp_example`

        SDP subscription plan ID.

      - **`organizationId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `org_example`

        Organization identifier.

      - **`projectId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

        Project identifier.

      - **`ownerWalletId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `privy_wallet_123`

        Provider wallet ID — the `walletId` field returned by GET /v1/wallets.

      - **`ownerAddress`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Base58-encoded Solana address.

      - **`token`** · `string` · required

        Token mint or normalized token identifier.

      - **`amount`** · `string` · required · example `100.00`

        Token amount in UI units (decimal string).

      - **`periodHours`** · `integer` · required · greater than 0 · example `720`

      - **`programPlanId`** · `string` · required · example `17014118346046923173`

        Unsigned 64-bit decimal program plan identifier used in PDA derivation.

      - **`planPda`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        On-chain plan PDA.

      - **`destinationAddress`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Allowed destination owner address.

      - **`pullerWalletId`** · `string | null` · required · min length 1 · example `privy_wallet_123`

        Collector wallet ID.

      - **`pullerAddress`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Collector wallet address.

      - **`metadataUri`** · `string | null` · required

        Optional plan metadata URI.

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `draft`, `active`, `archived` · example `active`

        Subscription plan status.

      - **`createdBy`** · `string | null` · required

        Creator user ID or API key ID.

      - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

      - **`updatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `recurring.execute` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`404`** Not Found

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`409`** Conflict

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`422`** Unprocessable Entity

## Payments: Subscriptions

### Create subscription
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/payments/create-payment-subscription

> Creates a recurring-payment subscription record tied to a counterparty.

`POST /v1/payments/subscriptions`

The customer must still sign the Solana subscription authorization transaction.

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `recurring.manage` action.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Selects the active project for this request. Required for Clerk (dashboard) callers. Ignored when authenticating with an API key, whose scope is fixed to the key's project.

- **`Idempotency-Key`** · `string` · pattern `^[\x20-\x7e]{1,255}$` · example `idempotency_example_12345`

  Optional, and honored when sent. 1-255 printable ASCII characters; send a UUID per logical operation and reuse it on every retry. Within 24 hours, a retry with the same key and the same request returns the stored status and body with the response header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`. Keys are scoped to the credential: within 24 hours, the same key with a different request, or from a different credential, returns 422 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED`; after that, the same key from a different credential runs as a new request. A rotated API key is a new credential, so after any rotation read the resource with GET to see whether the original request ran, and never resend a money request under the new credential without checking first. A key whose original request is still running returns 409 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_IN_FLIGHT` with `Retry-After`. A 400, 401, 403, 409 or 429 refusal is not stored, so the same key runs again once the cause is fixed. Access is checked before the key on every request, so a refused request never claims the key, and a credential that has since lost access to the named resource gets 403 instead of the stored response. A replay is a snapshot of the original response: read the current state with GET instead of sending the request again. If the original request never recorded its outcome (it crashed), a same-key retry gets 409 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_IN_FLIGHT` until 15 minutes plus the route's lease have passed since the original was sent (about 16 minutes, or about 20 for transfer batches), then 409 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN` with no `Retry-After`, as does every later retry with that key: read the resource with GET to see whether it ran, then send again with a new key. A 5xx is stored and replayed like any other answer; retry it with a new key.

## Request body

`application/json` · required

Creates a pending SDP subscription record tied to a counterparty. Lifecycle, schedule, on-chain addresses, and authorization proof are server-owned and populated only by verified flows.

- **`planId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `psp_example`

  SDP subscription plan ID.

- **`counterpartyId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `cpty_example`

  Counterparty being billed for the recurring payment.

- **`subscriberAddress`** · `string` · required · example `7xKXtg2CW87d97TXJSDpbD5jBkheTqA83TZRuJosgAsU`

  Customer wallet address that authorizes the subscription.

## Responses

- **`201`** Subscription created

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    Subscription response payload.

    - **`subscription`** · `object` · required

      Recurring payment subscription record.

      - **`id`** · `string` · required · example `psub_example`

        SDP subscription ID.

      - **`organizationId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `org_example`

        Organization identifier.

      - **`projectId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

        Project identifier.

      - **`planId`** · `string` · required

        SDP subscription plan ID.

      - **`counterpartyId`** · `string` · required

        Counterparty ID.

      - **`subscriberAddress`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Base58-encoded Solana address.

      - **`subscriberTokenAccount`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Subscriber token account address.

      - **`subscriptionPda`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        On-chain subscription PDA.

      - **`subscriptionAuthorityAddress`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        On-chain subscription authority address.

      - **`authorizationSignature`** · `string | null` · required

        Customer authorization transaction signature.

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `pending_authorization`, `active`, `paused`, `canceling`, `canceled`, `expired` · example `active`

        Subscription status.

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

### Prepare subscription authorization
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/payments/prepare-payment-subscription-authorization

> Prepares the subscriber-signed Solana transaction that initializes the subscription authority and subscribes to the plan.

`POST /v1/payments/subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/prepare-authorization`

The transaction must still be signed and submitted by the client.

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `recurring.execute` action.

## Path parameters

- **`subscriptionId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `psub_example`

  SDP subscription record ID.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Selects the active project for this request. Required for Clerk (dashboard) callers. Ignored when authenticating with an API key, whose scope is fixed to the key's project.

## Request body

`application/json` · required

Inputs for preparing the subscriber-signed Solana subscription authorization transaction.

- **`subscriberTokenAccount`** · `string` · required · example `7xKXtg2CW87d97TXJSDpbD5jBkheTqA83TZRuJosgAsU`

  Subscriber token account that authorizes the subscription authority delegation.

- **`expectedPlanCreatedAt`** · `string` · required · pattern `^\d+$` · example `0`

  Unsigned 64-bit created-at timestamp from the on-chain plan terms that the subscriber consents to.

- **`expectedSubscriptionAuthorityInitId`** · `string` · required · pattern `^-?\d+$` · example `0`

  Signed 64-bit init id from the on-chain subscription authority that the subscriber consents to.

## Responses

- **`200`** Subscription authorization prepared

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    Prepared subscription authorization response payload.

    - **`subscription`** · `object` · required

      Recurring payment subscription record.

      - **`id`** · `string` · required · example `psub_example`

        SDP subscription ID.

      - **`organizationId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `org_example`

        Organization identifier.

      - **`projectId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

        Project identifier.

      - **`planId`** · `string` · required

        SDP subscription plan ID.

      - **`counterpartyId`** · `string` · required

        Counterparty ID.

      - **`subscriberAddress`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Base58-encoded Solana address.

      - **`subscriberTokenAccount`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Subscriber token account address.

      - **`subscriptionPda`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        On-chain subscription PDA.

      - **`subscriptionAuthorityAddress`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        On-chain subscription authority address.

      - **`authorizationSignature`** · `string | null` · required

        Customer authorization transaction signature.

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `pending_authorization`, `active`, `paused`, `canceling`, `canceled`, `expired` · example `active`

        Subscription status.

      - **`currentPeriodStartAt`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

      - **`nextCollectionDueAt`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

      - **`cancelAt`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

      - **`canceledAt`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

      - **`createdBy`** · `string | null` · required

      - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

      - **`updatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

    - **`subscriptionPda`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

      Derived subscription delegation PDA.

    - **`subscriptionAuthorityAddress`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

      Derived subscription authority PDA.

    - **`preparedTransaction`** · `object` · required

      Unsigned Solana subscriptions transaction payload for client-side signing.

      - **`serialized`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `AQID`

        Base64-encoded unsigned transaction.

      - **`blockhash`** · `string` · required · example `blockhash_example`

        Blockhash for the transaction.

      - **`lastValidBlockHeight`** · `string` · required · example `123456`

        Last valid block height.

      - **`requiredSigners`** · `string[]` · required · each min length 32 · each max length 44 · each example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Addresses that must sign the prepared transaction. This includes the sponsored fee payer when the transaction uses one.

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `recurring.execute` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`404`** Not Found

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `400`.

## Example request

```bash tab="cURL"
curl -X POST 'https://api.solana.com/v1/payments/subscriptions/psub_example/prepare-authorization' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SDP_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "subscriberTokenAccount": "7xKXtg2CW87d97TXJSDpbD5jBkheTqA83TZRuJosgAsU",
    "expectedPlanCreatedAt": "0",
    "expectedSubscriptionAuthorityInitId": "0"
  }'
```

```ts tab="TypeScript"
const res = await fetch("https://api.solana.com/v1/payments/subscriptions/psub_example/prepare-authorization", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.SDP_API_KEY}`,
    "Content-Type": "application/json"
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({
    "subscriberTokenAccount": "7xKXtg2CW87d97TXJSDpbD5jBkheTqA83TZRuJosgAsU",
    "expectedPlanCreatedAt": "0",
    "expectedSubscriptionAuthorityInitId": "0"
  })
});
```

```python tab="Python"
import os, requests

r = requests.post("https://api.solana.com/v1/payments/subscriptions/psub_example/prepare-authorization",
  headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['SDP_API_KEY']}"},
  json={
    "subscriberTokenAccount": "7xKXtg2CW87d97TXJSDpbD5jBkheTqA83TZRuJosgAsU",
    "expectedPlanCreatedAt": "0",
    "expectedSubscriptionAuthorityInitId": "0"
  })
```

      - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

      - **`updatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

    - **`preparedTransaction`** · `object` · required

      Unsigned Solana subscriptions transaction payload for client-side signing.

      - **`serialized`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `AQID`

        Base64-encoded unsigned transaction.

      - **`blockhash`** · `string` · required · example `blockhash_example`

        Blockhash for the transaction.

      - **`lastValidBlockHeight`** · `string` · required · example `123456`

        Last valid block height.

      - **`requiredSigners`** · `string[]` · required · each min length 32 · each max length 44 · each example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Addresses that must sign the prepared transaction. This includes the sponsored fee payer when the transaction uses one.

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `recurring.execute` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`404`** Not Found

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `400`.

## Example request

  -d '{}'

### Prepare subscription collection
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/payments/prepare-payment-subscription-collection

> Prepares the collector-signed Solana subscriptions transfer transaction for an active subscription.

`POST /v1/payments/subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/prepare-collection`

The transaction must still be signed and submitted by the collector/fee-payer flow.

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `recurring.execute` action.

## Path parameters

- **`subscriptionId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `psub_example`

  SDP subscription record ID.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Selects the active project for this request. Required for Clerk (dashboard) callers. Ignored when authenticating with an API key, whose scope is fixed to the key's project.

## Request body

`application/json` · required

Inputs for preparing the collector-signed Solana subscriptions transfer transaction. The amount is always derived from the stored plan.

- **`receiverTokenAccount`** · `string` · required · example `7xKXtg2CW87d97TXJSDpbD5jBkheTqA83TZRuJosgAsU`

  Receiver token account for the pulled subscription payment. It must be allowed by the on-chain plan.

## Responses

- **`200`** Subscription collection prepared

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    Prepared subscription collection response payload.

    - **`subscription`** · `object` · required

      Recurring payment subscription record.

      - **`id`** · `string` · required · example `psub_example`

        SDP subscription ID.

      - **`organizationId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `org_example`

        Organization identifier.

      - **`projectId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

        Project identifier.

      - **`planId`** · `string` · required

        SDP subscription plan ID.

      - **`counterpartyId`** · `string` · required

        Counterparty ID.

      - **`subscriberAddress`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Base58-encoded Solana address.

      - **`subscriberTokenAccount`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Subscriber token account address.

      - **`subscriptionPda`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        On-chain subscription PDA.

      - **`subscriptionAuthorityAddress`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        On-chain subscription authority address.

      - **`authorizationSignature`** · `string | null` · required

        Customer authorization transaction signature.

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `pending_authorization`, `active`, `paused`, `canceling`, `canceled`, `expired` · example `active`

        Subscription status.

      - **`currentPeriodStartAt`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

      - **`nextCollectionDueAt`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

      - **`cancelAt`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

      - **`canceledAt`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

      - **`createdBy`** · `string | null` · required

      - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

      - **`updatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

    - **`preparedTransaction`** · `object` · required

      Unsigned Solana subscriptions transaction payload for client-side signing.

      - **`serialized`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `AQID`

        Base64-encoded unsigned transaction.

      - **`blockhash`** · `string` · required · example `blockhash_example`

        Blockhash for the transaction.

      - **`lastValidBlockHeight`** · `string` · required · example `123456`

        Last valid block height.

      - **`requiredSigners`** · `string[]` · required · each min length 32 · each max length 44 · each example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Addresses that must sign the prepared transaction. This includes the sponsored fee payer when the transaction uses one.

    - **`collectionAttempt`** · `object`

      Recurring payment collection attempt record.

      - **`id`** · `string` · required · example `psca_example`

        Collection attempt ID.

      - **`organizationId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `org_example`

        Organization identifier.

      - **`projectId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

        Project identifier.

      - **`subscriptionId`** · `string` · required

        Subscription ID.

      - **`transferId`** · `string | null` · required · min length 1 · example `xfr_example`

        Payment transfer record ID when linked.

      - **`token`** · `string` · required

        Token mint or normalized token identifier.

      - **`amount`** · `string` · required · example `100.00`

        Token amount in UI units (decimal string).

      - **`dueAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

      - **`attemptedAt`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `pending`, `processing`, `confirmed`, `failed`, `skipped` · example `pending`

        Collection attempt status.

      - **`signature`** · `string | null` · required

        Solana transaction signature.

      - **`error`** · `string | null` · required

        Collection error, if any.

      - **`metadata`** · `object` · required

        Provider/job metadata for the attempt.

        One of:

        - **source: "manual"**

          - **`recurringPaymentId`** · `string` · required

          - **`initiatedByKeyId`** · `string | null` · required

          - **`source`** · `string` · required · always `manual`

        - **source: "automated"**

          - **`recurringPaymentId`** · `string` · required

          - **`initiatedByKeyId`** · `string | null` · required

          - **`source`** · `string` · required · always `automated`

        - **source: "retry"**

          - **`recurringPaymentId`** · `string` · required

          - **`initiatedByKeyId`** · `string | null` · required

          - **`source`** · `string` · required · always `retry`

          - **`initialSource`** · `string` · required · one of `manual`, `automated`

          - **`transferId`** · `string | null` · required

          - **`error`** · `string` · required

          - **`retryAfterAt`** · `string` · required

        - **source: "linked_transfer"**

          - **`recurringPaymentId`** · `string` · required

          - **`initiatedByKeyId`** · `string | null` · required

          - **`source`** · `string` · required · always `linked_transfer`

          - **`initialSource`** · `string` · required · one of `manual`, `automated`

          - **`transferId`** · `string` · required

      - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

      - **`updatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `recurring.execute` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`404`** Not Found

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `400`.
