### List subscription collection attempts
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/payments/list-payment-subscription-collection-attempts

> Lists collection attempts for a recurring-payment subscription.

`GET /v1/payments/subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/collection-attempts`

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `recurring.read` action.

## Path parameters

- **`subscriptionId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `psub_example`

  SDP subscription record ID.

## Query parameters

- **`status`** · `string` · one of `pending`, `processing`, `confirmed`, `failed`, `skipped` · example `pending`

  Collection attempt status.

- **`page`** · `integer` · greater than 0 · default `1`

- **`pageSize`** · `integer` · min 1 · max 100 · default `20`

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Selects the active project for this request. Required for Clerk (dashboard) callers. Ignored when authenticating with an API key, whose scope is fixed to the key's project.

## Responses

- **`200`** Collection attempt list

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    Collection attempt list response payload.

    - **`collectionAttempts`** · `object[]` · required

      - **`id`** · `string` · required · example `psca_example`

        Collection attempt ID.

      - **`organizationId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `org_example`

        Organization identifier.

      - **`projectId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

        Project identifier.

      - **`subscriptionId`** · `string` · required

        Subscription ID.

      - **`transferId`** · `string | null` · required · min length 1 · example `xfr_example`

        Payment transfer record ID when linked.

      - **`token`** · `string` · required

        Token mint or normalized token identifier.

      - **`amount`** · `string` · required · example `100.00`

        Token amount in UI units (decimal string).

      - **`dueAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

      - **`attemptedAt`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `pending`, `processing`, `confirmed`, `failed`, `skipped` · example `pending`

        Collection attempt status.

      - **`signature`** · `string | null` · required

        Solana transaction signature.

      - **`error`** · `string | null` · required

        Collection error, if any.

      - **`metadata`** · `object` · required

        Provider/job metadata for the attempt.

        One of:

        - **source: "manual"**

          - **`recurringPaymentId`** · `string` · required

          - **`initiatedByKeyId`** · `string | null` · required

          - **`source`** · `string` · required · always `manual`

        - **source: "automated"**

          - **`recurringPaymentId`** · `string` · required

          - **`initiatedByKeyId`** · `string | null` · required

          - **`source`** · `string` · required · always `automated`

        - **source: "retry"**

          - **`recurringPaymentId`** · `string` · required

          - **`initiatedByKeyId`** · `string | null` · required

          - **`source`** · `string` · required · always `retry`

          - **`initialSource`** · `string` · required · one of `manual`, `automated`

          - **`transferId`** · `string | null` · required

          - **`error`** · `string` · required

          - **`retryAfterAt`** · `string` · required

        - **source: "linked_transfer"**

          - **`recurringPaymentId`** · `string` · required

          - **`initiatedByKeyId`** · `string | null` · required

          - **`source`** · `string` · required · always `linked_transfer`

          - **`initialSource`** · `string` · required · one of `manual`, `automated`

          - **`transferId`** · `string` · required

      - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

      - **`updatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

    - **`total`** · `integer` · required

    - **`page`** · `integer` · required

    - **`pageSize`** · `integer` · required

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `recurring.read` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`404`** Not Found

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `400`.

## Example request

```bash tab="cURL"
curl 'https://api.solana.com/v1/payments/subscriptions/psub_example/collection-attempts' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SDP_API_KEY"
```

```ts tab="TypeScript"

  method: "GET",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.SDP_API_KEY}`
  }
});
```

```python tab="Python"

r = requests.get("https://api.solana.com/v1/payments/subscriptions/psub_example/collection-attempts",
  headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['SDP_API_KEY']}"})
```

## Payments: Ramps

### List on-ramp currency support
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/payments/list-payment-onramp-currencies

> Lists generated fiat-to-crypto on-ramp pairs and the providers that support each pair.

`GET /v1/payments/ramps/onramp/currency`

Supports optional source, destination rail, and provider filters.

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `onramp.read` action.

## Query parameters

- **`source`** · `string` · one of `AUD`, `BRL`, `CAD`, `CHF`, `COP`, `CZK`, `DKK`, `DOP`, `EGP`, `EUR`, `GBP`, `HKD`, `IDR`, `ILS`, `JOD`, `KES`, `KWD`, `LKR`, `MXN`, `NGN`, `NOK`, `NZD`, `OMR`, `PEN`, `PLN`, `RON`, `SEK`, `THB`, `TRY`, `TWD`, `USD`, `VND`, `ZAR` · example `USD`

  Optional fiat source currency filter.

- **`dest`** · `string` · one of `sol.solana`, `usdc.solana`, `usdt.solana`, `usdg.solana`, `pyusd.solana` · example `usdc.solana`

  Optional Solana crypto rail destination filter.

- **`provider`** · `string` · one of `moonpay`, `stripe` · example `moonpay`

  Optional ramp provider filter.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Selects the active project for this request. Required for Clerk (dashboard) callers. Ignored when authenticating with an API key, whose scope is fixed to the key's project.

## Responses

- **`200`** On-ramp currency support

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    On-ramp currency support response payload.

    - **`currencies`** · `object` · required

      On-ramp currency option sets.

      - **`sources`** · `string[]` · required

        Fiat source currencies with at least one supported on-ramp pair.

      - **`destinations`** · `string[]` · required · each one of `sol.solana`, `usdc.solana`, `usdt.solana`, `usdg.solana`, `pyusd.solana`

        Crypto rails considered for Solana on-ramp support.

    - **`pairs`** · `object[]` · required

      Supported fiat-to-crypto pairs and their providers.

      - **`source`** · `string` · required · example `USD`

        Fiat source currency code.

      - **`dest`** · `string` · required · one of `sol.solana`, `usdc.solana`, `usdt.solana`, `usdg.solana`, `pyusd.solana` · example `usdc.solana`

        Destination crypto rail.

      - **`providers`** · `string[]` · required · each one of `moonpay`, `stripe`

        Providers that support this on-ramp pair.

    - **`providerDetails`** · `object` · required

      Provider support details keyed by provider ID. Includes only providers present in the returned pairs.

      - **`*`** · `object`

        Provider support details for the endpoint direction.

        - **`currencies`** · `object` · required

          Fiat currency support keyed by ISO 4217 currency code.

          - **`*`** · `object`

            Provider amount limits for one fiat currency.

            - **`min`** · `string | null` · required · example `20`

              Minimum fiat amount supported for this provider and currency.

            - **`max`** · `string | null` · required · example `30000`

              Maximum fiat amount supported for this provider and currency.

        - **`countrySupport`** · `object` · required

          Provider country coverage details.

          One of:

          - **coverage: "by-country"**

            - **`coverage`** · `string` · required · always `by-country` · example `by-country`

              Country coverage is reported per fiat currency.

            - **`countries`** · `object` · required

              Map of ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes to supported fiat currencies.

              - **`*`** · `string[]`

          - **coverage: "all-currencies"**

            - **`coverage`** · `string` · required · always `all-currencies` · example `all-currencies`

              Country coverage applies to every listed provider currency.

            - **`countries`** · `string[]` · required

              ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes supported for all listed currencies.

          - **coverage: "unreported"**

            - **`coverage`** · `string` · required · always `unreported` · example `unreported`

              The provider has not reported country coverage.

        - **`entityTypes`** · `string[]` · required · each one of `individual`, `business`

          Counterparty entity types supported by this provider for the endpoint direction.

    - **`supportHash`** · `string` · required · example `sha256:example`

      Deterministic hash of the generated ramp support matrix.

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `onramp.read` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `400`.

## Example request

```bash tab="cURL"
curl 'https://api.solana.com/v1/payments/ramps/onramp/currency' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SDP_API_KEY"
```

```ts tab="TypeScript"

  method: "GET",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.SDP_API_KEY}`
  }
});
```

```python tab="Python"

  headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['SDP_API_KEY']}"})
```

### Create on-ramp quote
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/payments/create-payment-onramp-quote

> Creates a provider-specific on-ramp quote.

`POST /v1/payments/ramps/onramp/quote`

Hosted providers return a hosted URL; instruction-based providers return manual funding instructions.

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `onramp.execute` action.

## Request body

`application/json` · required

Create an on-ramp quote. The response uses `deliveryMode` to indicate whether the client should display manual instructions, open a hosted provider flow, or mount a provider session widget.

- **`provider`** · `string` · required · one of `moonpay`, `stripe` · example `moonpay`

  Ramp provider identifier. Hosted providers return a URL, manual providers return funding instructions, and Stripe returns a session widget secret.

- **`counterpartyId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `cpty_example`

  SDP counterparty ID. Provider-native customer records may be resolved or created from this counterparty.

- **`destinationCustodyWalletId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `cwlt_example`

  Custody wallet ID (the `id` returned by the wallets API) for purchased crypto.

- **`assetRail`** · `string` · required · one of `sol.solana`, `usdc.solana`, `usdt.solana`, `usdg.solana`, `pyusd.solana` · example `usdc.solana`

  Canonical SDP crypto asset rail.

- **`fiatCurrency`** · `string` · required · one of `AUD`, `BRL`, `CAD`, `CHF`, `COP`, `CZK`, `DKK`, `DOP`, `EGP`, `EUR`, `GBP`, `HKD`, `IDR`, `ILS`, `JOD`, `KES`, `KWD`, `LKR`, `MXN`, `NGN`, `NOK`, `NZD`, `OMR`, `PEN`, `PLN`, `RON`, `SEK`, `THB`, `TRY`, `TWD`, `USD`, `VND`, `ZAR` · example `USD`

  Fiat currency for on-ramp.

- **`fiatAmount`** · `string` · required · example `100.00`

  Fiat amount to on-ramp.

- **`rampsMemo`** · `object`

  Optional key-value memo stored on the resulting transfer.

  - **`*`** · `string` · min length 1 · max length 256

## Responses

- **`200`** On-ramp quote created

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    On-ramp quote response payload.

    - **`quote`** · `object` · required

      On-ramp quote details.

      - **`id`** · `string` · required · example `ramp_quote_example`

        Quote identifier.

      - **`provider`** · `string` · required · one of `moonpay`, `stripe` · example `moonpay`

        Provider that created the quote.

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `pending`, `processing`, `completed`, `failed` · example `pending`

        Quote status.

      - **`deliveryMode`** · `string` · required · one of `hosted`, `session_widget` · example `hosted`

        `hosted` means open `hostedUrl`; `session_widget` means mount the provider SDK session.

      - **`hostedUrl`** · `string` · format `uri`

        Provider-hosted URL for hosted quote delivery.

      - **`clientSecret`** · `string`

        Stripe on-ramp session client secret for session widgets.

      - **`sessionId`** · `string`

        Provider session identifier for session widgets.

      - **`publishableKey`** · `string`

        Stripe publishable key used to initialize the on-ramp widget.

      - **`redirectUrl`** · `string` · format `uri`

        Provider redirect URL associated with the widget session.

    - **`transferId`** · `string` · required

      Identifier of the transfer record created for this quote. Poll GET /v1/payments/transfers/\{transferId\} for settlement status.

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `onramp.execute` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`404`** Not Found

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`409`** Conflict

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`429`** Too Many Requests

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`502`** Bad Gateway

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`503`** Service Unavailable

  Same fields as `400`.

## Example request

```bash tab="cURL"
curl -X POST 'https://api.solana.com/v1/payments/ramps/onramp/quote' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SDP_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "provider": "moonpay",
    "counterpartyId": "cpty_example",
    "destinationCustodyWalletId": "cwlt_example",
    "assetRail": "usdc.solana",
    "fiatCurrency": "USD",
    "fiatAmount": "100.00"
  }'
```

```ts tab="TypeScript"

  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.SDP_API_KEY}`,
    "Content-Type": "application/json"
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({
    "provider": "moonpay",
    "counterpartyId": "cpty_example",
    "destinationCustodyWalletId": "cwlt_example",
    "assetRail": "usdc.solana",
    "fiatCurrency": "USD",
    "fiatAmount": "100.00"
  })
});
```

```python tab="Python"

  headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['SDP_API_KEY']}"},

    "provider": "moonpay",
    "counterpartyId": "cpty_example",
    "destinationCustodyWalletId": "cwlt_example",
    "assetRail": "usdc.solana",
    "fiatCurrency": "USD",
    "fiatAmount": "100.00"
  })
```

### Simulate sandbox transfer
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/payments/simulate-sandbox-transfer

> Sandbox-only.

`POST /v1/payments/ramps/sandbox/simulate`

Simulates the fiat pay-in for an on-ramp transfer awaiting payment, at most once per transfer.

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `ramp_transfers.manage` action.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Selects the active project for this request. Required for Clerk (dashboard) callers. Ignored when authenticating with an API key, whose scope is fixed to the key's project.

## Request body

`application/json` · required

Sandbox-only helper that simulates the fiat pay-in for a persisted on-ramp quote. Only the transfer ID is accepted; every provider-specific value is derived from the transfer.

- **`transferId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `xfr_example`

  ID of an on-ramp transfer that is awaiting payment. The provider, quote reference, counterparty, and fiat amount are read from the transfer; each transfer can be simulated once.

## Responses

- **`204`** Sandbox pay-in requested from the provider

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `ramp_transfers.manage` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`404`** Not Found

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`409`** Conflict

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`503`** Service Unavailable

  Same fields as `400`.

## Example request

```bash tab="cURL"
curl -X POST 'https://api.solana.com/v1/payments/ramps/sandbox/simulate' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SDP_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "transferId": "xfr_example"
  }'
```

```ts tab="TypeScript"
const res = await fetch("https://api.solana.com/v1/payments/ramps/sandbox/simulate", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.SDP_API_KEY}`,
    "Content-Type": "application/json"
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({
    "transferId": "xfr_example"
  })
});
```

```python tab="Python"

  headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['SDP_API_KEY']}"},
  json={
    "transferId": "xfr_example"
  })
```

### Screen an address across configured compliance providers
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/compliance/screen-compliance-address

> Runs address screening against configured compliance providers and returns provider-level risk scores.

`POST /v1/compliance/address-screenings`

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `compliance.execute` action.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Selects the active project for this request. Required for Clerk (dashboard) callers. Ignored when authenticating with an API key, whose scope is fixed to the key's project.

- **`Idempotency-Key`** · `string` · pattern `^[\x20-\x7e]{1,255}$` · example `idempotency_example_12345`

  Optional, and honored when sent. 1-255 printable ASCII characters; send a UUID per logical operation and reuse it on every retry. Within 24 hours, a retry with the same key and the same request returns the stored status and body with the response header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`. Keys are scoped to the credential: within 24 hours, the same key with a different request, or from a different credential, returns 422 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED`; after that, the same key from a different credential runs as a new request. A rotated API key is a new credential, so after any rotation read the resource with GET to see whether the original request ran, and never resend a money request under the new credential without checking first. A key whose original request is still running returns 409 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_IN_FLIGHT` with `Retry-After`. A 400, 401, 403, 409 or 429 refusal is not stored, so the same key runs again once the cause is fixed. Access is checked before the key on every request, so a refused request never claims the key, and a credential that has since lost access to the named resource gets 403 instead of the stored response. A replay is a snapshot of the original response: read the current state with GET instead of sending the request again. If the original request never recorded its outcome (it crashed), a same-key retry gets 409 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_IN_FLIGHT` until 15 minutes plus the route's lease have passed since the original was sent (about 16 minutes, or about 20 for transfer batches), then 409 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN` with no `Retry-After`, as does every later retry with that key: read the resource with GET to see whether it ran, then send again with a new key. A 5xx is stored and replayed like any other answer; retry it with a new key.

## Request body

`application/json` · required

Address compliance screening request payload.

- **`address`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `8dHEsGLpCZHZbXnFVvqWq4kMfM2pVDuNrXvVJVhQWRGZ`

  Address to screen.

- **`network`** · `string` · min length 1 · max length 64 · default `solana` · example `solana`

  Network identifier expected by the compliance provider.

- **`intent`** · `string` · one of `transfer_destination`, `wallet_address_addition`, `unknown` · default `unknown` · example `transfer_destination`

  Business intent for address screening.

## Responses

- **`200`** Address screening results

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    Address screening response payload.

    - **`screening`** · `object` · required

      Aggregated address screening response.

      - **`address`** · `string` · required · example `8dHEsGLpCZHZbXnFVvqWq4kMfM2pVDuNrXvVJVhQWRGZ`

        Address that was screened.

      - **`network`** · `string` · required · example `solana`

        Network that was screened.

      - **`intent`** · `string` · required · one of `transfer_destination`, `wallet_address_addition`, `unknown` · example `transfer_destination`

        Business intent for address screening.

      - **`checkedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        Timestamp when all provider checks completed.

      - **`providers`** · `object[]` · required

        - **`provider`** · `string` · required · one of `range`, `elliptic`, `trm`, `chainalysis` · example `range`

          Compliance provider identifier.

        - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `ok`, `pending`, `unavailable`, `error` · example `ok`

          Provider response status.

        - **`riskScore`** · `number | null` · required · example `7`

          Risk score returned by the provider.

        - **`riskLevel`** · `string` · example `High risk`

          Provider-specific risk level label.

        - **`providerStatus`** · `string` · example `COMPLETE`

          The provider's own status word, verbatim, retained for audit; the normalized status field is the decision.

        - **`message`** · `string`

          Optional provider message, such as warnings or error details.

        - **`evaluatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

          Timestamp when the provider result was produced.

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `compliance.execute` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`409`** Conflict

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`422`** Unprocessable Entity

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `400`.

## Example request

```bash tab="cURL"
curl -X POST 'https://api.solana.com/v1/compliance/address-screenings' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SDP_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "address": "8dHEsGLpCZHZbXnFVvqWq4kMfM2pVDuNrXvVJVhQWRGZ",
    "network": "solana",
    "intent": "transfer_destination"
  }'
```

```ts tab="TypeScript"

  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.SDP_API_KEY}`,
    "Idempotency-Key": crypto.randomUUID(),
    "Content-Type": "application/json"
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({
    "address": "8dHEsGLpCZHZbXnFVvqWq4kMfM2pVDuNrXvVJVhQWRGZ",
    "network": "solana",
    "intent": "transfer_destination"
  })
});
```

```python tab="Python"
import os, requests, uuid

r = requests.post("https://api.solana.com/v1/compliance/address-screenings",
  headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['SDP_API_KEY']}", "Idempotency-Key": str(uuid.uuid4())},
  json={
    "address": "8dHEsGLpCZHZbXnFVvqWq4kMfM2pVDuNrXvVJVhQWRGZ",
    "network": "solana",
    "intent": "transfer_destination"
  })
```

## Example responses

```json tab="200"

  "data": {
```

### Create counterparty
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/counterparties/create-counterparty

> Creates a counterparty.

`POST /v1/counterparties`

If externalId is provided, it must be unique within the organization.

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `counterparties.manage` action.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Selects the active project for this request. Required for Clerk (dashboard) callers. Ignored when authenticating with an API key, whose scope is fixed to the key's project.

- **`Idempotency-Key`** · `string` · pattern `^[\x20-\x7e]{1,255}$` · example `idempotency_example_12345`

  Optional, and honored when sent. 1-255 printable ASCII characters; send a UUID per logical operation and reuse it on every retry. Within 24 hours, a retry with the same key and the same request returns the stored status and body with the response header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`. Keys are scoped to the credential: within 24 hours, the same key with a different request, or from a different credential, returns 422 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED`; after that, the same key from a different credential runs as a new request. A rotated API key is a new credential, so after any rotation read the resource with GET to see whether the original request ran, and never resend a money request under the new credential without checking first. A key whose original request is still running returns 409 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_IN_FLIGHT` with `Retry-After`. A 400, 401, 403, 409 or 429 refusal is not stored, so the same key runs again once the cause is fixed. Access is checked before the key on every request, so a refused request never claims the key, and a credential that has since lost access to the named resource gets 403 instead of the stored response. A replay is a snapshot of the original response: read the current state with GET instead of sending the request again. If the original request never recorded its outcome (it crashed), a same-key retry gets 409 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_IN_FLIGHT` until 15 minutes plus the route's lease have passed since the original was sent (about 16 minutes, or about 20 for transfer batches), then 409 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN` with no `Retry-After`, as does every later retry with that key: read the resource with GET to see whether it ran, then send again with a new key. A 5xx is stored and replayed like any other answer; retry it with a new key.

## Request body

`application/json` · required

Create counterparty request body.

- **`externalId`** · `string` · min length 1 · max length 256 · example `customer_42`

  Caller-supplied opaque identifier for cross-system reference. Do not place personal data in this indexed field.

- **`entityType`** · `string` · required · one of `individual`, `business` · example `individual`

  Counterparty entity type.

- **`displayName`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · max length 512 · example `Jane Doe`

  Human-readable, searchable display name. Keep it minimal because this indexed field is not application-encrypted.

## Responses

- **`201`** Counterparty created

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    Counterparty response payload.

    - **`counterparty`** · `object` · required

      Counterparty record.

      - **`id`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `cpty_example`

        Counterparty identifier.

      - **`organizationId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `org_example`

        Organization identifier.

      - **`projectId`** · `string | null` · required · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

        Project scope when the counterparty is project-scoped.

      - **`externalId`** · `string | null` · required · example `customer_42`

        Caller-supplied opaque identifier for cross-system reference. Do not place personal data in this indexed field.

      - **`entityType`** · `string` · required · one of `individual`, `business` · example `individual`

        Counterparty entity type.

      - **`displayName`** · `string` · required · example `Jane Doe`

        Human-readable, searchable display name. Keep it minimal because this indexed field is not application-encrypted.

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `active`, `archived` · example `active`

        Counterparty status.

      - **`createdBy`** · `string | null` · required · min length 1 · example `usr_example`

        User who created the counterparty. Null when created via API key.

      - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        Creation timestamp.

      - **`updatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-02T00:00:00.000Z`

        Last update timestamp.

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `counterparties.manage` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

- **`403`** Forbidden.   Same fields as `401`.

### Update counterparty
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/counterparties/update-counterparty

> Updates counterparty attributes.

`PATCH /v1/counterparties/{counterpartyId}`

At least one field must be provided. Use null on externalId to clear it.

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `counterparties.manage` action.

## Path parameters

- **`counterpartyId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `cpty_example`

  Counterparty identifier.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Selects the active project for this request. Required for Clerk (dashboard) callers. Ignored when authenticating with an API key, whose scope is fixed to the key's project.

- **`Idempotency-Key`** · `string` · pattern `^[\x20-\x7e]{1,255}$` · example `idempotency_example_12345`

  Optional, and honored when sent. 1-255 printable ASCII characters; send a UUID per logical operation and reuse it on every retry. Within 24 hours, a retry with the same key and the same request returns the stored status and body with the response header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`. Keys are scoped to the credential: within 24 hours, the same key with a different request, or from a different credential, returns 422 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED`; after that, the same key from a different credential runs as a new request. A rotated API key is a new credential, so after any rotation read the resource with GET to see whether the original request ran, and never resend a money request under the new credential without checking first. A key whose original request is still running returns 409 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_IN_FLIGHT` with `Retry-After`. A 400, 401, 403, 409 or 429 refusal is not stored, so the same key runs again once the cause is fixed. Access is checked before the key on every request, so a refused request never claims the key, and a credential that has since lost access to the named resource gets 403 instead of the stored response. A replay is a snapshot of the original response: read the current state with GET instead of sending the request again. If the original request never recorded its outcome (it crashed), a same-key retry gets 409 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_IN_FLIGHT` until 15 minutes plus the route's lease have passed since the original was sent (about 16 minutes, or about 20 for transfer batches), then 409 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN` with no `Retry-After`, as does every later retry with that key: read the resource with GET to see whether it ran, then send again with a new key. A 5xx is stored and replayed like any other answer; retry it with a new key.

## Request body

`application/json` · required

Update counterparty request body. At least one field must be provided.

- **`externalId`** · `string | null` · min length 1 · max length 256 · example `customer_42`

  Updated opaque external ID. Do not include personal data. Use null to clear.

- **`entityType`** · `string` · one of `individual`, `business` · example `business`

  Updated counterparty entity type.

- **`displayName`** · `string` · min length 1 · max length 512 · example `Jane Q. Doe`

  Updated searchable display name. Keep it minimal.

## Responses

- **`200`** Counterparty updated

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    Counterparty response payload.

    - **`counterparty`** · `object` · required

      Counterparty record.

      - **`id`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `cpty_example`

        Counterparty identifier.

      - **`organizationId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `org_example`

        Organization identifier.

      - **`projectId`** · `string | null` · required · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

        Project scope when the counterparty is project-scoped.

      - **`externalId`** · `string | null` · required · example `customer_42`

        Caller-supplied opaque identifier for cross-system reference. Do not place personal data in this indexed field.

      - **`entityType`** · `string` · required · one of `individual`, `business` · example `individual`

        Counterparty entity type.

      - **`displayName`** · `string` · required · example `Jane Doe`

        Human-readable, searchable display name. Keep it minimal because this indexed field is not application-encrypted.

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `active`, `archived` · example `active`

        Counterparty status.

      - **`createdBy`** · `string | null` · required · min length 1 · example `usr_example`

        User who created the counterparty. Null when created via API key.

      - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        Creation timestamp.

      - **`updatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-02T00:00:00.000Z`

        Last update timestamp.

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `counterparties.manage` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`404`** Not Found

### Get counterparty ramp requirements
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/counterparties/get-counterparty-requirements

> Evaluates whether a counterparty is ready to create a quote with the selected ramp provider and returns any fields or provider-hosted actions still required.

`GET /v1/counterparties/{counterpartyId}/requirements`

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `counterparties.read` action.

## Path parameters

- **`counterpartyId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `cpty_example`

  Counterparty identifier.

## Query parameters

- **`provider`** · `string` · required · example `moonpay`

  Ramp provider to evaluate.

  Any of:

  - **string** · one of `moonpay`, `stripe`

  - **string** · always `moonpay`

- **`direction`** · `string` · required · one of `onramp`, `offramp` · example `onramp`

  Ramp direction.

- **`assetRail`** · `string` · required · one of `sol.solana`, `usdc.solana`, `usdt.solana`, `usdg.solana`, `pyusd.solana` · example `usdc.solana`

  Canonical SDP crypto asset rail.

- **`fiatCurrency`** · `string` · required · one of `AUD`, `BRL`, `CAD`, `CHF`, `COP`, `CZK`, `DKK`, `DOP`, `EGP`, `EUR`, `GBP`, `HKD`, `IDR`, `ILS`, `JOD`, `KES`, `KWD`, `LKR`, `MXN`, `NGN`, `NOK`, `NZD`, `OMR`, `PEN`, `PLN`, `RON`, `SEK`, `THB`, `TRY`, `TWD`, `USD`, `VND`, `ZAR` · example `USD`

  Fiat currency code.

- **`destinationCustodyWalletId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `cwlt_example`

  Custody wallet ID (the `id` returned by the wallets API). Required when direction is onramp.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Selects the active project for this request. Required for Clerk (dashboard) callers. Ignored when authenticating with an API key, whose scope is fixed to the key's project.

## Responses

- **`200`** Counterparty ramp requirements

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    Current provider-specific readiness state and any fields or actions required before creating a ramp quote.

    Any of:

    - **status: "ready"**

      - **`direction`** · `string` · required · one of `onramp`, `offramp` · example `onramp`

        Ramp direction evaluated for this counterparty.

      - **`provider`** · `string` · required · one of `moonpay`, `stripe`

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · always `ready`

    - **status: "collect"**

      - **`direction`** · `string` · required · one of `onramp`, `offramp` · example `onramp`

        Ramp direction evaluated for this counterparty.

      - **`provider`** · `string` · required · one of `moonpay`, `stripe`

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · always `collect`

      - **`fields`** · `object[]` · required

        One of:

        - **kind: "text"**

          - **`kind`** · `string` · required · always `text`

          - **`key`** · `string` · required

          - **`label`** · `string` · required

          - **`required`** · `boolean` · required

          - **`pattern`** · `string`

          - **`minLength`** · `integer` · min 0

          - **`maxLength`** · `integer` · min 0

          - **`placeholder`** · `string`

          - **`mask`** · `string`

        - **kind: "select"**

          - **`kind`** · `string` · required · always `select`

          - **`key`** · `string` · required

          - **`label`** · `string` · required

          - **`required`** · `boolean` · required

          - **`options`** · `object[]` · required

            - **`value`** · `string` · required

            - **`label`** · `string` · required

        - **kind: "country"**

          - **`kind`** · `string` · required · always `country`

          - **`key`** · `string` · required

          - **`label`** · `string` · required

          - **`required`** · `boolean` · required

          - **`options`** · `string[]`

            Subset of country codes the client may offer; absent means every supported country.

        - **kind: "currency"**

          - **`kind`** · `string` · required · always `currency`

          - **`key`** · `string` · required

          - **`label`** · `string` · required

          - **`required`** · `boolean` · required

          - **`options`** · `string[]`

            Subset of fiat currencies the client may offer; absent means every supported currency.

        - **kind: "date"**

          - **`kind`** · `string` · required · always `date`

          - **`key`** · `string` · required

          - **`label`** · `string` · required

          - **`required`** · `boolean` · required

          - **`before`** · `string`

        - **kind: "address"**

          - **`kind`** · `string` · required · always `address`

          - **`key`** · `string` · required

          - **`label`** · `string` · required

          - **`required`** · `boolean` · required

          - **`fields`** · `object[]` · required

            One of:

            - **kind: "text"**

              - **`kind`** · `string` · required · always `text`

              - **`key`** · `string` · required

              - **`label`** · `string` · required

              - **`required`** · `boolean` · required

              - **`pattern`** · `string`

              - **`minLength`** · `integer` · min 0

              - **`maxLength`** · `integer` · min 0

              - **`placeholder`** · `string`

              - **`mask`** · `string`

            - **kind: "select"**

              - **`kind`** · `string` · required · always `select`

              - **`key`** · `string` · required

              - **`label`** · `string` · required

              - **`required`** · `boolean` · required

              - **`options`** · `object[]` · required

                - **`value`** · `string` · required

                - **`label`** · `string` · required

            - **kind: "country"**

              - **`kind`** · `string` · required · always `country`

              - **`key`** · `string` · required

              - **`label`** · `string` · required

              - **`required`** · `boolean` · required

              - **`options`** · `string[]`

                Subset of country codes the client may offer; absent means every supported country.

            - **kind: "currency"**

              - **`kind`** · `string` · required · always `currency`

              - **`key`** · `string` · required

              - **`label`** · `string` · required

              - **`required`** · `boolean` · required

              - **`options`** · `string[]`

                Subset of fiat currencies the client may offer; absent means every supported currency.

            - **kind: "date"**

              - **`kind`** · `string` · required · always `date`

              - **`key`** · `string` · required

              - **`label`** · `string` · required

              - **`required`** · `boolean` · required

              - **`before`** · `string`

    - **status: "unsupported"**

      - **`direction`** · `string` · required · one of `onramp`, `offramp` · example `onramp`

        Ramp direction evaluated for this counterparty.

      - **`provider`** · `string` · required · one of `moonpay`, `stripe`

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · always `unsupported`

      - **`reason`** · `string` · required

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `counterparties.read` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`404`** Not Found

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `400`.

### List counterparty accounts
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/counterparties/list-counterparty-accounts

> Lists payment accounts for a counterparty.

`GET /v1/counterparties/{counterpartyId}/accounts`

Crypto-wallet accounts can be used by payment flows that send funds to a counterparty wallet.

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `counterparties.read` action.

### Create counterparty account
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/counterparties/create-counterparty-account

> Creates a payment account for a counterparty.

`POST /v1/counterparties/{counterpartyId}/accounts`

For accountKind "crypto_wallet", details.network must be "solana" and details.address must be a Solana wallet address.

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `counterparties.execute` action.

## Path parameters

- **`counterpartyId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `cpty_example`

  Counterparty identifier.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Selects the active project for this request. Required for Clerk (dashboard) callers. Ignored when authenticating with an API key, whose scope is fixed to the key's project.

- **`Idempotency-Key`** · `string` · pattern `^[\x20-\x7e]{1,255}$` · example `idempotency_example_12345`

  Optional, and honored when sent. 1-255 printable ASCII characters; send a UUID per logical operation and reuse it on every retry. Within 24 hours, a retry with the same key and the same request returns the stored status and body with the response header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`. Keys are scoped to the credential: within 24 hours, the same key with a different request, or from a different credential, returns 422 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED`; after that, the same key from a different credential runs as a new request. A rotated API key is a new credential, so after any rotation read the resource with GET to see whether the original request ran, and never resend a money request under the new credential without checking first. A key whose original request is still running returns 409 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_IN_FLIGHT` with `Retry-After`. A 400, 401, 403, 409 or 429 refusal is not stored, so the same key runs again once the cause is fixed. Access is checked before the key on every request, so a refused request never claims the key, and a credential that has since lost access to the named resource gets 403 instead of the stored response. A replay is a snapshot of the original response: read the current state with GET instead of sending the request again. If the original request never recorded its outcome (it crashed), a same-key retry gets 409 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_IN_FLIGHT` until 15 minutes plus the route's lease have passed since the original was sent (about 16 minutes, or about 20 for transfer batches), then 409 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN` with no `Retry-After`, as does every later retry with that key: read the resource with GET to see whether it ran, then send again with a new key. A 5xx is stored and replayed like any other answer; retry it with a new key.

## Request body

`application/json` · required

Create counterparty account request body.

- **`accountKind`** · `string` · required · always `crypto_wallet` · example `crypto_wallet`

  Counterparty account kind.

- **`label`** · `string` · min length 1 · max length 256 · example `USDC wallet`

  Optional account label.

- **`details`** · `object`

  For crypto_wallet accounts, must include network: "solana" and address as a Solana wallet address.

  - **`*`** · `any`

- **`providerAccountData`** · `object`

  Provider-specific metadata to preserve with the account.

  - **`*`** · `any`

## Responses

- **`201`** Counterparty account created

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    Counterparty account response payload.

    - **`account`** · `object` · required

      Counterparty payment account record.

      - **`id`** · `string` · required · example `cpa_example`

        Counterparty account identifier.

      - **`organizationId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `org_example`

        Organization identifier.

      - **`projectId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

        Project identifier.

      - **`counterpartyId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `cpty_example`

        Counterparty identifier.

      - **`accountKind`** · `string` · required · always `crypto_wallet` · example `crypto_wallet`

        Counterparty account kind.

      - **`label`** · `string | null` · required · example `USDC wallet`

        Optional human-readable account label.

      - **`details`** · `object` · required

        Account details. For crypto_wallet accounts, include network: "solana" and address as a Solana wallet address.

        - **`*`** · `any`

      - **`providerAccountData`** · `object` · required

        Provider-specific account metadata preserved by SDP.

        - **`*`** · `any`

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `active`, `archived` · example `active`

        Counterparty account status.

      - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        Creation timestamp.

      - **`updatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-02T00:00:00.000Z`

        Last update timestamp.

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `counterparties.execute` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`404`** Not Found

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`409`** Conflict

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`422`** Unprocessable Entity

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `400`.

```bash tab="cURL"

    "label": "USDC wallet",
    "details": {
      "network": "solana",
```

```ts tab="TypeScript"
  })

```

### List counterparty provider accounts
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/counterparties/list-counterparty-provider-accounts

> Lists provider-owned fiat payout accounts for a counterparty.

`GET /v1/counterparties/{counterpartyId}/provider-accounts`

Provider details are fetched just in time and account numbers are returned only as last-four digits.

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `counterparties.read` action.

## Path parameters

- **`counterpartyId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `cpty_example`

  Counterparty identifier.

## Query parameters

- **`provider`** · `string` · one of `moonpay`, `stripe` · example `moonpay`

  Filter by ramp provider.

- **`fiatCurrency`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `USD`

  Filter by fiat currency.

### Update counterparty account
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/counterparties/update-counterparty-account

> Updates a counterparty payment account.

`PATCH /v1/counterparties/{counterpartyId}/accounts/{counterpartyAccountId}`

At least one field must be provided.

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `counterparties.execute` action.

## Path parameters

- **`counterpartyId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `cpty_example`

  Counterparty identifier.

- **`counterpartyAccountId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `cpa_example`

  Counterparty account identifier.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Selects the active project for this request. Required for Clerk (dashboard) callers. Ignored when authenticating with an API key, whose scope is fixed to the key's project.

- **`Idempotency-Key`** · `string` · pattern `^[\x20-\x7e]{1,255}$` · example `idempotency_example_12345`

  Optional, and honored when sent. 1-255 printable ASCII characters; send a UUID per logical operation and reuse it on every retry. Within 24 hours, a retry with the same key and the same request returns the stored status and body with the response header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`. Keys are scoped to the credential: within 24 hours, the same key with a different request, or from a different credential, returns 422 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED`; after that, the same key from a different credential runs as a new request. A rotated API key is a new credential, so after any rotation read the resource with GET to see whether the original request ran, and never resend a money request under the new credential without checking first. A key whose original request is still running returns 409 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_IN_FLIGHT` with `Retry-After`. A 400, 401, 403, 409 or 429 refusal is not stored, so the same key runs again once the cause is fixed. Access is checked before the key on every request, so a refused request never claims the key, and a credential that has since lost access to the named resource gets 403 instead of the stored response. A replay is a snapshot of the original response: read the current state with GET instead of sending the request again. If the original request never recorded its outcome (it crashed), a same-key retry gets 409 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_IN_FLIGHT` until 15 minutes plus the route's lease have passed since the original was sent (about 16 minutes, or about 20 for transfer batches), then 409 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN` with no `Retry-After`, as does every later retry with that key: read the resource with GET to see whether it ran, then send again with a new key. A 5xx is stored and replayed like any other answer; retry it with a new key.

## Request body

`application/json` · required

Update counterparty account request body. At least one field must be provided.

- **`label`** · `string | null` · min length 1 · max length 256 · example `Primary USDC wallet`

  Updated account label. Use null to clear.

- **`details`** · `object`

  Updated account details. Crypto-wallet accounts must retain network: "solana" and a valid Solana wallet address.

  - **`*`** · `any`

- **`providerAccountData`** · `object`

  Updated provider-specific metadata.

  - **`*`** · `any`

## Responses

- **`200`** Counterparty account updated

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    Counterparty account response payload.

    - **`account`** · `object` · required

      Counterparty payment account record.

      - **`id`** · `string` · required · example `cpa_example`

        Counterparty account identifier.

      - **`organizationId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `org_example`

        Organization identifier.

      - **`projectId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

        Project identifier.

      - **`counterpartyId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `cpty_example`

        Counterparty identifier.

      - **`accountKind`** · `string` · required · always `crypto_wallet` · example `crypto_wallet`

        Counterparty account kind.

      - **`label`** · `string | null` · required · example `USDC wallet`

        Optional human-readable account label.

      - **`details`** · `object` · required

        Account details. For crypto_wallet accounts, include network: "solana" and address as a Solana wallet address.

        - **`*`** · `any`

      - **`providerAccountData`** · `object` · required

        Provider-specific account metadata preserved by SDP.

        - **`*`** · `any`

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `active`, `archived` · example `active`

        Counterparty account status.

      - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        Creation timestamp.

      - **`updatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-02T00:00:00.000Z`

        Last update timestamp.

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`404`** Not Found

### Archive counterparty account
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/counterparties/archive-counterparty-account

> Archives a counterparty payment account.

`DELETE /v1/counterparties/{counterpartyId}/accounts/{counterpartyAccountId}`

Archived accounts are hidden from default lists.

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `counterparties.manage` action.

## Path parameters

- **`counterpartyId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `cpty_example`

  Counterparty identifier.

- **`counterpartyAccountId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `cpa_example`

  Counterparty account identifier.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Selects the active project for this request. Required for Clerk (dashboard) callers. Ignored when authenticating with an API key, whose scope is fixed to the key's project.

- **`Idempotency-Key`** · `string` · pattern `^[\x20-\x7e]{1,255}$` · example `idempotency_example_12345`

  Optional, and honored when sent. 1-255 printable ASCII characters; send a UUID per logical operation and reuse it on every retry. Within 24 hours, a retry with the same key and the same request returns the stored status and body with the response header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`. Keys are scoped to the credential: within 24 hours, the same key with a different request, or from a different credential, returns 422 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED`; after that, the same key from a different credential runs as a new request. A rotated API key is a new credential, so after any rotation read the resource with GET to see whether the original request ran, and never resend a money request under the new credential without checking first. A key whose original request is still running returns 409 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_IN_FLIGHT` with `Retry-After`. A 400, 401, 403, 409 or 429 refusal is not stored, so the same key runs again once the cause is fixed. Access is checked before the key on every request, so a refused request never claims the key, and a credential that has since lost access to the named resource gets 403 instead of the stored response. A replay is a snapshot of the original response: read the current state with GET instead of sending the request again. If the original request never recorded its outcome (it crashed), a same-key retry gets 409 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_IN_FLIGHT` until 15 minutes plus the route's lease have passed since the original was sent (about 16 minutes, or about 20 for transfer batches), then 409 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN` with no `Retry-After`, as does every later retry with that key: read the resource with GET to see whether it ran, then send again with a new key. A 5xx is stored and replayed like any other answer; retry it with a new key.

## Responses

- **`204`** Counterparty account archived

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `counterparties.manage` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`404`** Not Found

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`409`** Conflict

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`422`** Unprocessable Entity

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `400`.

## Example request

```bash tab="cURL"
curl -X DELETE 'https://api.solana.com/v1/counterparties/cpty_example/accounts/cpa_example' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SDP_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)"
```

```ts tab="TypeScript"
const res = await fetch("https://api.solana.com/v1/counterparties/cpty_example/accounts/cpa_example", {
  method: "DELETE",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.SDP_API_KEY}`,
    "Idempotency-Key": crypto.randomUUID()
  }
});
```

```python tab="Python"
  headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['SDP_API_KEY']}", "Idempotency-Key": str(uuid.uuid4())})
```

### List asset profiles
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/asset-profiles/list-asset-profiles

> Lists asset profiles for the authenticated organization and project.

`GET /v1/issuance/asset-profiles`

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `issuance.read` action.

## Query parameters

- **`page`** · `integer` · greater than 0 · default `1` · example `1`

  Page number (1-based).

- **`pageSize`** · `integer` · min 1 · max 100 · default `20` · example `20`

  Items per page (max 100).

- **`includeArchived`** · `boolean` · example `false`

  Include archived asset profiles in results.

- **`category`** · `string` · one of `generic`, `stablecoin`, `tokenized_security` · example `stablecoin`

  Filter by asset category.

- **`tokenIds`** · `string` · example `tok_abc123,tok_def456`

  Restrict results to these token ids as a comma-separated list (max 100). Lets a client hydrate exactly the tokens on the page it is rendering.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Selects the active project for this request. Required for Clerk (dashboard) callers. Ignored when authenticating with an API key, whose scope is fixed to the key's project.

## Responses

- **`200`** Asset profiles list

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    Paginated list of asset profiles.

    - **`assetProfiles`** · `object[]` · required

      Asset profiles.

      - **`id`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `asset_profile_example`

        Asset profile identifier.

      - **`organizationId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `org_example`

        Organization identifier.

      - **`projectId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

        Project identifier.

      - **`tokenId`** · `string` · required · example `tok_example`

        Identifier of the issued token this profile describes.

      - **`assetCategory`** · `string` · required · one of `generic`, `stablecoin`, `tokenized_security` · example `stablecoin`

        Broad product/regulatory grouping for an issued asset.

      - **`assetType`** · `string` · required · example `fiat_backed`

        Concrete asset type within the category.

      - **`assetTypeVersion`** · `integer` · required · greater than 0 · example `2`

        Version of the asset type registry contract this profile was validated against.

      - **`issuanceMetadata`** · `object` · required

        Canonical, private master metadata for the asset. SDP-owned namespaces (asset, compliance, chain) plus a namespaced custom bucket (customer, integration). The optional `visibility.public` array holds the issuance_metadata dot-paths the issuer chose to expose publicly; when omitted, the asset type's registry default is used. Only asset.* and chain.decimals paths can ever be projected publicly — compliance and custom fields are private by default and can never be exposed, even if listed in visibility.public. The optional `settings` namespace holds the selected advanced (Token-2022) settings; `version` is server-stamped and each selected key is validated against the asset type's capability.

        - **`asset`** · `object`

          - **`*`** · `any`

        - **`compliance`** · `object`

          - **`*`** · `any`

        - **`chain`** · `object`

          - **`*`** · `any`

        - **`custom`** · `object`

          - **`customer`** · `object`

            - **`*`** · `any`

          - **`integration`** · `object`

            - **`*`** · `any`

        - **`visibility`** · `object`

          - **`public`** · `string[]`

        - **`settings`** · `object`

          - **`version`** · `integer` · greater than 0

          - **`selected`** · `object` · required

            - **`*`** · `object`

              - **`params`** · `object`

                - **`*`** · `string | number`

                  Any of:

                  - **string**

                  - **number**

        - **`*`** · `any`

      - **`publicMetadata`** · `object` · required

        Safe public subset of the issuance metadata, derived via the asset type's projection rules. Served by the public token metadata URI.

        - **`*`** · `any`

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `active`, `archived` · example `active`

        Asset profile status.

      - **`createdBy`** · `string | null` · required · min length 1 · example `usr_example`

        User who created the profile. Null when created via API key.

      - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        Creation timestamp.

      - **`updatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-02T00:00:00.000Z`

        Last update timestamp.

    - **`total`** · `integer` · required · min 0 · example `7`

      Total asset profiles matching the query.

    - **`page`** · `integer` · required · greater than 0 · example `1`

      Current page number.

    - **`pageSize`** · `integer` · required · greater than 0 · example `20`

      Items per page.

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `issuance.read` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `400`.
