### Create token with asset profile
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/asset-profiles/create-token-with-asset-profile

> Creates an issued token and its asset profile atomically in a single transaction: if either write fails, both roll back, so a token is never persisted without a profile.

`POST /v1/issuance/asset-profiles`

Requires the Asset Profiles feature to be enabled.

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `issuance.manage` action.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Selects the active project for this request. Required for Clerk (dashboard) callers. Ignored when authenticating with an API key, whose scope is fixed to the key's project.

## Request body

`application/json` · required

Create token + asset profile request body: the token-create fields plus the asset profile's category, type, and issuance metadata. The token and its profile are created atomically.

- **`name`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · max length 100 · example `Example Token`

  Token name.

- **`symbol`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · max length 10 · pattern `^[A-Za-z0-9]+(?:\.[A-Za-z0-9]+)*$` · example `EXM`

  Ticker symbol.

- **`signingCustodyWalletId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `cwlt_example`

  Optional exact SDP Wallet ID for direct deployment. A draft may defer selection until deploy.

- **`decimals`** · `integer` · min 0 · max 18 · example `6`

  Token decimals.

- **`description`** · `string` · max length 500 · example `Example token description.`

  Token description.

- **`uri`** · `string` · format `uri` · max length 512 · example `https://example.com/metadata.json`

  Metadata URI passed to on-chain token metadata (points to off-chain JSON).

- **`imageUrl`** · `string` · format `uri` · max length 512 · example `https://example.com/token.png`

  Token image URL.

- **`maxSupply`** · `string` · example `1000000`

  Maximum supply as a string (UI units).

- **`template`** · `string` · one of `stablecoin`, `arcade`, `tokenized-security`, `custom` · example `stablecoin`

  Token template preset. Defaults to 'custom' if not specified.

- **`overrides`** · `object`

  Template overrides to customize defaults.

  - **`extensions`** · `object`

    Override template extension configuration.

    - **`transferFee`** · `boolean | object`

      Transfer fee configuration or false to disable.

      Any of:

      - **boolean** · always `false`

      - **object**

        - **`basisPoints`** · `integer` · required · min 0 · max 10000 · example `50`

          Transfer fee in basis points.

        - **`maxFee`** · `string` · required · example `0.5`

          Maximum fee in UI units.

        - **`transferFeeConfigAuthority`** · `string` · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

          Authority to configure transfer fees. Defaults to platform authority.

        - **`withdrawWithheldAuthority`** · `string` · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

          Authority to withdraw withheld fees. Defaults to platform authority.

    - **`interestBearing`** · `boolean | object`

      Interest-bearing configuration or false to disable.

      Any of:

      - **boolean** · always `false`

      - **object**

        - **`rate`** · `number` · required · example `2.5`

          Interest rate in percent.

        - **`rateAuthority`** · `string` · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

          Authority that can update the rate. Defaults to platform authority.

    - **`permanentDelegate`** · `boolean | string` · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

      Permanent delegate authority address, or false to disable.

      Any of:

      - **boolean** · always `false`

      - **string**

    - **`pausable`** · `boolean | object`

      Pausable configuration or false to disable.

      Any of:

      - **boolean** · always `false`

      - **object**

        - **`authority`** · `string` · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

          Authority that can pause/resume transfers. Defaults to platform authority.

    - **`nonTransferable`** · `boolean` · example `false`

      Enable/disable non-transferable.

    - **`defaultAccountState`** · `string` · one of `initialized`, `frozen` · example `frozen`

      Override default account state.

    - **`scaledUiAmount`** · `boolean | object`

      Scaled UI amount configuration or false to disable.

      Any of:

      - **boolean** · always `false`

      - **object**

        - **`authority`** · `string` · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

          Authority that can update scaled UI parameters. Defaults to platform authority.

        - **`multiplier`** · `number` · required · example `1`

          Current UI multiplier.

        - **`newMultiplier`** · `number` · example `2`

          Scheduled multiplier.

        - **`newMultiplierEffectiveTimestamp`** · `integer` · example `1735689600`

          Unix timestamp (seconds) when the new multiplier takes effect.

    - **`transferHook`** · `boolean | object`

      Transfer hook configuration or false to disable.

      Any of:

      - **boolean** · always `false`

      - **object**

        - **`programId`** · `string` · required · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

          Transfer hook program id.

        - **`authority`** · `string` · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

          Authority that can update the hook program. Defaults to platform authority.

  - **`requiresAllowlist`** · `boolean` · example `true`

    Override allowlist requirement (if template allows).

- **`requiresAllowlist`** · `boolean` · example `true`

  Require allowlist checks for transfers.

- **`isMintable`** · `boolean` · example `true`

  Allow minting after creation.

- **`isFreezable`** · `boolean` · example `true`

  Allow freezing token accounts.

- **`assetCategory`** · `string` · one of `generic`, `stablecoin`, `tokenized_security` · default `generic` · example `stablecoin`

  Asset category for the token's profile. Defaults to generic.

- **`assetType`** · `string` · min length 1 · max length 128 · default `generic` · example `fiat_backed`

  Asset type within the category. Must be supported for the category.

- **`issuanceMetadata`** · `object`

  Optional canonical issuance metadata for the profile. Public metadata is derived from it.

  - **`asset`** · `object`

    - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`compliance`** · `object`

    - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`chain`** · `object`

    - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`custom`** · `object`

    - **`customer`** · `object`

      - **`*`** · `any`

    - **`integration`** · `object`

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`visibility`** · `object`

    - **`public`** · `string[]`

  - **`settings`** · `object`

    - **`version`** · `integer` · greater than 0

    - **`selected`** · `object` · required

      - **`*`** · `object`

        - **`params`** · `object`

          - **`*`** · `string | number`

            Any of:

            - **string**

            - **number**

  - **`*`** · `any`

## Responses

- **`201`** Token and asset profile created

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    Token + asset profile response payload.

    - **`token`** · `object` · required

      The created token.

      - **`id`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `tok_example`

        Token identifier.

      - **`projectId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

        Project identifier.

      - **`organizationId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `org_example`

        Organization identifier.

      - **`signingCustodyWalletId`** · `string | null` · required · min length 1 · example `cwlt_example`

        Exact deployment wallet selected for a pending token, or historical deployment attribution after deployment. This is not the current signer for later authority operations.

      - **`mintAddress`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Mint address once deployed.

      - **`mintAuthority`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Mint authority address, if set.

      - **`freezeAuthority`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Freeze authority address, if set.

      - **`ablListAddress`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        On-chain allowlist/blocklist address, if enabled.

      - **`name`** · `string` · required · example `Example Token`

        Token name.

      - **`symbol`** · `string` · required · example `EXM`

        Token symbol.

      - **`decimals`** · `integer` · required · example `9`

        Token decimals.

      - **`description`** · `string | null` · required · example `Example token description.`

        Token description.

      - **`uri`** · `string | null` · required · example `https://example.com/metadata.json`

        Metadata URI passed to on-chain token metadata (points to off-chain JSON).

      - **`imageUrl`** · `string | null` · required · example `https://example.com/token.png`

        Token image URL.

      - **`template`** · `string` · required · one of `stablecoin`, `arcade`, `tokenized-security`, `custom`, `rwa` · example `stablecoin`

        Token template identifier.

      - **`extensions`** · `object | null` · required

        Token-2022 extensions configuration.

        - **`transferFee`** · `object`

          Transfer fee configuration.

          - **`basisPoints`** · `integer` · required · min 0 · max 10000 · example `25`

            Transfer fee in basis points (0-10000).

          - **`maxFee`** · `string` · required · example `0.5`

            Maximum fee in UI units.

          - **`transferFeeConfigAuthority`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

            Authority to configure transfer fees.

          - **`withdrawWithheldAuthority`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

            Authority to withdraw withheld fees.

        - **`interestBearing`** · `object`

          Interest-bearing configuration.

          - **`rate`** · `number` · required · example `2.5`

            Interest rate in percent.

          - **`rateAuthority`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

            Authority that can update the rate.

        - **`permanentDelegate`** · `string` · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

          Permanent delegate address.

        - **`pausable`** · `object`

          Pausable configuration.

          - **`authority`** · `string` · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

            Authority that can pause/resume transfers.

        - **`nonTransferable`** · `boolean` · example `false`

          Mark token as non-transferable.

        - **`defaultAccountState`** · `string` · one of `initialized`, `frozen` · example `initialized`

          Default account state.

        - **`scaledUiAmount`** · `object`

          Scaled UI amount configuration.

          - **`authority`** · `string` · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

            Authority that can update scaled UI parameters.

          - **`multiplier`** · `number` · required · example `1`

            Current UI multiplier.

          - **`newMultiplier`** · `number` · required · example `2`

            Scheduled multiplier.

          - **`newMultiplierEffectiveTimestamp`** · `integer` · required · example `1735689600`

            Unix timestamp (seconds) when the new multiplier takes effect.

        - **`transferHook`** · `object`

          Transfer hook configuration.

          - **`programId`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

            Transfer hook program id.

          - **`authority`** · `string` · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

            Authority that can update the transfer hook program.

      - **`totalSupply`** · `string` · required · example `1000000`

        Cached total supply in UI units (stored to avoid frequent RPC reads). Use POST /v1/issuance/tokens/\{tokenId\}/supply/refresh to force an on-chain refresh.

      - **`totalSupplyUpdatedAt`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `null`

        Timestamp when supply was last refreshed.

      - **`maxSupply`** · `string | null` · required · example `10000000`

        Maximum supply in UI units, if capped.

      - **`isMintable`** · `boolean` · required · example `true`

        Whether additional minting is allowed.

      - **`isFreezable`** · `boolean` · required · example `true`

        Whether freeze authority is enabled.

      - **`requiresAllowlist`** · `boolean` · required · example `false`

        Whether transfers require allowlist approval.

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `pending`, `active`, `paused`, `revoked` · example `active`

        Token lifecycle status.

      - **`deployedAt`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-05T00:00:00.000Z`

        Deployment timestamp, if deployed.

      - **`createdBy`** · `string` · required · example `key_example`

        Actor identifier that created the token.

      - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        Creation timestamp.

      - **`updatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-02T00:00:00.000Z`

        Last update timestamp.

    - **`assetProfile`** · `object` · required

      The created asset profile.

      - **`id`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `asset_profile_example`

        Asset profile identifier.

      - **`organizationId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `org_example`

        Organization identifier.

      - **`projectId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

        Project identifier.

      - **`tokenId`** · `string` · required · example `tok_example`

        Identifier of the issued token this profile describes.

      - **`assetCategory`** · `string` · required · one of `generic`, `stablecoin`, `tokenized_security` · example `stablecoin`

        Broad product/regulatory grouping for an issued asset.

      - **`assetType`** · `string` · required · example `fiat_backed`

        Concrete asset type within the category.

      - **`assetTypeVersion`** · `integer` · required · greater than 0 · example `2`

        Version of the asset type registry contract this profile was validated against.

      - **`issuanceMetadata`** · `object` · required

        Canonical, private master metadata for the asset. SDP-owned namespaces (asset, compliance, chain) plus a namespaced custom bucket (customer, integration). The optional `visibility.public` array holds the issuance_metadata dot-paths the issuer chose to expose publicly; when omitted, the asset type's registry default is used. Only asset.* and chain.decimals paths can ever be projected publicly — compliance and custom fields are private by default and can never be exposed, even if listed in visibility.public. The optional `settings` namespace holds the selected advanced (Token-2022) settings; `version` is server-stamped and each selected key is validated against the asset type's capability.

        - **`asset`** · `object`

          - **`*`** · `any`

        - **`compliance`** · `object`

          - **`*`** · `any`

        - **`chain`** · `object`

          - **`*`** · `any`

        - **`custom`** · `object`

          - **`customer`** · `object`

            - **`*`** · `any`

          - **`integration`** · `object`

            - **`*`** · `any`

        - **`visibility`** · `object`

          - **`public`** · `string[]`

        - **`settings`** · `object`

          - **`version`** · `integer` · greater than 0

          - **`selected`** · `object` · required

            - **`*`** · `object`

              - **`params`** · `object`

                - **`*`** · `string | number`

                  Any of:

                  - **string**

                  - **number**

        - **`*`** · `any`

      - **`publicMetadata`** · `object` · required

        Safe public subset of the issuance metadata, derived via the asset type's projection rules. Served by the public token metadata URI.

        - **`*`** · `any`

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `active`, `archived` · example `active`

        Asset profile status.

      - **`createdBy`** · `string | null` · required · min length 1 · example `usr_example`

        User who created the profile. Null when created via API key.

      - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        Creation timestamp.

      - **`updatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-02T00:00:00.000Z`

        Last update timestamp.

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `issuance.manage` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `400`.

## Example request

```bash tab="cURL"
curl -X POST 'https://api.solana.com/v1/issuance/asset-profiles' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SDP_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "name": "Example Token",
    "symbol": "EXM",
    "signingCustodyWalletId": "cwlt_example",
    "decimals": 6,
    "description": "Example token description.",
    "uri": "https://example.com/metadata.json",
    "imageUrl": "https://example.com/token.png",
    "maxSupply": "1000000",
    "template": "stablecoin",
    "overrides": {
      "extensions": {
        "transferFee": {
          "basisPoints": 50,
          "maxFee": "0.5"
        }
      }
    },
    "requiresAllowlist": true,
    "isMintable": true,
    "isFreezable": true,
    "assetCategory": "stablecoin",
    "assetType": "fiat_backed",
    "issuanceMetadata": {
      "asset": {
        "name": "Acme USD",
        "issuerName": "Acme Financial Inc.",
        "pegCurrency": "USD"
      },
      "compliance": {
        "transferRestrictions": "reg_d"
      },
      "chain": {
        "decimals": 6
      },
      "custom": {
        "customer": {
          "internalDeskId": "FX-22"
        },
        "integration": {}
      }
    }
  }'
```

### Get asset profile by token
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/asset-profiles/get-asset-profile-by-token

> Gets the active asset profile for an issued token, if one exists.

`GET /v1/issuance/asset-profiles/by-token/{tokenId}`

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `issuance.read` action.

## Path parameters

- **`tokenId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `tok_example`

  Token identifier.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Selects the active project for this request. Required for Clerk (dashboard) callers. Ignored when authenticating with an API key, whose scope is fixed to the key's project.

## Responses

- **`200`** Asset profile

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    Asset profile response payload.

    - **`assetProfile`** · `object` · required

      Asset profile record: SDP-owned description of what an issued token represents.

      - **`id`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `asset_profile_example`

        Asset profile identifier.

      - **`organizationId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `org_example`

        Organization identifier.

      - **`projectId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

        Project identifier.

      - **`tokenId`** · `string` · required · example `tok_example`

        Identifier of the issued token this profile describes.

      - **`assetCategory`** · `string` · required · one of `generic`, `stablecoin`, `tokenized_security` · example `stablecoin`

        Broad product/regulatory grouping for an issued asset.

      - **`assetType`** · `string` · required · example `fiat_backed`

        Concrete asset type within the category.

      - **`assetTypeVersion`** · `integer` · required · greater than 0 · example `2`

        Version of the asset type registry contract this profile was validated against.

      - **`issuanceMetadata`** · `object` · required

        Canonical, private master metadata for the asset. SDP-owned namespaces (asset, compliance, chain) plus a namespaced custom bucket (customer, integration). The optional `visibility.public` array holds the issuance_metadata dot-paths the issuer chose to expose publicly; when omitted, the asset type's registry default is used. Only asset.* and chain.decimals paths can ever be projected publicly — compliance and custom fields are private by default and can never be exposed, even if listed in visibility.public. The optional `settings` namespace holds the selected advanced (Token-2022) settings; `version` is server-stamped and each selected key is validated against the asset type's capability.

        - **`asset`** · `object`

          - **`*`** · `any`

        - **`compliance`** · `object`

          - **`*`** · `any`

        - **`chain`** · `object`

          - **`*`** · `any`

        - **`custom`** · `object`

          - **`customer`** · `object`

            - **`*`** · `any`

          - **`integration`** · `object`

            - **`*`** · `any`

        - **`visibility`** · `object`

          - **`public`** · `string[]`

        - **`settings`** · `object`

          - **`version`** · `integer` · greater than 0

          - **`selected`** · `object` · required

            - **`*`** · `object`

              - **`params`** · `object`

                - **`*`** · `string | number`

                  Any of:

                  - **string**

                  - **number**

        - **`*`** · `any`

      - **`publicMetadata`** · `object` · required

        Safe public subset of the issuance metadata, derived via the asset type's projection rules. Served by the public token metadata URI.

        - **`*`** · `any`

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `active`, `archived` · example `active`

        Asset profile status.

      - **`createdBy`** · `string | null` · required · min length 1 · example `usr_example`

        User who created the profile. Null when created via API key.

      - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        Creation timestamp.

      - **`updatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-02T00:00:00.000Z`

        Last update timestamp.

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `issuance.read` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `401`.

- **`404`** Not Found

  Same fields as `401`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `401`.

## Example request

```bash tab="cURL"
curl 'https://api.solana.com/v1/issuance/asset-profiles/by-token/tok_example' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SDP_API_KEY"
```

```ts tab="TypeScript"

  method: "GET",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.SDP_API_KEY}`
  }
});
```

```python tab="Python"

  headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['SDP_API_KEY']}"})
```

### Update asset profile
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/asset-profiles/update-asset-profile

> Updates an asset profile.

`PATCH /v1/issuance/asset-profiles/{profileId}`

At least one field must be provided. The resulting category/type pair must be supported. Public metadata is recomputed when metadata or the asset type changes; set issuanceMetadata.visibility.public to control which fields are exposed (asset.* and chain.decimals only).

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `issuance.manage` action.

## Path parameters

- **`profileId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `asset_profile_example`

  Asset profile identifier.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Selects the active project for this request. Required for Clerk (dashboard) callers. Ignored when authenticating with an API key, whose scope is fixed to the key's project.

## Request body

`application/json` · required

Update asset profile request body. At least one field must be provided.

- **`assetCategory`** · `string` · one of `generic`, `stablecoin`, `tokenized_security` · example `stablecoin`

  Updated asset category. Must remain consistent with the asset type.

- **`assetType`** · `string` · min length 1 · max length 128 · example `fiat_backed`

  Updated asset type. Must be supported for the (resulting) category.

- **`issuanceMetadata`** · `object`

  Updated issuance metadata. Replaces the existing object; public metadata is recomputed.

  - **`asset`** · `object`

    - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`compliance`** · `object`

    - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`chain`** · `object`

    - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`custom`** · `object`

    - **`customer`** · `object`

      - **`*`** · `any`

    - **`integration`** · `object`

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`visibility`** · `object`

    - **`public`** · `string[]`

  - **`settings`** · `object`

    - **`version`** · `integer` · greater than 0

    - **`selected`** · `object` · required

      - **`*`** · `object`

        - **`params`** · `object`

          - **`*`** · `string | number`

            Any of:

            - **string**

            - **number**

  - **`*`** · `any`

    Asset profile response payload.

      - **`id`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `asset_profile_example`

        Organization identifier.

      - **`projectId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

      - **`tokenId`** · `string` · required · example `tok_example`

      - **`assetCategory`** · `string` · required · one of `generic`, `stablecoin`, `tokenized_security` · example `stablecoin`

        Broad product/regulatory grouping for an issued asset.

      - **`assetType`** · `string` · required · example `fiat_backed`

        Concrete asset type within the category.

      - **`assetTypeVersion`** · `integer` · required · greater than 0 · example `2`

        Version of the asset type registry contract this profile was validated against.

      - **`issuanceMetadata`** · `object` · required

        Canonical, private master metadata for the asset. SDP-owned namespaces (asset, compliance, chain) plus a namespaced custom bucket (customer, integration). The optional `visibility.public` array holds the issuance_metadata dot-paths the issuer chose to expose publicly; when omitted, the asset type's registry default is used.         - **`asset`** · `object`

          - **`*`** · `any`

                - **`*`** · `string | number`

                  Any of:

                  - **string**

                  - **number**

        - **`*`** · `any`

      - **`publicMetadata`** · `object` · required

        Safe public subset of the issuance metadata, derived via the asset type's projection rules. Served by the public token metadata URI.

        - **`*`** · `any`

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `active`, `archived` · example `active`

        Asset profile status.

      - **`createdBy`** · `string | null` · required · min length 1 · example `usr_example`

        User who created the profile. Null when created via API key.

      - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        Creation timestamp.

      - **`updatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-02T00:00:00.000Z`

        Last update timestamp.

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `issuance.manage` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`404`** Not Found

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `400`.

### Archive asset profile
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/asset-profiles/archive-asset-profile

> Archives an asset profile.

`DELETE /v1/issuance/asset-profiles/{profileId}`

Archived profiles are hidden from default lists.

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `issuance.manage` action.

## Path parameters

- **`profileId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `asset_profile_example`

  Asset profile identifier.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Selects the active project for this request. Required for Clerk (dashboard) callers. Ignored when authenticating with an API key, whose scope is fixed to the key's project.

## Responses

- **`204`** Asset profile archived

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `issuance.manage` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `401`.

- **`404`** Not Found

  Same fields as `401`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `401`.

## Example request

```bash tab="cURL"
curl -X DELETE 'https://api.solana.com/v1/issuance/asset-profiles/asset_profile_example' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SDP_API_KEY"
```

```ts tab="TypeScript"

  method: "DELETE",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.SDP_API_KEY}`
  }
});
```

```python tab="Python"

r = requests.delete("https://api.solana.com/v1/issuance/asset-profiles/asset_profile_example",
  headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['SDP_API_KEY']}"})
```
